table_description: This table stores information about various job sites, including their geographical location and associated employer.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This is the primary key for the table, which is an auto-incrementing integer value. It uniquely identifies each record in the table. Example: 1, 2, 3, etc.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: This column stores the name of the job site.

columns.name: Latitude
columns.description: This column stores latitude coordinate of the job site.

columns.name: Longitude
columns.description: This column stores longitude coordinate of the job site.

columns.name: Parentid
columns.description: This column stores the identifier for the parent job site, if any.

columns.name: DeleteFlag
columns.description: This column Indicates whether the job site has been deleted (1) or not (0). Example: 0, 1.

columns.name: Employerid
columns.description: This column stores the employer id .This column refers to the insid column in the insurance table.

table_description: This table stores information about different job categories and their associated employers.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This is the primary key column, which uniquely identifies each record in the table. It is an integer value that is automatically incremented with each new record. Example values: 1, 2, 3, etc.

columns.name: JobCategory
columns.description: This column stores the name of the job category as a string with a maximum length of 250 characters. Example values: "Software Developer", "Data Analyst", "Marketing Manager", etc.

columns.name: deleteFlag
columns.description: This column is a tiny integer value (1 byte) that indicates whether the record has been deleted or not. A value of 1 means the record is deleted, and a value of 0 means the record is active. Example values: 0, 1.

columns.name: Employerid
columns.description: This column stores the foreign key relation to the "insurance" table, specifically the "insid" column. It is an integer value that represents the unique identifier of the employer associated with the job category. Example values: 101, 102, 103, etc. Foreign key relation: "insurance(insid)".

table_description: This table stores information about job titles and their corresponding employee IDs.

columns.name: titleid
columns.description: This is the primary key for the table and is an auto-incrementing integer value that uniquely identifies each job title. Example: 1, 2, 3, etc.

columns.name: titlename
columns.description: This is a variable character field with a maximum length of 200 characters, storing the name of the job title. Examples include: "Software Engineer", "Project Manager", "Data Analyst", etc.

columns.name: empid
columns.description: This is a variable character field with a maximum length of 200 characters, storing the employee id associated with the job title. Examples include: "EMP001", "EMP002", "EMP003", etc.

columns.name: delflag
columns.description: This is a tiny integer field with a default value of "0", indicating whether the record has been deleted or not. A value of "0" means the record is not deleted, while a value of "1" means the record is deleted. Example: 0, 1.

table_description: This table stores information about various employment projects, including their names, parent projects, and associated employers.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This is the primary key column, which uniquely identifies each record in the table. It is an integer value that is automatically incremented as new records are added. Example: 1, 2, 3, etc.

columns.name: Project_NAME
columns.description: This column stores the name of the employment project as a variable character string with a maximum length of 60 characters. Examples include: "Project A", "Project B", "Project C", etc.

columns.name: Parentid
columns.description: This column stores the id of the parent project, if any, as an integer value. It is a foreign key that refers to the "id" column in the same "employment_projects_desc" table. If there is no parent project, the value will be NULL. Examples include: 1, 2, 3, etc., or NULL.

columns.name: DeleteFlag
columns.description: This column stores a flag indicating whether the record has been deleted or not. It is an integer value with a maximum length of 2 digits. A value of 0 indicates that the record is not deleted, while a value of 1 indicates that the record is deleted. Example: 0 or 1.

columns.name: Employerid
columns.description: This column stores the id of the employer associated with the project as an integer value.

table_description: This table stores data/attachments received with incoming referrals.

columns.name: Id
columns.description: Unique identifier for each attachment record. Example: 1, 2, 3.

columns.name: ReferralReqId
columns.description: This column stores id of am incoming referral. This column refer to refreqid column in referral table.

columns.name: progressnotes
columns.description: This column stores contents of progress note(s) received through an incoming referral in XML format.

columns.name: medicalsummary
columns.description: This column stores medical summary received through incoming referral in XML format.

columns.name: labreports
columns.description: This column stores content of lab reports received with incoming referral in XML format.

columns.name: xrays
columns.description: This column stores content of xrays received with incoming referral.

columns.name: specialtyforms
columns.description: This column stores specialty forms received with incoming referral in XML format.

columns.name: ccr
columns.description: This column stores Continuity of Care Record (CCR) received incoming referral in XML format.

columns.name: reqAPUID
columns.description: This column stores APU id of a sender of an incoming referral.

table_description: This table stores documents attached to incoming or outgoing referrals.

columns.name: Id
columns.description: Unique identifier for each attachment record. Example: 1, 2, 3.

columns.name: ReferralReqId
columns.description: This column stores id of a referral through which document has been received or sent out. This column refers to column  ReferralId in referral table.

columns.name: document
columns.description: This column stores entire document attached to corresponding referral id mentioned in ReferralReqId column in binary format.

columns.name: filename
columns.description: This column stores name of the file attached to referral.

columns.name: filelabel
columns.description: This column stores label of document attached to referral, if any.

table_description: This table stores encounter and related information which acts as primary data for that encounter to all the other tables storing various information related to the encounter.

columns.name: encounterid
columns.description: The column stores an id of the encounter of a patient. This column is an auto incremental primary key.

columns.name: patientid
columns.description: This column stores the identifier number of a patient, for whom the appointment is created. It refers to column "UID" from the "user" table.

columns.name: doctorid
columns.description: This column stores the appointment provider id of the encounter. Foreign key relationship: "UID" column of the "user" table.

columns.name: date
columns.description: This column stores the date when the appointment was created. The format used is YYYY-MM-DD

columns.name: time
columns.description: This column is not used anymore.

columns.name: startTime
columns.description: This column stores the start time of the appointment created. The format used is: HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: endTime
columns.description: This column stores the end time of the appointment created. The format used is: HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: reason
columns.description: This column stores a combination of pre-defined text as well as free-text for the Reason section of an appointment for a patient from the user interface.

columns.name: VisitType
columns.description: This column stores the selected visit type of the patient for an appointment from the User Interface. It refers to column name from the visitcodes table.

columns.name: roomno
columns.description: This column stores the room number at the facility where the encounter took place.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: This column stores the current�visit status of an appointment created. This column refers to column code from visitstscodes table.

columns.name: deleteFlag
columns.description: This column stores values  "0  or "1" indicating whether this appointment is deleted. This is soft delete. A "0" means not deleted, while a "1" means deleted.

columns.name: encType
columns.description:
This column stores one of the values listed below which denotes the type of the encounter:
1 - Office Visit, 2 - Tel Encounter, Virtual Visits, 3 - Out of Office, 4 - Claim, 5 - Lab, 6 - Web Encounter, 7 - ePrescription refills, 8 - PTDASH, 9 - Orderset with patient id as 8663.

columns.name: encLock
columns.description: This column stores values "0" or "1" which indicate if an encounter is locked or not. A "1" means locked, and a "0" means not locked.

columns.name: Notes
columns.description: This columns stores additional notes documented for the encounter.

columns.name: generalNotes
columns.description: This column stores the free text general notes documented related to an appointment created.

columns.name: vmid
columns.description: This column stores a string as unique identifiers for each row. Currently, this column is not actively used in the system.

columns.name: facilityid
columns.description: This column stores an id of the facility selected for the created encounter.This columns refers to the column id from edi_facilities.

columns.name: POS
columns.description: This column stores the place of service code where an encounter took place. This column refers to column code from edi_pos table.

columns.name: arrivedTime
columns.description: This column stores the current time when the patient is checked in for the appointment created. The format used is YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: timeIn
columns.description: This column stores the checked in time of the patient for an appointment. The format used is: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: timeOut
columns.description: This column stores the check out time of the patient for an appointment. The format used is: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: stsAfterArr
columns.description: This column stores values IN or OUT which indicate the arrival status of a patient. "IN" means when a patient is checked in, while "OUT" means when patient has checked out.

columns.name: depTime
columns.description: This column stores the current time when the patient is checked out for the appointment created. The format used is: YYYY-MM_DD HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: stsAfterChkIn
columns.description: The status after the patient checked in (e.g., 'Waiting', 'In consultation', 'Completed').

columns.name: HL7id
columns.description: The visit number sent by the vendor for an interface created appointment.

columns.name: newPt
columns.description: This column stores values 0 or 1 which indicate a new patient. A "1" means a new patient, and a "0"means not a new patient.

columns.name: Dx
columns.description: This column stores diagnosis or reason of the patient for the visit (appointment). This column refers to column itemname from the items table.

columns.name: reminded
columns.description: This column stores flags "0" or "1". A "1" is when the appointment is created using Nimbus and patient opts for the Remind Me option. A "0"  means otherwise.

columns.name: remindedDate
columns.description: This column is not used anymore.

columns.name: VisitCopay
columns.description: This column stores the co-pay amount set for the appointment from the encounterid column of the patient.

columns.name: CopayChanged
columns.description: This column stores values "0" or "1" which indicate Co-Pay/Claim changes for the visit of the patient. A "1" means changed, and a "0"  means not changed.

columns.name: ClaimRequired
columns.description: This column is no longer used.

columns.name: ClaimReq
columns.description: This column stores flags "0" or "1". A "1" means the claim is required, and a "0" means the claim is not required.

columns.name: VisitTypeOverriden
columns.description: This column stores code id for the selected visit type for the encounter. This column refers to column codeid from the visitcodes table.

columns.name: refPrName
columns.description: This column stores the last, first name of the referring provider at the facility.

columns.name: refPrid
columns.description: Integer identifier for the referring provider, this column refers to UID column of user table.

columns.name: PSACGroup
columns.description: This column stores the PSAC Group id of the user when a user tries to access the Encounters window of a patient whose records are marked as confidential.

columns.name: deptid
columns.description: This column stores an id of the department to which the encounter is associated. This column refers to the column deptid from the departments table.

columns.name: Resourceid
columns.description: This column stores the id of a resource such as anyone on the staff (except a physician), devices, or even rooms.

columns.name: EncEligibilityStatus
columns.description:
This column stores one of the below flags when eligibility for primary insurance is checked at encounter level. Flags include:
E = Eligible    V  =  Not Verified,     N  = InEligible

columns.name: EligibilityMessage
columns.description: This column stores messages received from the insurance company for the eligibility request sent for the primary insurance.

columns.name: Invoiceid
columns.description: This column stores claim (invoice) number corresponding to the encounter. This column refers to the id column of the edi_invoice table.

columns.name: EligSubid
columns.description: This column stores an id for the eligibility submitted request. This column refers to the column submissionid from the x271respDetails table.

columns.name: EncEligibilityStatus2
columns.description: This column stores one of the below flags when eligibility for secondary insurance is checked at encounter level. Flags include: E = Eligible V = Not Verified, N = InEligible

columns.name: EligibilityMessage2
columns.description: This column stores message received from the Insurance company for the eligibility request sent for the secondary insurance.

columns.name: EncEligibilityStatus3
columns.description: This column stores one of the below flags when eligibility for tertiary insurance is checked at the encounter level. Flags include: E = Eligible V = Not Verified, N = InEligible

columns.name: EligibilityMessage3
columns.description: This column stores messages received from the insurance company for the eligibility request sent for the tertiary insurance.

columns.name: trans_dictation
columns.description: This column stores the flags 0 or 1. A "1" means when the physician documents the notes for the encounter, and a "0" means otherwise. This column is not being used anymore. Confirm with developer.

columns.name: waitTime
columns.description: This column stores the estimated wait time for a patient in the waiting room. The format used is YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: websync
columns.description: This column stores the flags 0 or 1. A "1" means the encounter is uploaded to portal, and a "0" means the encounter is not uploaded to portal.

columns.name: dateIn
columns.description: This column stores the date when the patient is checked in by the end user. The format used is YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: dateOut
columns.description: This column stores the time stamp when the encounter from the encounterid column is marked as done. The format used is: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: notesDoneTime
columns.description: This column is to store time when the encounter from the encounterid column is marked as done. The format used is: HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: notesLoginid
columns.description: This column stores an id of the logged in user who documents the encounter. This column refers the UID column from the user table.

columns.name: notesLogOutid
columns.description: This column stores an id of the provider who marks the encounter from the encounterid column as done. This column refers to the column UID from the user table.

columns.name: visittypeid
columns.description: This column stores an id of the selected visit type while creating an appointment. This column refers to the column codeid from the visitcodes table.

columns.name: UTCStartTime
columns.description: This column stores the start time in UTC format. This column is not used anymore.

columns.name: UTCEndTime
columns.description: This column stores end time in UTC format. This column is not used anymore.

columns.name: visitstscodeid
columns.description: This column stores the visit status code id of the appointment. This column refers to the column codeid from the visitstscodes table.

columns.name: practiceid
columns.description: This column stores the practice id for the created apppointment. This column refers to the column id from the practice table.

columns.name: immnotessendstatus
columns.description: This column stores flags 0 or 1. A "1" means when the HL7 outbound message is sent, and a "0" means otherwise.

columns.name: transitionofcare
columns.description: This column stores flags 1, 2, or 0 indicating whether or not transition of care data was received. A "1" means the electronic summary of care record was not received, a "2" means the electronic summary of care record was received, and a "0" means otherwise.

columns.name: prNotesSendStatus
columns.description: This column stores flags 0, 1, 2, 5, 6, 7, and 8 which indicate the sent status of outbound Progress Notes of a patient to a vendor. A �0� means when they were not transmitted, a �1� means the transmission was successful, a �2� means the transmission failed, a �5� means a transmission is in progress, a �6� means it needs to be retransmitted, a �7� means the Progress Note XML is not available, and an �8� means the Progress Notes are part of a PSAC group.

columns.name: readytobill
columns.description: This column stores flags 0 or 1. A "1" means when the encounter is ready to be sent to EMR SPOLE to CBO HUB, and a "0" means otheriwse.

columns.name: reviewbeforebill
columns.description: This column stores flags 0 or 1. A "1" means if CBO is supposed to review a spoke encounter before creating claim, and a "0" means otherwise.

columns.name: EncEligibilityStatus4
columns.description: This column stores one of the below flags when eligibility for other insurances is checked at the encounter level. Flags include: E = Eligible V = Not Verified, N = InEligible

columns.name: EligibilityMessage4
columns.description: This column stores messages received from the insurance company for the eligibility request sent for any other insurance (vision, dental).

columns.name: gUID
columns.description: This is a unique row identifier and the data is not used by the system.

columns.name: afterCareStatus
columns.description: This column stores the status code for the encounter which is marked for after care. This column refers column code in aftercarestatuscodes table.

columns.name: callbackHistory
columns.description: This column stores the documented call back history notes to a specific sub status of the after care encounter.

columns.name: waittime_minutes
columns.description: This column stores the estimated wait time in minutes for a patient in the waiting room.

columns.name: medicalmodifieddate
columns.description: This column stores the time stamp when medical history is last modified in the encounter of the patient. The format used is YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: surgicalmodifieddate
columns.description: This column stores the time stamp when surgical history is last modified in the encounter of the patient. The format used is YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: hospmodifieddate
columns.description: This column stores the time stamp when hospitalization data is last modified in the encounter of the patient. The format used is YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: familymodifieddate
columns.description: This column stores the time stamp when family history is last modified in the encounter of the patient. The format used is YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: socialmodifieddate
columns.description: This column stores the time stamp when social history is last modified in the encounter of the patient. The format used is YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: allergymodifieddate
columns.description: This column stores the time stamp when an allergy is last modified in the encounter of the patient. The format used is YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: supproviderid
columns.description: This column stores the supervising provider assigned to the appointment. Refers to the UID column of the user table.

columns.name: aftercareSubStatus
columns.description: This column stores the sub status code for the encounter which is marked for after care. This column refers to the column code in the aftercaresubstatuscodes table.

columns.name: ApptStatusReasonRequired
columns.description: This column stores the reason documented by the end user on change of the appointment status in corrections module.

columns.name: implantmodifieddate
columns.description: This column stores the current time stamp when an implant is modified in the encounter of the patient. The format used is YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: dentalmodifieddate
columns.description: This column stores the current time stamp when dental history is modified in the encounter of the patient. The format used is: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: ocularhistmodifieddt
columns.description: This varchar value represents the date when the ocular history was last modified. Format is: yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss

columns.name: ocularsurgmodifieddt

columns.name: chieficds

columns.name: historyicds

columns.name: AsmtNotesHeader

columns.name: NextApptReason

columns.name: FollowUpNA

columns.name: LockOrDoneDate

columns.name: SocialHistoryFlag

columns.name: FamilyHistoryFlag

columns.name: doneBy
columns.description: This column is not being used.

columns.name: doneDate
columns.description: This column is not being used.

columns.name: ImmunizationsVerified
columns.description: This column stores values Y or N to indicate the provider verified the patient�s immunization records. A "Y" means  verified and an "N"  means records are not yet verified.

columns.name: medreconciliationinternalflag
columns.description: This column stores flags Y or N to indicate whether medication reconciliation has been performed or not. A �Y� means medication reconciliation was performed, and an �N� means medication reconciliation was not performed.

columns.name: historyicdids
columns.description: This column stores item id for a  diagnosis added by a provider or staff as part of a patient's medical history. This column refers to the itemid column in the items table.

columns.name: mddatelastseen
columns.description: This column stores the date when the podiatric patient was last seen. This information is documented by a provider or staff on the Additional Billing Data window from the Billing window on the Progress Notes. The date format is: 'YYYY-MM-DD 00:00:00.000'.

columns.name: cancellationReason
columns.description: This column stores the free text reason documented by a staff member for the cancellation of an appointment.

columns.name: transportationRequired

columns.name: transportationStatus

columns.name: occHealthType

A "0" means it is not an occupational health appointment, a �1� means the appointment is an occupational health appointment. This flag is used by the Occupational Health module of eCW.

columns.name: NoReportedMedHx

A �Y� means the patient denies past medical history, a �N� means the past medical history of the patient is documented. This option is only used when item key: showDeniesPastMedicalHxOption is enabled.

columns.name: NKDAFlag
columns.description: This column stores values Y or N to indicate no known drug allergies (N.K.D.A) in the allergies/intolerance. A "Y" means there here are no known drug allergies, and an "N" means allergies have been documented.

columns.name: trackingBoardNotes_status
columns.description: This column denotes notes status for each respective encounter. Possible values for this column are 0, 1, 2. Default is "0" which indicates that there are no notes for encounter. A "1" indicates there are notes which exist but one or many notes are not acknowledged. A "2" indicates all notes are acknowledged.

columns.name: InitialTreatmentDate
columns.description: This column stores the date when a patient received treatment for the first time which is used for billing purposes.

columns.name: ImplantsFlag
columns.description: This column stores values Y or N to indicate if information related to implants has been verified with the patient or not. A �Y� means implant related information is verified, and an �N� means implant related information is not verified.

columns.name: InvRespPartyid
columns.description: This column stores the id of a guarantor for an encounter. When overwriting a guarantor at the encounter or claim level this id takes precedence over the valueset in the patients table. This column refers to the UID in the user table.

columns.name: InvRespPartyRelid
columns.description: This column stores the id for a relationship of a guarantor mentioned in InvRespPartyid with the patient whose encounter is being recorded.

columns.name: InvIsGrPt
columns.description: This column stores values 0 or 1 to indicate whether the guarantor mentioned in InvRespPartyid column is also a registered patient with the practice or not. A "0" means that they are a registered patient, and a "1" means they are not a patient.

columns.name: PLVerifiedBy
columns.description: This column stores the id of the user who marked the patient's problem list as verified. This column refers to the UID column in the user table.

columns.name: PLVerified
columns.description: This column stores values 0 or 1 to indicate whether the Problem List of the patient has been verified or not. A "0"  means the problem list is not verified, and a "1" means the Problem List is verified by user.

columns.name: PLVerifiedOn
columns.description: This column stores the date and time when the problem list was marked as verified by the end user. Date and time is stored in: 'YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss' format.

columns.name: behavioralHistoryVerified
columns.description: Not Available.

table_description: This table stores the patient's examination data for an encounter.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This is auto-incremented and Primary Key of This column .

columns.name: Encounterid
columns.description: This column stores id of the encounter for which Examination section is documented. This column refers column encounterid from enc table.

columns.name: Examid
columns.description: This column stores id of the Category selected while documenting Examination section of the patient. This column refers to column itemid from items table.

columns.name: Propid
columns.description: This column stores id of the Field selected in the user interfacewhile documenting Examination section of the patient. This column refers to column propid from properties table.

columns.name: PropDetailid
columns.description: This column stores property detail id and not actively used hence it is always assigned default value 0.

columns.name: Selection
columns.description: This column is not used anymore.

columns.name: Notes
columns.description: This column stores Notes documented in the Examination section of the Patient. This could be selected structured question along with answer or free text entered by the end user.

columns.name: createDate
columns.description: This column stores date when the exam was added. The format used is YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. This column is not actively used.

columns.name: displayseq
columns.description: This column stores sequence of the items to be displayed.

columns.name: notes2
columns.description: This column stores the same value as in Notes column but along with the HTML tags i.e. in HTML format.

columns.name: displaycatseq
columns.description: This column stores sequence number of the documented categories to be displayed in the Progress Note. The sequence starts from 0.

columns.name: drawingnotes
columns.description: This column stores additional notes documented on the attached drawing.

table_description: This table stores notes related to encrypted points, along with information about the user who created the note and the time it was created.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This is the primary key for the table and is an integer that uniquely identifies each record. It is an auto-incrementing value. Example: 1, 2, 3, etc.

columns.name: Encid
columns.description: This is a foreign key that refers to the encrypted points table (not provided in the query) and is an integer representing the id of the encrypted point to which the note is related. Example: 1, 5, 10, etc.

columns.name: NotesTime
columns.description: This is a datetime column that stores the date and time when the note was created. Example: 2021-09-15 14:30:00, 2021-09-16 09:45:00, etc.

columns.name: Notes
columns.description: This is a text column that stores the content of the note. Example: This is a sample note, Another note about the encrypted point, etc.

columns.name: Notesid
columns.description: This is an integer column that represents the id of the note. It has a default value of 1. Example: 1, 2, 3, etc.

columns.name: deleteflag
columns.description: This is an integer column that indicates whether the note has been deleted or not. A value of 0 means the note is not deleted, and a value of 1 means the note is deleted. The default value is 0. Example: 0, 1.

columns.name: userid
columns.description: This is a foreign key that refers to the user table (not provided in the query) and is an integer representing the id of the user who created the note. The default value is 0. Example: 1, 3, 5, etc.

table_description: This table stores the outcome scores for different encounters, along with their associated community and local IDs, values, and publication status.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This is an auto incremented primary key of the table.

columns.name: encounterid
columns.description: This column stores the encounter id for which scores are received. This column refers to the the encounter id from the enc table.

columns.name: outcomecommunityid
columns.description: This column stores the community id of the questionnaire form which is the primary key (ecwPropid column) of ecwproperties table.

columns.name: scorecommunityid
columns.description: This column stores the community id of the results and scores of the questionnaire form, which references the ecwStructid column of the ecwstructoptions table.

columns.name: VALUE
columns.description: This column stores the value of the result score and option.

columns.name: ispublished
columns.description: This column stores the status of the result score and option. A 0 means not published,  and a 1  means published.

columns.name: optioncommunityid
columns.description: This column stores the community id of the result option of the questionnaire form which is the primary key (ecwOptionid column) of the ecwstructoptions table.

columns.name: outcomelocalid
columns.description: This column stores the local id of the questionnaire form which references the propid column of the ecwpropertiesmapper table.

columns.name: scorelocalid
columns.description: This column stores the community id of the results and scores of the questionnaire form, which references the structid column of the ecwstructmapper table.

columns.name: optionlocalid
columns.description: This column stores the community id of the result option of the questionnaire form which references the optionid column of the ecwstructoptionsmapper table.

table_description: This table stores information about tax IDs associated with different encounters.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier for each record in the enctaxids table. Example: 1, 2, 3.

columns.name: enccounterid
columns.description: The identifier for the encounter associated with the tax ID. This is a foreign key that refers to the `id` column in the `encounters` table. Example: 101, 102, 103.

columns.name: taxid
columns.description: The tax ID value. Example: "123-45-6789", "987-65-4321".

columns.name: taxidtype
columns.description: The type of tax ID. Example: "SSN", "EIN".

columns.name: deleteflag
columns.description: A flag indicating whether the record is deleted or not. A value of 0 means the record is not deleted, and a value of 1 means the record is deleted. Example: 0, 1.

columns.name: modifieddate
columns.description: The date and time when the record was last modified. Example: "2021-09-15 10:30:00", "2021-09-16 14:45:00".

columns.name: enctype
columns.description: The type of encounter associated with the tax ID. Example: 1, 2, 3.

table_description: This table stores the information on enterprise units, which is used to form enterprise hierarchy, such as organization unit, facility or practice. Users are assigned access to certain levels of enterprise hierarchy based on their role.

columns.name: id
columns.description: The column stores an id of the enterprise directory. This column is an auto incremented primary key.

columns.name: Orgid
columns.description: This column is generally a practice id or facility id. It holds the int value.

columns.name: Parentid
columns.description: This column represents the parent of any node present in the Enterprise Directory Hierarchy. It refers to the enterprisedirectory id.

columns.name: OrgName
columns.description: This column stores the name Org Unit while creating Org Unit/building enterprise hierarchy. It  holds the varchar values.

columns.name: OrgDesc
columns.description: This column stores the name Org Unit Description while creating Org Unit building enterprise hierarchy. It holds the text values.

columns.name: OrgType
columns.description: This column stores the name Org Type while creating Org Type. Fix Org types are 'Root', 'OU', Practice' and 'Facility' for root, UnAssigned, Practice and Facility Org Unit respectively.  It holds varchar values. The default value is OU which represents the unassigned org unit.

columns.name: DeleteFlag
columns.description: It represents that the value is deleted or not. It holds the tinyint value of 1 or 0. A value of 1 means the entry is deleted. The default value is 0.

columns.name: modifiedDate
columns.description: This column stores the time stamp on value inset/update operation.

table_description: This table stores the cancellation reasons for a specific vendor along with their respective codes.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier for each cancellation reason entry. It is a small integer with a maximum value of 65535 and is auto-incremented. Example: 1, 2, 3, etc.

columns.name: reason_code
columns.description: A short code representing the cancellation reason. It is a string with a maximum length of 10 characters. Example: "RC001", "RC002", "RC003", etc.

columns.name: reason_name
columns.description: A detailed description of the cancellation reason. It is a string with a maximum length of 500 characters. Example: "Customer requested cancellation", "Product out of stock", "Shipping delay", etc.

columns.name: vendor_id
columns.description: Identifier for the vendor associated with the cancellation reason. It is a tiny integer with a maximum value of 255 and a default value of 0. Example: 1, 2, 3, etc. This column can be a foreign key referring to the `id` column in a `vendors` table.

columns.name: delete_flag
columns.description: A flag indicating whether the cancellation reason entry has been deleted or not. It is a tiny integer with a value of either 0 (not deleted) or 1 (deleted). Default value is 0. Example: 0, 1.

table_description: This table stores the close reasons for EPA (Electronic Prior Authorization) cases, along with their associated reason codes, descriptions, vendor IDs, and deletion flags.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This is the primary key and an auto-incrementing tinyint(4) column, which uniquely identifies each close reason record in the table. Example: 1, 2, 3, etc.

columns.name: reason_code
columns.description: This is a varchar(10) column that stores the unique reason code for each close reason. Example: "RC001", "RC002", "RC003", etc.

columns.name: reason_description
columns.description: This is a varchar(500) column that stores a detailed description of the close reason. Example: "Case resolved successfully", "Case closed due to lack of evidence", "Case transferred to another department", etc.

columns.name: vendor_id
columns.description: This is a tinyint(4) column that stores the ID of the vendor associated with the close reason. This could potentially be a foreign key referring to a `vendor` table's primary key (e.g., `vendor.id`). Example: 1, 2, 3, etc.

columns.name: delete_flag
columns.description: This is a tinyint(4) column with a default value of '0', which indicates whether the close reason record has been deleted (1) or not (0). Example: 0 (not deleted), 1 (deleted).

table_description: This table stores the mapping between EPA transactions and their corresponding reason codes, along with a delete flag to indicate if the mapping is active or deleted.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This is the primary key for the table, an auto-incrementing integer that uniquely identifies each record in the table. Example: 1, 2, 3, etc.

columns.name: epa_transaction_id
columns.description: This is a foreign key that refers to the `id` column in the `epa_transaction` table. It represents the ID of the EPA transaction associated with the reason code. Example: 101, 102, 103, etc.

columns.name: reason_code
columns.description: This is a varchar column that stores the reason code associated with the EPA transaction. Example: 'RC001', 'RC002', 'RC003', etc.

columns.name: delete_flag
columns.description: This is a tinyint column that indicates whether the mapping record is active or deleted. A value of '0' means the record is active, while a value of '1' means the record is deleted. Example: 0, 1

table_description: This table stores information about questionnaires related to EPA transactions, including their content, status, and deadlines.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier for each questionnaire (e.g., 1, 2, 3).

columns.name: epa_transaction_id
columns.description: Identifier for the related EPA transaction; foreign key relation to `epa_transaction` table's `id` column.

columns.name: epa_case_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the EPA case (e.g., "EPA12345").

columns.name: pa_reference_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the PA reference (e.g., "PA12345").

columns.name: epa_message_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the EPA message (e.g., "MSG12345").

columns.name: question_set_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the question set (e.g., "QS12345").

columns.name: question_set_no
columns.description: Number representing the order of the question set (e.g., 1, 2, 3).

columns.name: question_set_title
columns.description: Title of the question set (e.g., "Environmental Impact Assessment").

columns.name: question_set_desc
columns.description: Description of the question set (e.g., "This question set covers the environmental impact assessment of the project.").

columns.name: content
columns.description: Content of the questionnaire in medium text format.

columns.name: deadline_for_reply
columns.description: Deadline for replying to the questionnaire in datetime format (e.g., "2022-12-31 23:59:59").

columns.name: questionnaire_status
columns.description: Status of the questionnaire (e.g., "Pending", "Completed", "Expired").

columns.name: created_by
columns.description: Identifier for the user who created the questionnaire; foreign key relation to `users` table's `uid` column.

columns.name: created_datetime
columns.description: Datetime when the questionnaire was created (e.g., "2022-01-01 12:34:56").

columns.name: updated_by
columns.description: Identifier for the user who last updated the questionnaire; foreign key relation to `users` table's `uid` column.

columns.name: updated_datetime
columns.description: Datetime when the questionnaire was last updated (e.g., "2022-01-02 12:34:56").

columns.name: pa_note
columns.description: Notes from the PA regarding the questionnaire (e.g., "Please provide additional information on the environmental impact.").

columns.name: is_active
columns.description: Flag indicating if the questionnaire is active (1) or not (0).

columns.name: delete_flag
columns.description: Flag indicating if the questionnaire is deleted (1) or not (0).

table_description: This table stores detailed information about medications ordered through EPA, including medicine details, prescribing doctor, patient, and pharmacy information.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier for each record in the table (e.g., 1, 2, 3).

columns.name: item_id
columns.description: Identifier for the medicine item, foreign key relation to `items` table (`itemID` column).

columns.name: medicine_name
columns.description: Name of the prescribed medicine (e.g., "Ibuprofen", "Amoxicillin").

columns.name: ncpdpid
columns.description: National Council for Prescription Drug Programs ID, a unique identifier for pharmacies (e.g., "1234567").

columns.name: encounter_id
columns.description: Identifier for the patient encounter, foreign key relation to `enc` table (`encounterID` column).

columns.name: doctor_id
columns.description: Identifier for the prescribing doctor, foreign key relation to `doctors` table (`doctorID` column).

columns.name: patient_id
columns.description: Identifier for the patient, foreign key relation to `patients` table (`pid` column).

columns.name: facility_id
columns.description: Identifier for the facility where the prescription was made, foreign key relation to `edi_facilities` table (`Id` column).

columns.name: refill
columns.description: Number of refills allowed for the prescription (e.g., 0, 1, 2).

columns.name: assess_id
columns.description: Assessment identifier, used for internal purposes (e.g., 123, 456, 789).

columns.name: ndc_code
columns.description: National Drug Code, a unique identifier for the prescribed drug (e.g., "12345-6789-01").

columns.name: rx_order_no
columns.description: Prescription order number (e.g., "RX123456").

columns.name: strength
columns.description: Strength of the prescribed medicine (e.g., "200 mg", "500 mg").

columns.name: formulation
columns.description: Formulation of the prescribed medicine (e.g., "tablet", "capsule").

columns.name: take
columns.description: Instructions on how to take the medicine (e.g., "Take 1 tablet every 6 hours").

columns.name: route
columns.description: Route of administration for the medicine (e.g., "oral", "intravenous").

columns.name: frequency
columns.description: Frequency of taking the medicine (e.g., "every 6 hours", "twice daily").

columns.name: duration
columns.description: Duration of the treatment (e.g., "7 days", "2 weeks").

columns.name: dispense
columns.description: Quantity of medicine to be dispensed (e.g., "30 tablets", "10 capsules").

columns.name: epa_context
columns.description: Context of the electronic prescription authorization (e.g., "new", "refill").

columns.name: assign_to_id
columns.description: Identifier for the person assigned to process the prescription (e.g., 123, 456, 789).

columns.name: ss_encounter_id
columns.description: Identifier for the encounter in a secondary system, used for internal purposes (e.g., 123, 456, 789).

columns.name: old_rx_id
columns.description: Identifier for the previous prescription, if any (e.g., 123, 456, 789).

columns.name: epa_transaction_id
columns.description: Identifier for the electronic prescription authorization transaction, foreign key relation to `epa_transaction` table (`id` column).

columns.name: daw_flag
columns.description: Dispense as written flag, 1 if the prescription must be dispensed as written, 0 otherwise (e.g., 0, 1).

columns.name: delete_flag
columns.description: Flag indicating if the record has been deleted, 1 if deleted, 0 otherwise (e.g., 0, 1).

columns.name: addInstructions
columns.description: Additional instructions for the prescription (e.g., "Take with food", "Do not crush").

columns.name: rx_notes
columns.description: Notes related to the prescription (e.g., "Patient allergic to penicillin", "Monitor blood pressure").

columns.name: rx_additional_notes
columns.description: Additional notes related to the prescription (e.g., "Patient prefers brand name", "Dispense in child-resistant container").

columns.name: pharmacy_id
columns.description: Identifier for the pharmacy, foreign key relation to `pharmacy` table (`pmcid` column).

columns.name: rx_source
columns.description: Source of the prescription (e.g., "EHR", "Paper").

columns.name: rx_source_id
columns.description: Identifier for the prescription source, used for internal purposes (e.g., 123, 456, 789).

columns.name: start_date
columns.description: Start date of the prescription (e.g., "2021-01-01").

columns.name: stop_date
columns.description: Stop date of the prescription (e.g., "2021-01-08").

table_description: This table stores information about electronic prior authorization (EPA) transactions, including their status, type, and related details.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier for each EPA transaction (integer). Example: 1, 2, 3.

columns.name: pa_reference_id
columns.description: Unique reference ID for the prior authorization (string). Example: "PA12345", "PA67890".

columns.name: txn_type
columns.description: Type of the transaction (string). Example: "New", "Renewal", "Cancel".

columns.name: txn_status
columns.description: Status of the transaction (string). Example: "Pending", "Approved", "Denied".

columns.name: grid_status
columns.description: Status of the transaction in the grid view (string, NULLable). Example: "Active", "Inactive", NULL.

columns.name: pn_note
columns.description: Note related to the prior authorization (string, NULLable, up to 2000 characters). Example: "Patient needs this medication due to...", NULL.

columns.name: case_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the case associated with the transaction (string, NULLable). Example: "CASE123", "CASE456", NULL.

columns.name: authorization_number
columns.description: Unique authorization number for the transaction (string, NULLable, up to 140 characters). Example: "AUTH12345", "AUTH67890", NULL.

columns.name: effective_date
columns.description: Date when the transaction becomes effective (date, NULLable). Example: "2022-01-01", "2022-02-01", NULL.

columns.name: expiration_date
columns.description: Date when the transaction expires (date, NULLable). Example: "2022-12-31", "2023-01-31", NULL.

columns.name: appeal_available
columns.description: Indicates if an appeal is available for the transaction (string, NULLable). Example: "Yes", "No", NULL.

columns.name: appeal_expiration_date
columns.description: Date when the appeal option expires (date, NULLable). Example: "2022-03-01", "2022-04-01", NULL.

columns.name: cancel_reason_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the cancellation reason (small integer, NULLable). Example: 1, 2, 3, NULL.

columns.name: cancel_note
columns.description: Note related to the cancellation (string, NULLable, up to 200 characters). Example: "Patient no longer needs medication", NULL.

columns.name: erx_request_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the e-prescription request associated with the transaction (integer, NULLable). Example: 1001, 1002, 1003, NULL.

columns.name: payor_attachment
columns.description: Binary data for the payor attachment (varbinary, NULLable, up to 8000 bytes). Example: BLOB data, NULL.

columns.name: created_by
columns.description: Unique identifier for the user who created the transaction (integer). Foreign key relation to `users` table, `uid` column. Example: 101, 102, 103.

columns.name: created_datetime
columns.description: Date and time when the transaction was created (datetime, NULLable). Example: "2022-01-01 12:34:56", "2022-02-01 10:30:00", NULL.

columns.name: updated_by
columns.description: Unique identifier for the user who last updated the transaction (integer). Foreign key relation to `users` table, `uid` column. Example: 101, 102, 103.

columns.name: updated_datetime
columns.description: Date and time when the transaction was last updated (datetime, NULLable). Example: "2022-01-02 14:30:00", "2022-02-02 16:45:00", NULL.

columns.name: scheduler_flag
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the transaction is scheduled (tiny integer, default '0'). Example: 0 (not scheduled), 1 (scheduled).

columns.name: delete_flag
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the transaction is deleted (tiny integer, default '0'). Example: 0 (not deleted), 1 (deleted).

columns.name: auth_update_datetime
columns.description: Date and time when the authorization was last updated (datetime, NULLable). Example: "2022-01-03 09:00:00", "2022-02-03 11:15:00", NULL.

table_description: This table stores information about token information for COF data and cards masked information by patients in a healthcare facility.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier for each record in the table.

columns.name: patientid
columns.description: identifier for the patient associated with the card, refers to the `pid` column in the `patients` table.

columns.name: facilityid
columns.description: identifier for the facility where the card is used, refers to the `id` column in the `edi_facilities` table.

columns.name: cardnumber
columns.description: This column stores the first digit and last 4 digits of the card number. Example 4xxxxxxxxxxx1234

columns.name: nameoncard
columns.description: The name of the cardholder as it appears on the card (e.g., John Doe).

columns.name: expmonth
columns.description: The expiration month of the card (e.g., 12 for December).

columns.name: expyear
columns.description: The expiration year of the card (e.g., 2025).

columns.name: address
columns.description: The billing address associated with the card (e.g., 123 Main St).

columns.name: zipcode
columns.description: The billing zip code associated with the card (e.g., 12345).

columns.name: recurringid
columns.description: identifier for recurring payments associated with the card.

columns.name: updateduser
columns.description: identifier for the user who last updated the record, refers to the `id` column in the `users` table.

columns.name: datecreated
columns.description: The date and time when the record was created (e.g., 2021-01-01 12:34:56).

columns.name: primecard
columns.description: Indicates if the card is the primary card for the patient (e.g., 'yes' or 'no').

columns.name: verify
columns.description: Verification status of the card (e.g., 'yes' or 'no').

columns.name: referenceid
columns.description: Reference identifier for the card, used for external systems.

columns.name: maxamount
columns.description: The maximum amount that can be charged to the card (e.g., 500.00).

columns.name: maxdate
columns.description: The maximum date until which the card can be charged (e.g., 2023-12-31).

columns.name: isdeleted
