columns.description: Stores ICD description which is mainly from items table's itemName column.

columns.name: snomedCode
columns.description: Stores SNOMED code.

columns.name: custom_name
columns.description: Stores customized names for ICD which can be used to display instead of ICD description.

columns.name: displayindex
columns.description:
stores the sequence number of the customized ICD when it is added.
Based on which list of ICD can be displayed.

columns.name: showcustom_name
columns.description: Used to mark whether customized should be displayed or not. Valid values are 0 and 1. 0 means not display and 1 means display customized name.

columns.name: snomeddesc
columns.description: Stores SNOMED description.

table_description: This table stores information related to family planning visits for patients in New York, including demographic, medical, and insurance details.

columns.name: id
columns.description: The unique identifier for each record in the table (e.g., 1, 2, 3).

columns.name: Encid
columns.description: The unique identifier for each patient encounter (e.g., 101, 102, 103).

columns.name: Patientid
columns.description: The unique identifier for each patient (e.g., 1001, 1002, 1003).

columns.name: ClinicNo
columns.description: The clinic number where the visit took place (e.g., C001, C002, and C003).

columns.name: ClientNo
columns.description: The unique identifier for the client (e.g., CL001, CL002, and CL003).

columns.name: DateOfVisit
columns.description: The date of the patient's visit (e.g., 2021-01-01, 2021-01-02, 2021-01-03).

columns.name: PurposeOfVisit
columns.description: This column stores information about purpose of visit. Possible values for this column are : 1-Initial Medical Exam, 2-Annual Medical Exam, 3-Method Check/Maintenance, 4-Counseling, 5-Pregnancy Test, 6-Medical Problem/Follow-up

columns.name: DOB
columns.description: The date of birth of the patient (e.g., 1990-01-01, 1990-01-02, 1990-01-03).

columns.name: MedSvcPrvded
columns.description: This column is used to represent Medical services provided during the visit. List of possible values is large, hence omitted. Some of them are 31-Hgb / Hct, 02-Pap Smear, 10-Bimanual Pelvic, 12-Male Exam, 32-Urine Dipstick  etc

columns.name: ProviderMedSvc
columns.description: This column is used to represent Provider code for the Medical services provided. Possible values are 1 - Physician, 3 - Other Clinician, 2 - PA / NP / CNM , 4 - Non-Clinician

columns.name: CounsSvcPrvded
columns.description: This column is used to represent Counseling services provided during the visit. List of Possible values is large. Some of them are 01-Contraceptive, 03-Infertility, 05-Pregnancy, 09-STD, 10-Preconception etc

columns.name: ProviderCounsSvc
columns.description: This column is used to represent Provider code for the counseling services provided. Possible values are 1 - Physician, 3 - Other Clinician, 2 - PA / NP / CNM , 4 - Non-Clinician

columns.name: BegnContrMethd
columns.description: This column is used to represent Beginning contraceptive method used by the patient. List of possible values is large, hence omitted. Some of them are 21 - Oral - Extend. Cycle, 04 - Diaphragm, 06 - Spermicide, 15 - Female Condom, 01. Sterilization etc

columns.name: EndContrMethd
columns.description: This column is used to represent Ending contraceptive method used by the patient. List of possible values are large, hence omitted here. Some of them are 02 - Oral, 18 - Vaginal Ring, 19 - Sponge, 20 - Abstinence, 14 - Hormonal Inj. - 3 mo etc

columns.name: RsnNoContraMethd
columns.description: This column is used to represent reason code for not using contraceptive method on patient. Possible values are 1 - Pregnancy, 2 - Infertility, 3 - Seeking Pregnancy, 4 - Other Medical Reasons, 5 - Relying on Female Method, 6 - Other, 7 - Not Sexually Active, 0 - Same Sex Partner, 8 - Vasectomy, 9 - Condom

columns.name: PregTest
columns.description: This column is used to represent Pregnancy test result. 1 means Negative and 2 means Positive.

columns.name: IfPregTestPostv
columns.description: This column is used to represent whether pregnancy was desired or not. Possible values in this column are 1 - Desired Now, 4- Not Desired, 2 - Desired Sooner , 3 - Desired Later

columns.name: ReffrdElsewhere
columns.description: This column is used to represent if  the patient is refferred somewhere else. This column holds reason for which patient is referred somewhere else.  Possible values are 1 - Pregnancy, 2 - Sterilizatio, 3 - Infertility, 4 - Medical Problem/Follow-up, 5 - CBE F/U, 6 - Primary Care

columns.name: IntprtrNeeded
columns.description: This column is used to represent whether the bilinugal interpreter or stafff is required. Value 1 means it is required and 2 means it is not required.

columns.name: STDSvc
columns.description: This column is used to represent different STD test and treatment performed on Patient. Possible values are 01 - Gonorrhea Test, 03 - Syphilis Test, 05 - Herpes Diagnosis, 07 - HPV Diagnosis, 09- Chlamydia Test, 02 - Gonorrhea Treatment, 04 - Syphilis Treatment, 06 - Herpes Treatment, 08 - HPV Treatment, 10-Chlamydia Treatment

columns.name: Race
columns.description: This column is used to represent patient's race. Possible values are 1-White, 2-Black / Afr American, 3-American Indian, 4-Alaskan Native, 5-Asian, 7-Pacific Islanders/Hawaaiian Native, 6-Other

columns.name: InsCovrg
columns.description: This column is used to represent whether the Primary care is covered for private insurance. Value 1 means Yes and 2 mean No.

columns.name: HIVPreTestCoun
columns.description: This column is used to represent HIV pre test counselling. Value 1 means Yes and 2 means No.

columns.name: HIVTest
columns.description: This column is used to represent whether the HIV Test was performed or not. Value 1 means HIV test was performed and 2 means HIV test was not performed.

columns.name: HIVTestResult
columns.description: This column is used to represent HIV test result. Value 1 means Positive and 2 means Negative or Inconclusive.

columns.name: HIVPostTestCoun
columns.description: This column is used to represent HIV post test counselling. Value 1 means Yes and 2 means No.

columns.name: NoTimesPreg
columns.description: The number of times the patient has been pregnant, up to 5 characters (e.g., 0, 1, and 2).

columns.name: NoTimesBirth
columns.description: The number of times the patient has given birth, up to 5 characters (e.g., 0, 1, and 2).

columns.name: MonFamilyIncome
columns.description: The monthly family income, up to 20 characters (e.g., $2000, $3000, $4000).

columns.name: FamilyDependts
columns.description: The number of family dependents, up to 5 characters (e.g., 1, 2, 3).

columns.name: ZipCode
columns.description: The patient's ZIP Code, up to 10 characters (e.g., 10001, 10002, 10003, etc.).

columns.name: Ethnicity
columns.description: This column is used to represent ethnicity of patient. Value 1 means Hispanic and 2 means Other.

columns.name: Sex
columns.description: This column is used to represent gender of patient. Value 1 means Female and 2 means Male.

columns.name: HighestGrade
columns.description: The highest grade completed by the patient, up to 50 characters (e.g., High school, College, Graduate school, etc.).

columns.name: StudStatus
columns.description: This column is used to represent student status of patient. Possible values are 1-Full Time Student, 2-Part Time Student, 3- Not a Student

columns.name: County
columns.description: The patient's county of residence, up to 10 characters (e.g., Albany, Bronx, Kings, etc.).

columns.name: OtherHealthCareSrcs
columns.description: This column is used to represent whether the other healthcare sources are used by patient. Possible value 1- Yes, 2 - No

columns.name: MedcadNo
columns.description: The Medicaid number for the patient, up to 20 characters (e.g., M123456, M123457, M123458, etc.).

columns.name: InsPaidAmt
columns.description: By Default this coulmn does not have any value. It only stores blank value.

columns.name: OtherIns
columns.description: By Default this coulmn does not have any value. It only stores blank value.

columns.name: LastPGEndMonth
columns.description: The last pregnancy end month, up to 10 characters (e.g., January, February, and March).

columns.name: LastPGEndYear
columns.description: The last pregnancy end year, up to 10 characters (e.g., 2019, 2020, 2021, etc.).

columns.name: AssignedChargeCat
columns.description: This column stores the data about assigned charge category. For example 01 - No Charge, 05 - Full Fee (100% of Scale), 02 - Title XIX, 04 - Private Insurance etc

columns.name: IsPrimaryCovered
columns.description: This column stores data about coverage of primary care in case of private insurance. Value 1 means primary care is covered and Value 2 means otherwise.

columns.name: PmtSrc
columns.description: By Default this coulmn does not have any value. It only stores blank value.

columns.name: PregLastDate
columns.description: The last date of the pregnancy, up to 10 characters (e.g., 2021-01-01, 2021-01-02, 2021-01-03, etc.).

columns.name: deleteFlag
columns.description: The flag to indicate if the record is deleted, represented by an integer (e.g., 0 for not deleted, 1 for deleted).

columns.name: livingchildren
columns.description: The number of living children, up to 5 characters (e.g., 0, 1, and 2).

columns.name: ssn
columns.description: The patient's Social Security number, up to 10 characters (e.g., 123-45-6789, 987-65-4321, etc.).

columns.name: primarylanguage
columns.description: The patient's primary language, up to 10 characters (e.g., English, Spanish, Chinese).

columns.name: patientname
columns.description: The patient's full name, up to 100 characters in length (e.g., John Doe, Jane Smith, Maria Garcia, etc.).

table_description: This table stores information about outgoing faxes, including details about the sender, recipient, fax content, and status.

columns.name: LogID
columns.description: The column stores an id of the outgoing faxes. This is an auto incremental primary key of This column .

columns.name: LoginID
columns.description: The column stores an id of the logged in user who has sent the fax. This column refers to the uid column in user table. This can not have NULL value.

columns.name: DoctorID
columns.description: This column stores the ID of the provider that had auto-populated or updated in From Provider column Fax preview window. This column refers to the uid column in user table.

columns.name: PatientID
columns.description: The column stores an id of the patient of which the information is being sent in the fax . This column refers to the uid column in user table.

columns.name: ToID
columns.description:
This column stores the id of the recipient.
e.g. When the fax is sent to provider, it will store the id of the provider. When the fax is sent to pharmacy, it will store the id of the pharmacy selected etc

columns.name: ToName
columns.description: Name of the recipient of the fax. (Example: "John Doe", "Jane Smith")

columns.name: ToFax
columns.description: Fax number of the recipient. (Example: "123-456-7890", "987-654-3210")

columns.name: tocompany
columns.description: Name of the company the recipient belongs to. (Example: "ABC Hospital", "XYZ Clinic")

columns.name: EncounterID
columns.description: Identifier for the patient encounter associated with the fax. (Example: 4001, 4002, 4003)

columns.name: FaxInitTime
columns.description: time stamp when the fax was initiated. (Example: "2022-01-01 12:34:56")

columns.name: Retry
columns.description: Number of retries for sending the fax. (Example: 0, 1, 2)

columns.name: Status
columns.description: This is not being used anymore.

columns.name: faxdata
columns.description: Long text containing the content of the fax. (Example: "Prescription details...", "Lab report...")

columns.name: FaxStatus
columns.description: Enumerated status of the fax (Logged, Completed, Failed, Pending, Query, Received, Sending, Deleted, UserCancelled).

columns.name: SendDate
columns.description: Date and time when the fax was sent. (Example: "2022-01-01 12:45:00")

columns.name: FaxType
columns.description: Enumerated type of fax content (Prescription, ProgressNotes, ConsultNotes, LabReport, LabOrder, TiffDocument, TxtDocument, CustomForms, WebURL).

columns.name: FaxManLogID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the fax manager log entry. (Example: "a1b2c3d4", "e5f6g7h8")

columns.name: FaxPrefix
columns.description: Prefix for the fax number. (Example: "1", "01")

columns.name: FaxFile
columns.description:
FaxFile column is used to store the name of the file being faxed in case of non-HTML faxes.
e.g. 4860-9193-122-b4b844a3-62a1-4aa5-fc22-d9ec1a3afc95.tif
For HTML faxes initially it will be blank. Fax server will update it with the tiff file name after it converts HTML fax into Tiff file.

columns.name: FaxTransaction
columns.description: This is not longer being used.

columns.name: RxIds
columns.description: Column stores name of Rx being filled through Fax.

columns.name: FaxLogStatus
columns.description: This is no longer being used.

columns.name: FaxLogBatch
columns.description: This column is not being used anymore.

columns.name: FacilityID
columns.description: This column stores the id of the facility that was selected in the Facility field while sending the fax. This refers to the id column in edi_facilities table.

columns.name: FacilityName
columns.description: This column stores the name of the facility that was selected in the Facility field while sending the fax. This refers to the name column in edi_facilities table.

columns.name: reminded
columns.description: This is no longer being used.

columns.name: remindedDate
columns.description: This is no longer being used.

columns.name: FaxCoverPage
columns.description: This is no longer being used. This was part of the VB based fax server.

columns.name: FaxCoverPageID
columns.description: This is no longer being used. This was part of the VB based fax server.

columns.name: FaxStatusMsg
columns.description:
This column is used to store provide the more details on the current status of the fax. 
e.g. In case of Fax which is in 'Failed' status it will have value 'Fax [4859] -  Failed'.

columns.name: faxsubject
columns.description: This column is being used to store the subject of the fax. Short description of the content being sent in the Fax which user enters while sending the fax.

columns.name: LoginName
columns.description: Name of the user who initiated the fax. (Example: "Alice", "Bob")

columns.name: scheduledDate
columns.description: This contains future date and time of the fax, when fax is scheduled for future time and not to be sent immediately. For regular Fax, it will have same value as of FaxInitTime column.

columns.name: sentnotification
columns.description: This is no longer being used.

columns.name: OriginalFaxDoc
columns.description: This is no longer being used.

columns.name: FromName
columns.description: This stores the name of the sender that is sending the fax.

columns.name: FromVoice
columns.description: This column stores the Telephone number of the facility thathas auto-populated in the facility field. This will also contain the telephone number that is free-texted in the voice field.

columns.name: fromcompany
columns.description: This column stores the Name of the facility that has auto-populated in the Company field. This will also contain the value that is free-texted in the Company field.

columns.name: FaxInitTime2
columns.description: This is not being used.

columns.name: isMsgSent
columns.description: This is not being used.

columns.name: isTextMsgSent
columns.description: This is not being used.

columns.name: externaldocid
columns.description: This column stores ID of document/fax received from outside of organization for Smart Referral Management feature.

columns.name: isAddressed
columns.description: This columns conveys whether user has marked the outgoing fax as addressed or not. By default value is set to 0 and it updated to 1 when addressed.

columns.name: addressedComment
columns.description: Text containing comments about the addressed fax. (Example: "Reviewed and approved", "Needs further review")

columns.name: OriginalFaxFile
columns.description: This column contains the name of the document which is Faxed in case of non-HTML faxes. In case of HTML faxes it is kept blank.

columns.name: dialInCode
columns.description: Dial-in code for the fax. (Example: 1234, 5678)

columns.name: suffix
columns.description: Suffix for the fax number. (Example: "A", "B")

columns.name: splitFaxesBatchId
columns.description: Identifier for the batch of split faxes. (Example: "SPLIT123", "SPLIT456")

table_description: This table stores information about different types of FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources) applications.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This is an integer column that serves as the primary key for the table. It is an auto-incrementing value that uniquely identifies each record in the table. Example values: 1, 2, 3, etc.

columns.name: appType
columns.description: This is a varchar(100) column that stores the name of the FHIR application type. It has a unique constraint, meaning that each application type can only appear once in the table.

table_description: This table stores the different types of audit actions in an FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources) system.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This is an auto-incrementing integer column that serves as the primary key for the table. It uniquely identifies each audit action type. Example values: 1, 2, 3, etc.

columns.name: actionType
columns.description: This is a varchar(100) column that stores the name of the audit action type. It has a unique constraint, ensuring that each action type is only stored once in the table.

table_description: This table stores information about FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources) resources, which are standardized specifications for exchanging healthcare information electronically.

columns.name: resource_id
columns.description: This is an integer column that serves as the primary key for the table. It uniquely identifies each FHIR resource in the table. Example values could be 1, 2, 3, etc.

columns.name: resource_name
columns.description: This is a varchar(100) column that stores the name of the FHIR resource. It has a unique constraint, meaning that each resource name must be unique within the table. Example values could be "Patient", "Observation", "Condition", etc.

table_description: This table stores information about FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources) sources, including the source link, last retrieval time, and related patient information.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This is the primary key and an auto-incrementing integer that uniquely identifies each record in the table. Example: 1, 2, 3, etc.

columns.name: ecwPid
columns.description: This is an integer column that stores the patient ID from the electronic health record system (EHR). It can be NULL if the patient ID is not available. Example: 101, 102, 103, etc.

columns.name: lastRetrievalTime
columns.description: This is a datetime column that stores the time stamp, when the data from this FHIR source was retrieved. Example: '2021-09-15 10:30:00', '2021-09-16 14:45:00', etc.

columns.name: requestId
columns.description: This is varchar column that stores a unique identifier of the transaction through which the data was fetched from this source. There can be multiple source per transaction.

columns.name: fhirSourceLink
columns.description: This is a varchar(255) column that stores the URL of the FHIR source. Example: 'https://fhir.example.com/patient/123', 'https://fhir.example.com/patient/124', etc.

columns.name: sourcePid
columns.description: This is a varchar(255) column that stores the patient ID from the FHIR source. Example: 'FHIR123', 'FHIR124', 'FHIR125', etc.

columns.name: deleteFlag
columns.description: This is an integer(1) column that stores a flag indicating whether the record has been deleted or not. A value of 0 means the record is not deleted, and a value of 1 means the record is deleted. Example: 0, 1.

table_description: This table stores the audit logs of user actions related to FHIR resources, including the type of action, the resource type, and other relevant information.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier for each audit log entry. Example: 1, 2, 3.

columns.name: resourceType
columns.description: The type of FHIR resource involved in the action. Example: "Patient", "Observation", "Encounter".

columns.name: fhirQuery
columns.description: The FHIR query string used for the action, if applicable. Example: "Patient?_id=123", "Observation?subject=456".

columns.name: patientId
columns.description: The identifier of the patient associated with the action, if applicable. Example: 101, 102, 103.

columns.name: providerId
columns.description: The identifier of the provider associated with the action, if applicable. Example: 201, 202, 203.

columns.name: vendorId
columns.description: The identifier of the vendor associated with the action, if applicable. Example: 301, 302, 303.

columns.name: appTypeId
columns.description: The identifier of the application type associated with the action. Foreign key relation: `fhir_app_type.id`. Example: 401, 402, 403.

columns.name: actionTypeId
columns.description: The identifier of the action type performed. Foreign key relation: `fhir_audit_action_type.id`. Example: 501, 502, 503.

columns.name: dateReceived
columns.description: The date and time when the action was received. Example: '2021-08-01 12:34:56', '2021-08-02 14:56:23'.

columns.name: audit_status
columns.description: A tiny integer representing the status of the audit log entry, if applicable. Example: 0, 1, 2.

table_description: This table stores information about FHIR write-back audit requests, including the request ID, vendor ID, request status, and creation time.

columns.name: id
columns.description: An auto-incrementing integer that serves as the primary key for the table and uniquely identifies each record. Example: 1, 2, 3, etc.

columns.name: request_id
columns.description: A varchar(45) column that stores the unique ID of the audit request. Example: "REQ123", "REQ124", etc.

columns.name: vendor_id
columns.description: A varchar(45) column that stores the ID of the vendor associated with the audit request. This column can be NULL if there is no vendor associated with the request. Example: "VND001", "VND002", etc.

columns.name: request_status
columns.description: A tinyint(4) column that stores the status of the audit request. The default value is '1'. Example: 1 (Pending), 2 (Completed), 3 (Failed), etc.

columns.name: creation_time
columns.description: A datetime column that stores the time stamp when the audit request was created. Example: "2022-01-01 12:34:56", "2022-01-02 14:23:45", etc.

table_description: This table stores the details of audit requests related to FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources) write-back operations.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier for each record in the table. Example: 1, 2, 3.

columns.name: audit_request_id
columns.description: Identifier for the associated audit request. Foreign key relation with `fhir_write_back_audit_request(id)`. Example: 101, 102, 103.

columns.name: patient_id
columns.description: Identifier for the associated patient. Foreign key relation with `users (UID)`. Example: 1001, 1002, 1003. This column can have NULL values.

columns.name: processing_time
columns.description: time stamp of when the request was processed. Example: '2021-09-01 12:34:56'.

columns.name: resource_type_id
columns.description: Identifier for the type of FHIR resource involved in the write-back operation. Foreign key relation with `fhir_write_back_resource_type(id)`. Example: 1, 2, 3.

columns.name: resource_location_id
columns.description: Location identifier of the FHIR resource. Example: 'Location/123', 'Location/456'. This column can have NULL values.

columns.name: todo_record_id
columns.description: Identifier for the associated todo record. Foreign key relation with `todo_list(id)`. Example: 2001, 2002, 2003. This column can have NULL values.

columns.name: request_status
columns.description: Status code of the request. Default value is '1'.

table_description: This table stores information about FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources) write-back resource types.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This is an auto-incrementing integer column that serves as the primary key for the table. It uniquely identifies each record in the table. Example values: 1, 2, 3, etc.

columns.name: resource_name
columns.description: This is a varchar(18) column that stores the name of the FHIR resource type. Example values: "Patient", "Observation", "Encounter", etc.

table_description: This table stores the information of external app vendors. The app can be provider apps such as SMART on FHIR, CDS Hooks OR bulk/backend apps

columns.name: id
columns.description: This is a primary key

columns.name: name
columns.description: This column stores the name of the app.

columns.name: deleteflag
columns.description:
This column specifies whether given app is deprecated/deleted. 
0 - the app is active
1- the app is deprecated/deleted

columns.name: hubrefId
columns.description: This column stores the primary key of the app at Contenthub server

columns.name: appimgurl
columns.description: This column stores the app image which is shown on the configured app list pop up on patient hub or progress notes

columns.name: datecreated
columns.description: This column  stores the date time when the app is created first time

columns.name: applaunchurl
columns.description: This column stores the app launch url. The app is launched on this url when the user clicks on the app image. The app image is shown on the configured app list pop up on patient hub or progress notes

columns.name: details
columns.description: This column stores the description of the app. This description is provided by the app vendor when it registers the app on developer's portal.

columns.name: isodaactivated
columns.description: This column indicated whether the app is activated by the user on EMR.

columns.name: isappgranttoapu
columns.description: This column indicated whether the app is activated by the user on EMR.

columns.name: intereststatus
columns.description: This column is used to show the app activation progress. The app can be in one of these progress steps: 1) Request Pending 2) Activate 2) Configuration etc

columns.name: cost
columns.description: This column stores the cost information of the app.

columns.name: costdescription
columns.description: This column stores the cost description of the app.

columns.name: apptype
columns.description: This column stores the type of the app such as provider, bulk etc

columns.name: productname
columns.description: This column stores the productname used for the app activation on product activation screen.

columns.name: subAppType
columns.description: This column stores the subtype of the apps such as CDS Hooks, Backend single patient app etc

columns.name: feedbackneeded
columns.description: This column is used by CDS Hooks apps. It denotes whether the app requests/needs feedback from the user when the user makes decision on the cards provided by the app.

table_description: This table stores data related to flowsheets for the Others itemtype, which are used to track and document patient care.

columns.name: flowsheetid
columns.description: This column stores flowsheet id of the patient which is documented. This column refers column id from flowsheets.

columns.name: encounterid
columns.description: This column stores encounter id of the patient for whom flowsheet is documented. This column refers column encounterid from enc table.

columns.name: itemid
columns.description: This column stores the item id of the field in a flowsheet. This comes from front-end.

columns.name: value
columns.description: This column stores the data (free text) documented in the field from the itemid column.

table_description: This table stores the lock status of an encounter in a flowsheet.

columns.name: flowsheetid
columns.description: This column stores flowsheet id which is locked. This column refers column id from flowsheets table.

columns.name: encounterid
columns.description: This column stores encounter id to which the locked flowsheet is associated. this column refers column encounterid from enc table.

columns.name: lockFlag
columns.description: This column stores a value 0 or 1. 1 - indicating flowsheet is locked and cannot be edited. 0 - Otherwise.

table_description: This table stores information about items in a flowsheet, including their names, types, and display properties.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This column is an auto incremented Primary Key.

columns.name: flowSheetid
columns.description: This column stores flowsheet id to which the new item is added. This column refers column id from flowsheets table.

columns.name: name
columns.description: This column stores name of the item added.

columns.name: type
columns.description:
This column stores one of the below ids for the item from the drop-down list to which the item is associated.  {id: 1, value: 'Labs'},
 {id: 2, value: 'XRays'},
 {id: 3, value: 'Immunizations'},
 {id: 4, value: 'Rx'},
 {id: 5, value: 'Vitals'},
 {id: 6, value: 'Structured', invoke: $scope.openStructured},
 {id: 7, value: 'Drug Class'},
 {id: 8, value: 'Rx Group'},
 {id: 9, value: 'Procedures'},
 {id: 10, value: 'Lab Attributes'},
 {id: 0, value: 'Others'}
There is no master table for this ids.

columns.name: itemid
columns.description: This column stores an id of the item associated. This column refers column itemid from items table.

columns.name: itemName
columns.description: This column stores the item name of the item from itemid column. This column refers column itemName from items table.

columns.name: displayIndex
columns.description: This column stores the sequence of the item added, this is used to display the same item in User Interface.

columns.name: deleteFlag
columns.description: This column store a value 1 - when the added item to a flowsheet is deleted or 0 - Otherwise.

columns.name: Categoryid
columns.description: This column is not used.

columns.name: GoalLowerLimit

table_description: This table stores information about error codes related to data synchronization in the healow system.

columns.description: Flag indicates the last reading received for a day is deleted, datatype is tinyint - 0 - Not Deleted, 1 - Deleted. This field will always have a value hence defined as NOT NULL. By default, this column should not be in Deleted status hence default 0 is chosen.

columns.name: MessageContent

columns.name: MessageStatus

table_description:
This table stores immunization series and its CVX codes. (static table).
This table stores the list of Immunization Series defined by CDC and the CVXs that belong to each series. This table is utilized in Immunization Schedule tab of Immunization History screen.

columns.name: ImmSeriesid
columns.description: This column stores id of immunization series.

columns.name: ImmSeriesName
columns.description: This column stores Immunization Series Name available at Center for Disease Control.

columns.name: ImmSeriesAlias
columns.description: This column stores Immunization Series Name Alias that will be displayed on Immunization Schedule Screen.

columns.name: membercvx
columns.description: This column stores list of CVXs belonging to this series.

table_description: This table stores immunization data records, including information about the document name,patient's immunization questionnaire filled out from the Patient Portal, submitted user details and import details.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This is auto-incremented primary key in This column .

columns.name: UID
columns.description: This column stores UID of a patient who has submitted immunization questionnaire from Patient Portal. This column refers to UID column in user table.

columns.name: DocName
columns.description: This column stores name of immunization Questionnaire that patient has filled out form Patient Portal.

columns.name: value
columns.description: This column stores response from Patient Portal in XML format.

columns.name: pagenum
columns.description: This column stores  page number of an immunization form patient has filled out.

columns.name: dataImported
columns.description: This column stores values 0/1 to indicate of whether data received from Patient Portal has been imported in to EMR or not. Default value (0) - When staff has not  yet imported immunization data. 1 -  When staff has imported immunization data.

columns.name: importedBy
columns.description: This column stores id of a Staff who has imported immunization data into EMR. This column refers to UID column in user table.

columns.name: dtimported
columns.description: This column stores date when staff imported immunization data into EMR. Datetime is stored in 'YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss.000' format.

columns.name: actionTaken
columns.description: This column stores action taken by end user related to immunization data received from Patient Portal. Default (''); -  When no action has been performed by end user, 'imported' - when data is imported into EMR.

columns.name: ptSubmittimestamp
columns.description: This column stores a datetime value representing the time stamp when the record was submitted by the patient. It can be NULL if not submitted. Example: '2021-01-01 12:34:56', '2021-02-01 14:56:23', etc.

table_description:
This table stores patient's immunization records. 
This table stores the list of all the Immunization Orders that has been placed for a Patient with all the Immunization Order details.

columns.name: Immunizationid
columns.description: This is auto incremented and Primary Key of This column .

columns.name: patientid
columns.description: This column stores id of a patient whose immunizations are being documented. This column refers to UID column in user table.

columns.name: itemid
columns.description: This column stores immunizations selected by provider for the current visit. List of immunizations are stored in items table. Column refers to itemid column in items table.

columns.name: location
columns.description: Stores location of the body selected by provider where immunization is given. List of Locations are stored in vaccines_sites table. Column refers to code column in vaccines_sites table. Possible values LA-Left Arm, LD -Left Deltoid, LG-Left Gluteus Medius, LLFA-Left Lower Forearm, LT-Left Thigh, LVL-Left Vastus Lateralis, RA-Right Arm, RD-Right Deltoid, RG-Right Gluteus Medius, RLFA-Right Lower Forearm, RT-Right Thigh, RVL-Right Vastus Lateralis

columns.name: givenDate
columns.description: This column stores date on which immunization was given to the patient. Date is stored in 'YYYY-MM-DD 00:00:00' format

columns.name: givenBy
columns.description: This column stores name of the provider who administered immunization to the patient.

columns.name: lotNumber
columns.description: This column stores lotnumber of the immunization. Column refers to lotnumber column in lotnumbers table.

columns.name: dose
columns.description: This column stores number of dose(s) given to patient with dosage unit. i.e 1 mg, 2 mL.

columns.name: VaccineManufacturer
columns.description: This column stores name of the manufacturer of immunization given to the patient. This column refers to column Manufacturer from lotnumbers table.

columns.name: dueDate
columns.description: The column stores expiration date of immunization as documented by end user.

columns.name: dateVISgiven
columns.description: The column stores the date when Vaccine Information Statement (VIS) was provided to the patient. Vaccine Information Statements (VISs) are information sheets produced by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). VISs explain both the benefits and risks of a vaccine to adult vaccine recipients and the parents or legal representatives of vaccinees who are children and adolescents.

columns.name: DateonVIS
columns.description: This column stores edition date of the VIS being given to the patient at the time of a visit for immunization. This column refers to the itemvismapping.DateOnVIS and cvxvismapping.VISEditionDate columns.

columns.name: Notes
columns.description: This column stores free text note/comments documented by end user for immunization on User Interface.

columns.name: deleteFlag
columns.description: This column stores value 0 / 1 indicating if the immunization is marked deleted using the User Interface, this is soft delete. 0 - Not Deleted , 1 -Deleted

columns.name: billable
columns.description: This column stores value 0 / 1 indicating if the immunization is marked billable from the user interfaceby end user. 1 - Billable, 0 - Non billable.

columns.name: ImmtracDispatchStatus
columns.description:
This column stores status whether immunization/Therapeutic Inj. was exported to state registry or not.
 0 - Not transmitted,
 1 - Transmitted successfully,
 2 - Pending with errors,
 3 - Modified after being transmitted,
 4 - Deleted  before the export,
 5 - Exported,
 6 - Immunization is not a valid immunization and cannot be exported

columns.name: Selected
columns.description: This column stores 0/1 to indicate whether an Immunization was exported or not. 0 - Immunization was not exported, 1 - Immunization was exported.

columns.name: HistoryFlag
columns.description: This column stores Y/N to indicate if a specific immunization/Therapeutic Inj. was given t the patient in past which is documented by provider/staff on User Interface. Y - immunization/Therapeutic Inj. was given to the patient in past, N - immunization/Therapeutic Inj. was NOT given to the patient in past.

columns.name: DoseNumber
columns.description: This column stores dose number for a specific immunization/Therapeutic Inj. in case there are multiple doses to be administered for immunization/Therapeutic Inj.

columns.name: Facility
columns.description: This column stores the name of the facility where Immunization/Therapeutic Inj. was administered to the patient by provider/staff.

columns.name: race_code
columns.description: This column store race of the patient who has been administered Immunization/Therapeutic Inj. by provider/staff. This column refers to Code column in race_codes column.

columns.name: contactId
columns.description: This column in not being used. Column always has NULL value in database.

columns.name: relation_code
columns.description: This column stores code for relationship of the patient with person accompanying them. This column refers to Code column in relation_codes table.

columns.name: glname
columns.description: This column stores last name of the guardian accompanying the patient.

columns.name: gfname
columns.description: This column stores first name of the guardian accompanying the patient.

columns.name: gminitial
columns.description: This column stores middle initial  of the guardian accompanying the patient.

columns.name: cptcvx
columns.description: This column stores type of immunization value CPT/CVX. CPT - In case of Therapeutic Injection, CVX - In case of Vaccine.

columns.name: VaccineName
columns.description: This column stores name of Immunization/Therapeutic Injection administered to the patient.

columns.name: mvx_code
columns.description: This column stores codes that indicate the manufacturer of a vaccine.

columns.name: cvx_code
columns.description: This column stores codes that indicate the product used in a vaccination. This column refers to column cvx from cptcvx_cdc table.

columns.name: vfc_code
columns.description: This column stores code of Vaccines For Children selected by provider for the immunization. This column refers to code column in vfc_codes table.

columns.name: encounterid
columns.description: This column stores enocunterid for which immunizations are being documented. This column refers to encounterid column in enc table. Column stores 0 in case immunization records were added from Patient Hub.

columns.name: action
columns.description: This column stores values A/D to indicate action performed by end user. 'A' - Immunization was added, 'D' - Immunization was deleted. Column also record NULL and '' values.

columns.name: lotId
columns.description: This column stores lotid of vaccines of the Immunization/Therapeutic Injection administered to the patient. This column refers to id column in lotnumbers table.

columns.name: decDoses
columns.description: This column stores value 0/1 to indicate whether to decrement the number remaining  number of doses and increment given doses or not. 1 - Decrease remaining number of doses and increase given doses by 1 in case of Immunization/Therapeutic Injection was administered to the patient successfully, 0 - DO NOT decrease remaining number of doses and increase given doses by 1 in case Immunization/Therapeutic Injection was not successfully administered to the patient.

columns.name: route
columns.description: This column stores method of delivery of immunization.

columns.name: ExportedDate
columns.description: This column stores the date when Immunization/Therapeutic Inj. were successfully exported to state registry. Date is stored in 'YYYY-MM-DD 00:00:00.000' format.

columns.name: medicaidno
columns.description: When 'Medicaid_NY_PayerId' itemkey is enabled with value set to payorid from insurance table, this column stores id of a user while ordering immunization. This column refers to uid column in user table.

columns.name: GivenTime
columns.description: This column stores time when the Immunization/Therapeutic Injenction was given to the patient. Time is stored in '1900-01-01 hh:mm:00.000' format.

columns.name: ReadBy
columns.description: This column stores name of Provider/Staff who read the result of PPD immunization.

columns.name: ReadDate
columns.description: This column stores date when result of PPD immunization was read by provider/staff. Date is stored in 'YYYY-MM-DD 00:00:00.000'

columns.name: MMInduration
columns.description: This column stores size of the induration in mm for PPD immunization. This column refers to the MMInduration column in imm_induration table.

columns.name: Impression
columns.description: This column stores value Positive/Negative impression using the user interfacefor PPD immunization.

columns.name: GivenById
columns.description: This column stores ID of Provider/Staff by whom immunization was given to the patient. This column refers to uid column in user table.

columns.name: logBatchId
columns.description: This column stores batch id for an Ohio Board Pharmacy Report which has been reviewed by the end user. This column is only populated when report has been reviewed otherwise it is set to 0.

columns.name: logStatus
columns.description: This column stores status of the report whether is is logged or reviewed by user. 'Reviewed' - Ohio Board Pharmacy Report has been reviewed by end user, 'Logged' - Ohio Board Pharmacy Report has been Logged bu not yet Reviewed.

columns.name: immsendstatus
columns.description: Dead Column

columns.name: immprocessed
columns.description: Dead Column

columns.name: fromImmRegistry
columns.description:
This column stores id of an immunization registry from which immunization related data has been received.
This column refers to id column in immlist table. Only values with  immlist.IsVXQConfigured=1 are inserted into this column.

columns.name: immstatus
columns.description:
This column stores a number to indicate status of the immunization. This column refer to immstatusid column in immunizationstatus table.
0 - Pending,
1 - Administered,
2 - Partially Administered,
3 - Not Administered,
4 - Refused,
5 - Histroy of Immunity,
6 - Others,
7 - Contraindications,

columns.name: notAdminReasonCode
columns.description: This column stores code to indicate why Immunization/Therapeutic Injection was not administered to the patient. This column refers to column id in immunityhistory table.

columns.name: notAdminotherReason
columns.description: This column stores free text or pre-defined reasons why Immunization/Therapeutic Injection was not administered to the patient. This column stores more information to elaborate code stored in notAdminReasonCode column.

columns.name: SourceOfHistory
columns.description:
This column stores a code to indicate source from where information regarding patient's past vaccination has been received. This column refers to InfoValue column in imminformationSource table.
00 - New immunization record,
01 - Source unspecified,
02 - Other provider,
03 - Parent's written record,
04 - Parent's recall,
05 - Other registry,
06 - Birth certificate,
07 - School record,
08 - Public agency

columns.name: docfacilityId
columns.description: This column stores id of the facility where patient had received immunization as documented by provider/staff. This column is only used if "Vaccination given in the past" option is checked in the User Interface.

columns.name: counselling
columns.description: This column stores 0/1 to indicate that counselling was provided to the patient regarding any immunization being provided.  0 - If counselling was Not provides, 1 - If counselling was provided to the patient.

columns.name: ReadTime
columns.description: This hold the read time for a PPD immunization. An Immunization can be marked as PPD by checking the 'Mark as PPD' checkbox while creating immunization in the compendium. THen selct that imm to order from imm detail screen, you will see additional PPD related fields including readtime (other ppd related fields: ReadBy, readdate, induration, Impression, MMInduration)

columns.name: isMedWasted
columns.description: This column stores values 0/1 to indicate Immunization/Therapeutic Inj. dose was wasted and was not administered to the patient. 0 - Dose was NOT wasted, 1 - Dose was wasted.

columns.name: wastedDoseAmt
columns.description: This column stores amount of dose wasted in case isMedWasted flag is set to 1 and immunization dose was wasted for any reason.

columns.name: ndcCodeUse
columns.description: This column stores National Drug Code (NDC) for the Immunization/Therapeutic Injection.

columns.name: medicationItemId
columns.description: This column stores item id of drug

columns.name: medicationNDC
columns.description: This column stores NDC code for drug which is mapped to injection

columns.name: lotdoseDeduction
columns.description:
This column is used to track lotnumber dose deducted value for particular immunization.

Default value of this column will be 1 for backward compatibility. For previously created immunization if user delete immunization / update dose value then we need to add 1 in 'DosesRemaining' column in 'lotnumbers' table.

It will be updated when user create/update/delete Immunization based on on above calculation formula(mentioned on Proposed State section).

For Example, If User add 2 as Dose number from lot number screen, while ordering immunization add Dose value as 4 then this column will store ImmDose / lotnumberDose = 4/2 =2. So this column will save 2 in this case.

columns.name: LastDocumented
columns.description: This column is used to track the immunization documented date. If the immunization data for patient change then this column update to the changed date.

table_description: This table stores immunization status details. This table stores all the Immunization/Th Injection statuses and codes and refers to the Status dropdown on the Immunization/Th Injection screen.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This is an auto increment primary key column of this column.

columns.name: immstatusid
columns.description: This column stores immunization status id.

columns.name: CODE
columns.description: This column contains a 3-character code associated with the immunization status. It is an optional field and can be NULL. Example: IMM (Immunized), NIM (Not Immunized), PIM (Partially Immunized).

columns.name: Description
columns.description: This column contains a short description (up to 50 characters) of the immunization status. It is a required field and must have a unique value for each record. Example: Fully Immunized, Not Immunized, Partially Immunized.

columns.name: TYPE
columns.description: This column contains a 3-character code representing the type of immunization status. It is an optional field and can be NULL. Example: CHD (Child), ADL (Adult), SNR (Senior).

table_description: This table stores patient's implants/explants related information.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This is auto-incremented primary key in This column .

columns.name: encounterid
columns.description: This column stores id of an encounter for which implant is being documented. This column refers to encounterid column in enc table.

columns.name: implantType
columns.description: This column stores type of surgery being performed during the encounter. Two possible values are Implant and Explant.

columns.name: udi
columns.description: This column stores Unique Device identifier (UDI) number documented by end user on User Interface. UDI number is from Global Unique Device identification Database approved by FDA.

columns.name: mfgCatid
columns.description: This column stores Manufacturer Category identifier. This is distinct identification code for a human cell, tissue, or cellular and tissue-based product(HCT/P) regulated as a device.

columns.name: modelNo
columns.description: The column store manufacturer device model number of being implanted/explanted.

columns.name: lotNo
columns.description: This column stores Lot or batch number in which the device being implanted/explanted was manufactured by the manufacturer.

columns.name: deviceSnomedCode
columns.description: This column stores Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine -- Clinical Terms (SNOMED CT) code mapped to the GMDN PT Name for the device being implanted/explanted. SNOMED CT is the most comprehensive clinical terminology in use around the world.

columns.name: cptCode
columns.description: This column stores Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) code for the procedure being performed to implant/explant the device.

columns.name: size
columns.description: This column stores size of the implant/explant.

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: This column stores number of devices being implanted/explanted during current encounter.

columns.name: itemDesc
columns.description: This column stores description documented by end user of an item being implanted/explanted.

columns.name: mfgName
columns.description: This column stores name of the manufacturer of the device being implanted/explanted.

columns.name: serialNo
columns.description: This column stores serial number of the device being implanted/explanted.

columns.name: mfgDate
columns.description: This column stores date when the device being implanted/explanted was manufactured.

columns.name: expiryDate
columns.description: This column stores date when device being implanted/explanted might expire.

columns.name: implantedDate
columns.description: This column stores date when device was implanted.

columns.name: mriSafetyInfo
columns.description: This column stores end user documented information on MRI related safety from the device label.

columns.name: siteDesc
columns.description: This column stores details on the site on the body of the implant/explant for the patient.

columns.name: comments
columns.description: This column stores free text notes documented by end user under comments section in the User Interface.

columns.name: isSMDA
columns.description: This column stores values 0 or 1 to indicate if device is marked for Safe Medical Device Act (SDMA) or not. 0 - If not marked for SDMA, 1 - if marked for SDMA.

columns.name: isLatexInfo
columns.description: This column stores values 0 or 1 to indicate whether device is labeled as containing natural rubber latex or dry natural rubber.  0 - Latex Info is not Labeled, 1 - Latex Info is Labeled for the device.

columns.name: isExpiryDateNA
columns.description: This column stores values 0/1 to indicate whether expiry date is applicable or not for the device being implanted/explanted. 0 - If Expiry Date is Applicable, 1 - If Expiry Date is Not Applicable.

columns.name: gmdnPtName
columns.description:
This column stores attribute code associated with the device identifier (UDI), obtained from GUDid. Global Medical Device Nomenclature (GMDN) is a system of internationally agreed descriptors used to identify medical
device products and is managed by GMDN Agency.

columns.name: deleteFlag
columns.description: This column stores values 0 or 1 to indicate whether the implant/explant was deleted. 0 - If implant/explant is not deleted, 1 -If implant/explant is deleted.

columns.name: withUdi
columns.description: This column stores values 0/1 to indicate whether Implant is with or without UDI registry. 0 - Without UDI Registry, 1 - with UDI Registry

columns.name: barcode
columns.description: This column stores UDI of the device being implanted using barcode when "UDI Registry" radio button on user interfaceis selected.

columns.name: snomedCTName
columns.description: This column stores Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine -- Clinical Terms (SNOMED CT) Name mapped to the GMDN PT Name for the device being implanted/explanted. SNOMED CT is the most comprehensive clinical terminology in use around the world.

columns.name: explantDate
columns.description: This column stores date when device was explanted.

columns.name: brandName
columns.description: This column stores brand name of the device being implanted/explanted.

columns.name: issuingAgency
columns.description: This column stores abbreviation of the agency which issued the UDI for the device being implanted/explanted. Three issuing agencies are: GS1 Issuing Agency, Health Industry Business Communications Council (HIBCC), or International Council for Community in Blood Banking Automation (ICCBBA).

columns.name: donationid
columns.description: This column stores donation id in case the device being implanted is a donation.

table_description: This table stores the configuration of reasons for marking procedures as inactive, along with information about who created and modified the records and when.

columns.name: id
columns.description: A unique identifier for each record in the table. It is a small integer that auto-increments with each new entry. Example: 1, 2, 3, etc.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: A short name for the reason of marking a procedure as inactive. It is a variable character string with a maximum length of 25 characters. Example: "Outdated", "Deprecated", "Error".

columns.name: description
columns.description: A detailed description of the reason for marking a procedure as inactive. It is a variable character string with a maximum length of 256 characters. Example: "This procedure is no longer in use due to updated gUIDelines."

columns.name: invalidFlag
columns.description: A flag indicating whether the reason is valid or not. It is a tiny integer with a default value of '0'. Example: 0 (valid), 1 (invalid).

columns.name: createdBy
columns.description: The user id of the person who created the record. It is an integer that refers to the `UID` column in the `users` table as a foreign key. Example: 101, 102, 103, etc.

columns.name: createdDate
columns.description: The date and time when the record was created. It is a datetime value. Example: "2021-09-01 12:34:56".

columns.name: modifiedBy
columns.description: The user id of the person who last modified the record. It is an integer that can be NULL and refers to the `UID` column in the `users` table as a foreign key. Example: 101, 102, 103, etc.

columns.name: modifiedDate
columns.description: The date and time when the record was last modified. It is a datetime value that can be NULL. Example: "2021-09-10 15:30:00".

columns.name: deleteFlag
columns.description: A flag indicating whether the record has been deleted or not. It is a tiny integer with a default value of '0'. Example: 0 (not deleted), 1 (deleted).

table_description: This table stores the mapping between admission IDs and encounter IDs in the infirmary.

columns.name: admissionid
columns.description: This column store the infirmary admission id.

columns.name: encounterid
columns.description: This column store the encounter associated in this infirmary. Column refers to encounterid column in enc table.

table_description: This table stores notes related to patients' admissions in the infirmary, including the reason for admission, the user who created the note, and the date it was created.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This is the primary key column, which uniquely identifies each record in the infirmary_notes table. It is an integer value that auto-increments with each new entry. Example: 1, 2, 3, etc.

columns.name: admissionid
columns.description: This column stores the infirmary admission ID associated with the infirmary note. It is a foreign key that refers to the `id` column in the `corrections_infirmary_console` table. Example: 101, 102, 103, etc.

columns.name: icReasonId
columns.description: This column stores the reason id for the patient's note . It is a foreign key that refers to the `itemid` column in the `items` table. Example: 1 (injury), 2 (illness), 3 (surgery), etc.

columns.name: notes
columns.description: This column store the notes entered by user.

columns.name: userid
columns.description: This column stores the ID of the user who created the infirmary note. It is a foreign key that refers to the `id` column in the `users` table. Example: 1001, 1002, 1003, etc.

columns.name: datecreated
columns.description: This column stores the time stamp of when the infirmary note was created. It is automatically set to the current time stamp when a new record is inserted. Example: '2022-01-01 12:34:56'

columns.name: deleteflag
columns.description: This column store the delete status of the note. 0 - Not Deleted, 1 -  Deleted.

table_description: This table stores exception reason for information blocking

columns.name: id
columns.description: Primary key of information_blocking_reasons table. This column stores numeric data which could grow hence the integer range 0-2,147,483,647 is selected.

columns.name: exceptionReasonid
columns.description: This column is used to store Exception Reason id. This column does not expect NULL values as it is mandatory field in the user interface. This column required to stores unique id. Hence unique constraint is selected. This column stores numeric data which could grow hence integer range: 0-2,147,483,647 is selected.

columns.name: exceptionReason
columns.description: This column is used to store reason of why encounter is restricted/block for Patient Portal. As per functionality, user can insert a reason up to 255 characters.

columns.name: inactive
columns.description: This column is used to make Exception Reason active/inactive. Possible values of this column are 0 or 1 hence tinyint is selected. The default value of this column will be 0 (Active). This column will store 0 or 1 hence tinyint is selected.

table_description: This table stores information about encounters related to injections for patients, including details about the encounter, patient, and doctor involved.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This column stores id which is primary key of type integer and length 4. This column is auto incremented and cannot be NULL.

columns.name: injEncid
columns.description: This column stores id of item given to patient on given encounter. This column is of type integer and length 4. Default value of this column is 0 and it cannot be NULL.

columns.name: encid
columns.description: This column stores encounter id of a given patient. This column is of type integer and length 4. Default value of this column is 0 and it cannot be NULL.

columns.name: patientid
columns.description: This column stores patient id. This column is of type integer and length 4. Default value of this column is 0 and it cannot be NULL.

Table is used to store allergy details for patient encounter

columns.name: id
columns.description: Contains auto incremented id, datatype is INT (11). This column stores integer value which could grow with number of transactions over the years hence integer (Range: 0-2,147,483,647) is selected. It is AUTO_INCREMENT column and has PRIMARY KEY index

columns.name: patientID
columns.description: This column is used to identify for which patient user has documented allergies. This column is FOREIGN KEY which refers to uid column of users table. This column stores high range numeric value hence integer is selected, and this column will always have a value hence defined as NOT NULL.

columns.name: encounterId
columns.description: This column is used to identify for which patient encounter user has documented allergies This column is FOREIGN KEY which refers to encounterid column of enc table. This column stores a high range numeric value hence integer is selected, and this column will always have a value hence defined as NOT NULL.

columns.name: drug
columns.description: This column stores agent/drug/substance name which is added for patient encounter. We are using datatype as varchar 255.Drug name will not be more than 255 characters, so we have set its length to 255. This column will not always have value hence we keep NOT NULL DEFAULT ''.

columns.name: allergy
columns.description: This column stores reaction/allergy name which is added for patient encounter. We are using datatype as varchar 255. Allergy name will not be more than 255 characters, so we have set its length to 255. This column will always have a value hence defined as NOT NULL and default value is ''.

columns.name: itemID
columns.description: This column is used to store item id of added allergy to patient encounter. This column is FOREIGN KEY which refers to itemID column of items table. This column stores itemid of agent/drug/substance which is added for patient encounter.This column will not always have value hence we keep NULL DEFAULT NULL.

columns.name: displayIndex
columns.description: This column stores integer values hence integer data type is selected. This column is used to maintain order of drugs added for patient encounter. This column will always have a value hence defined as NOT NULL and default value is 1.

columns.name: SMDamConceptID
columns.description: This is a legacy column.This column is not being used as of now. Value is always set to 0.

columns.name: SMDamConceptIDDesc
columns.description: This is a legacy column.This column is not being used as of now.

columns.name: ndc_code
columns.description: This column stores ndc code of reaction/allergy name which is added for patient encounter. We are using datatype as varchar 255. Ndc code will not be more than 255 characters, so we have set its length to 255. This column will not always have a value hence defined as NULL and default value is NULL.

columns.name: allergytype
columns.description: This column stores the id of reaction/allergy which is added for patient encounter. This column belongs to the id column of allergytypes table. This column stores a small range numeric value hence SMALLINT datatype is selected. This column will not always have value hence we keep NULL DEFAULT NULL.

columns.name: type
columns.description: This column stores 1 or 2 number value.1-existing agent/substance .2- user entered value. The data type for this column is char (1) selected with default value is ''.

columns.name: status
columns.description: This column will store "Active" and "Inactive" text as value. We are using VARCHAR (10) as data type because the value of this column will not be more than 10 characters. This column will always have value hence we defined it as NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Active'.

columns.name: criticality
columns.description: This column stores the id of allergy criticality which is added for patient encounter. This column belongs to the id column of allergycriticality table. This column stores a small range numeric value hence SMALLINT is selected as datatype. This column will not always have value hence we defined it as NULL DEFAULT NULL.

columns.name: onsetdate
columns.description: This column stores date string value. We are using VARCHAR (10) as data type because the value of this column will not be more than 10 characters. This column will not always have value hence we defined it as NULL DEFAULT NULL.

columns.name: deleteFlag
columns.description: This will store 0 and 1 value. 0-not deleted and 1-deleted. This column is used to identify whether row is in use or not. We are using TINYINT as datatype as we just want to store 0 or 1 value. By default, row will be in use, so we keep NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.

columns.name: createdBy
columns.description: This column stores user id of user. This column is used to identify which user has added record(allergy) for patient encounter. This column is FOREIGN KEY which refers to uid column of users table. This column will store high range of numeric value hence integer is selected. This column will always have a value hence defined as NOT NULL.

columns.name: createdDateTime
columns.description: This Column stores datetime as we want to store a datetime when the record is added, so we are using DATETIME as data type of column. This column will always have a value hence defined as NOT NULL.

columns.name: modifiedBy
columns.description: This column stores user id of user. This column is used to identify which user has last updated/modified the added record(allergy) for patient encounter. This column is FOREIGN KEY which refers to uid column of users table. This column will store high range of numeric value hence integer is selected, and this column will not always have a value hence defined as NULL DEFAULT NULL.

columns.name: modifiedDateTime
columns.description: This Column stores datetime as we want to store a datetime when the record is modified, so we are using DATETIME as data type of column. This column will always not have a value hence defined as NULL DEFAULT NULL.

columns.name: uId
columns.description: This column stores vm id string value. We are using VARCHAR (60) as data type because this column's value will not be more than 60 characters. This column will always have a value hence defined as NOT NULL.

table_description: This table stores the templates created for Progress Notes Section on the clinical side.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This is an auto-incremented primary key column in this table. The data type is int because the templates are dynamically created and the templates created could be huge in number. The column cannot be NULL as it will always have an id.

columns.name: tempName
columns.description: This column stores the template name. The default value is NULL.

columns.name: categoryId
columns.description: This column refers to the itemId column in ip_rh_items table. It stores the itemid of the progress notes section for which the template is created.

columns.name: enableScore
columns.description: This column stores the value 0/1. Value 1 indicates the score is enabled for the corresponding template and 0 means the score is not enabled.

columns.name: forGender
columns.description: This column is used to identify if the template is created for Male, Female or for both the genders. It stores the values 0/1/2. Value 1 indicates the template is created for Male. Value 2 indicates the template is created for Female. Value 0 indicates the template is created for both Male and Female.

columns.name: ageRangeFrom
columns.description: This column stores the minimum age for which the template is applied.

columns.name: ageRangeTo
columns.description: This column stores the maximum age for which the template is applied.

columns.name: ageIn
columns.description: This column stores the values MON/YRS/DAY. It indicates if the age range set using the columns ageRangeFrom and ageRangeTo are in MONTHS/YEARS/DAYS respectively.

columns.name: displayIndex
columns.description: This column stores a number to indicate in which order templates should be listed on user facing screen. The data type is smallint and the value can range from -32,768 to 32,767. columns.description: This column stores the date and time when the drug administration ended in the format yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss.

columns.description: This column is used to store the reason if the drug administration was early. It is a foreign key referencing the id column of ip_rh_drugFormulary_reasondictionaryitems table.

columns.name: MasterEncounterID
columns.description: This column is used to store the ID of the master encounter associated with the drug administration. It is a foreign key referencing the encounterID column of enc table.

columns.name: LateDocumentationReason
columns.description: This column is used to store the reason if the documentation of the drug administration was done late. It is a foreign key referencing the id column of ip_rh_drugFormulary_reasondictionaryitems table.

columns.name: isScan
columns.description:
This column stores a value indicating if the record is scanned. Possible values:
0 - Not scanned
1 - scanned
The default value is 0.

columns.name: WastageDose
columns.description: This column is used to store the wastage dose of the drug, if any.

columns.name: WastageDoseUnit
columns.description: This column is used to store the units of wastage dose like ml, mg, etc.

columns.name: WastageDispense
columns.description: This column is used to store the wastage dispense of the drug, if any.

columns.name: WastageDispenseUnit
columns.description: This column is used to store the unit of wastage dispense like ml, mg, etc.

columns.name: AdminStartSource
columns.description: This column is used to store the source of the administration start.

columns.description: This column is used to store the ID of the document module encounter associated with the drug administration. It is a foreign key referencing the encounterID of enc table.

table_description: This table is used to store notes related to the administration of drugs, including details about users who made notes and when those notes were made.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This is the primary key and is auto incremented.

columns.name: userid
columns.description: This column stores the Id of a user.

columns.name: notedatetime
columns.description:
This column stores the date and time when a note was made.
It is stored as a datetime. Value gets stored in yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss format.

columns.name: Note
columns.description:
This column stores the text of a note at the time of administration documentation.
It is stored as a varchar with maximum length allowed, which means it can store a large amount of text data.

columns.name: orderid
columns.description: This column is used to store the ID of the order associated with the note.

columns.name: ScheduleId
columns.description: This column is used to store the ID of the schedule associated with the note and is a foreign key referencing the ScheduleId column of the ip_rh_drug_admin_schedule table.

columns.description: This column stores a value of 0 or 1 indicating if the record is marked deleted.

columns.name: deletedBy
columns.description:
This column is used to store the ID of the user who deleted the record.
The integer data type is chosen for efficient storage and sorting.
The column has a foreign key constraint (FK_ip_rh_ drugadministrationnotes _deletedBy) referencing the uid from the users table.

table_description: This table is used to store interaction override details like interaction override reason, severity for interaction and acknowledge flag for acknowledged interaction

columns.name: interactionId
columns.description: This is the unique identifier for each interaction record.

columns.name: severityCode
columns.description:
This column is used to store severity code of interaction. The default value is 0.
Possible values are:
1 - minor
2 - moderate
3 - severe

columns.name: encounterId
columns.description: This column is used to store encounter ID and is foreign key references encounterId column of enc table.

columns.name: description
columns.description: This column is used to store interaction messages.

columns.description:
This column is used to store override flag it shows whether interaction is override. 1 - represents interaction is override
0 - represents interaction is not overriden
Default value is 1 as record is added when the interaction is override.

columns.name: overrideReason
columns.description: This column is used to store override reason id and is foreign key references id column of ip_rh_drugFormulary_reasondictionaryitems table.

columns.name: interactionCategory
columns.description:
This column is used to store is category of interaction. Default value is 0 and possible values are:
1 - drug to drug
2 - drug to allergy
3 - drug to alcohol/food
6 - duplicate therapy

columns.name: overrideBy
columns.description: This column is used to store override by Id and is foreign key references uid column of users table.

columns.name: overrideDateTime
columns.description: This column is used to store date and time of override interaction in yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss format.

columns.name: acknowledgeFlag
columns.description:
This column is used to store acknowledge flag it shows whether interaction is acknowledged.1 - interaction is acknowledged
0 - interaction is not acknowledged.
Default value is 0 as record is added when interaction is override.

columns.name: acknowledgeBy
columns.description: This column is used to store acknowledge Id.

columns.name: acknowledgeDateTime
columns.description: This column is used to store date and time of acknowledge interaction in yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss format.

columns.name: itemID
columns.description: The primary key and unique identifier for each item. Identity auto increments itemID value. The data type is int because the items can be dynamically created and the items created could be huge in number. The column cannot be NULL as it will always have an itemid.

columns.name: itemName
columns.description: It stores the item name. The datatype is varchar(255) with a reasonable size constraint i.e., 255 characters as per business requirement. The column has a default value '' and cannot be NULL.

columns.name: itemDesc
columns.description: It stores item description entered by a user. The datatype is varchar(255) with a reasonable size constraint i.e., 255 characters as per business requirement. The column has a default value '' but cannot be NULL.

columns.description: This column stores id of a parent item under which new item has been created. The parent item is stored in ip_rh_items table only. However, there cannot be a foreign key relationship because it refers to the legacy table, items table where the parentId can be stored as 0 and accordingly it is used in the code also.

columns.name: xmlPath
columns.description: This column stores path of the item from parent item. It displays the hierarchy of the item under which it is created.

columns.name: itemType
columns.description:
This column stores the type of an item. It can have the following bold values.C - It is a category
I - It is a category Item
N - It is a Narrative item
S - It is a Structured item
If value is '', it means it is a free form item.

columns.name: createdDate
columns.description: Stores the date and time the item was created. As certain items will be shipped through the queries without the createdDate column, for these items the createdDate column will be the default value i.e 1901-01-01 00:00:00. This default value is used in the code. Hence, this column cannot be changed to NULL. For items created through application, this column will be populated with created Date and Time.

columns.name: modifiedDate
columns.description: Stores the date and time the item was last modified. As certain items will be shipped through the queries, for these items the modifiedDate column will be NULL. For items created through application, this column will be populated with the last modified date and time.

columns.name: displayIndex
columns.description: The order index for displaying the item in a list. The data type is smallint as compared to int is because the expected items will not exceed the limitation provided by the smallInt datatype. The column is NOT NULL and has a default value of 0.

columns.name: deleteflag
columns.description: This column stores flags 1/0 to indicate whether item has been marked as deleted or not. The datatype is tinyint. The column is NOT NULL and has a default value of 0.Value 0 indicates the item is not deleted and Value 1 indicates the item has been deleted.

columns.name: keyName
columns.description: It stores the key name associated with the item. The datatype is varchar(80) as the expected value to be stored in the keyName column will not exceed 80 characters.. The column cannot be NULL and has a default value ''.

columns.name: modifiedBy
columns.description: Stores the user ID of the person who last modified the item. For items shipped through the queries, the modifiedBy column will be NULL. For items created through the application , this column will be populated with user id of the user who last modified the item. It refers to uid column in users table.

columns.description: This field is a datetime data type and CAN be NULL. It represents the date and time the order was made.

columns.name: orderStatus
columns.description:
This is an int data type, CANNOT be NULL with a default value of 0. This field represents the status of the order.
orderStatus value mark as 1 when place a new order,
orderStatus value mark as 2 when signoff order,
orderStatus value mark as 3 when modify existing order,
orderStatus value mark as 5 when discontinue order,orderStatus value mark as 4 when modified order signoff,
orderStatus value mark as 10 when modified order discontinue.

columns.name: documentedbyid
columns.description: This is an Integer data type, can be NULL. This field hold the identifier of the person who documented the order. It references the uid column in the users table.

columns.name: documenteddatetime
columns.description: This field is a datetime data type and CAN be NULL. It represents the date and time the order was documented.

columns.description: This field is a datetime data type and can be NULL. It represents the start date and time of the order.

columns.description: This field is a datetime data type and can be NULL. It represents the end date and time of the order.

columns.description: This is a tinyint that stores 0/1. This column indicates whether the order is recurring or not.

columns.name: orderPriority
columns.description: This is a int, a smaller range integer. It cannot be NULL and represent the priority of the order.

columns.name: orderInstructions
columns.description: This is a varchar of size 255 and can be NULL. It holds any special instructions associated with the order.

columns.description: This is an Integer data type, can be NULL. This field hold the identifier for the method used to enter the order. It references the Id column in the ip_rh_global_list_items table.
