columns.name: orderNotes
columns.description: This is a varchar data type and cannot be NULL and default is empty. It holds any notes or additional information associated with the order.

table_description: This table appears to manage the expiry details of patient orders. It includes information about the order's expiry, renewal, and associated flags.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier for each record in the table. This column does not refer to another table but is likely referenced by other tables as a foreign key.

columns.name: orderId
columns.description: Associate the expiry record with a specific order. Likely refers to an ip_rh_ptorders table, specifically the id column, indicating which order this expiry pertains to.

columns.name: renewedBy
columns.description: Indicates which user or process renewed the order. Likely refers to a users table, specifically the uid column, to identify the user who renewed the order.

columns.name: expireDateTime
columns.description: Records the date and time when the order will expire or has expired. The default date '1901-01-01 00:00:00' is a sentinel value that can be used to easily identify records where the actual expiry date has not been set.

columns.name: expiryFlag
columns.description: A flag indicating the expiry status of the order. The default value of 0 likely indicates that the order is active or not expired when the record is first created.

columns.name: renewedDateTime
columns.description: Records the date and time when the order was last renewed. This column is used to track when an order's expiry has been extended, which is important for maintaining accurate records of order validity.

table_description: The table 'ip_rh_ptstagingorders' is designed to store order data, in a medical or healthcare setting. It covers comprehensive details about an order, including encounter details, order details, order processing information, and order discontinuation details.

columns.name: stagingOrderId
columns.description: This is the primary key for the table, providing a unique identifier for each record. It is an integer data type, auto-incrementing from 1, and cannot be NULL, ensuring a unique and not NULL value for every order.

columns.name: encounterId
columns.description: This is an Integer data type that cannot be NULL. This field hold the unique identifier of a patient's encounter during which the order was made. It references the encounterID column in the enc table.

columns.name: orderItemId
columns.description: This is an Integer data type, CANNOT be NULL. The default value is 0. This field is to hold the identifier for the item ordered. It references the itemId column in the items table.

columns.name: orderDateTime
columns.description: This field is a datetime data type and can be NULL. It represents the date and time the order was made.

columns.name: orderStatus
columns.description:
This is an int data type that can be NULL. This field hold the status of the order. It references the id column in the ip_rh_orderstatus_master table. orderStatus value mark as 1 when place a new order,
orderStatus value mark as 2 when signoff order,
orderStatus value mark as 3 when modify existing order,
orderStatus value mark as 5 when discontinue order,
orderStatus value mark as 4 when modified order signoff,
orderStatus value mark as 10 when modified order discontinue.

columns.name: documentedbyid
columns.description: This is an Integer data type that can be NULL. This field hold the identifier of the person who documented the order. It references the uid column in the users table

columns.name: documenteddatetime
columns.description: This field is a datetime data type and can be NULL. It represents the date and time the order was documented.

columns.name: startDateTime
columns.description: This field is a datetime data type and can be NULL. It represents the start date and time of the order.

columns.name: endDateTime
columns.description: This field is a datetime data type and can be NULL. It represents the end date and time of the order.

columns.name: orderedById
columns.description: This is an Integer data type that can be NULL. This field hold the identifier of the person who ordered. It references the uid column in the users table

columns.name: isRecurringOrder
columns.description: This is a tinyint, a smaller range integer. It cannot be NULL and indicate whether the order is recurring or not.

columns.name: orderFrequencyId
columns.description: This is an Integer data type that can be NULL. This field hold the identifier for the frequency of the order. It references the frequencyId column in the ip_rh_ptstagingorders table.

columns.name: orderPriority
columns.description: This is an int data type that cannot be NULL with a default value of 0. This field represents the priority level of the order.

columns.name: orderInstructions
columns.description: This is a varchar of size 255 and can be NULL. It is to hold any special instructions associated with the order.

columns.name: orderEntryMethodId
columns.description: Integer data type can be NULL. This field hold the identifier for the method used to enter the order. It references the Id column in the ip_rh_global_list_items table

columns.name: orderReason
columns.description: This is a varchar of size 255 and CANNOT be NULL. The default value is ''. It holds the reason for the order.

columns.name: includeNow
columns.description: This is a tinyint, a smaller range integer. It can be NULL and indicate whether the order needs to be included immediately or not.

columns.name: discontinueReasonId
columns.description: This is an Integer data type that can be NULL. This field hold the identifier for the reason the order was discontinued. It references the Id column in the ip_rh_global_list_items table.

columns.name: discontinueDateTime
columns.description: This field is a datetime data type and can be NULL. It represents the date and time the order was discontinued.

columns.name: onHoldReasonId
columns.description: This is an Integer data type that can be NULL. This field hold the identifier for the reason the order was put on hold.

columns.name: onHoldDateTime
columns.description: This field is a datetime data type and can be NULL. It represents the date and time the order was put on hold.

columns.name: deleteFlag
columns.description: This is a tinyint, a smaller range integer. It cannot be NULL and has a default value of 0. This column indicates whether a patient's staging order has been marked for deletion or not. deleteFlag value 0 mark as not deleted, and value 1 mark as deleted.

columns.name: episodeEncId
columns.description: This is an Integer data type that can be NULL. This field hold the identifier for the episode encounter associated with the order. It references the encounterId column in the enc table.

columns.name: discontinuedById
columns.description: This is an Integer data type that can be NULL. This field hold the identifier of the person who discontinued the order. It references the uid column in the users table.

columns.name: discontinueProtocol
columns.description: This is an Integer data type, CANNOT be NULL with a default value of 0. This field represents the protocol followed to discontinue the order.

columns.name: treatmentPlanId
columns.description: Integer data type, CANNOT be NULL with a default value of 0. This field represents the treatment plan associated with the order.

columns.name: orderNotes
columns.description: This is a varchar data type and cannot be NULL. It holds any notes or additional information associated with the order.

columns.name: orderPlacementFlag
columns.description: This is a smallint, a smaller range integer. It CANNOT be NULL and has a default value of 0. This column indicates whether an order has been placed or not.

columns.name: retroStartDateTime
columns.description: This is a tinyint, a smaller range integer. It cannot be NULL and has a default value of 0. This column indicates whether a retro start datetime orders are allowed or not. 0 indicates not allowed retro orders and 1 indicates allowed retro orders.

table_description: The 'ip_rh_ptstagingorders_action_map' table store mappings of actions related to staging orders. Each record is uniquely identified by an 'actionMapId' and contains details about the staging order, user, order status, and some flags indicating the state of the order.

table_description: This table logs details of medication pertaining to subsequent ambulatory encounter after RBH active encounter.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier for each medication alert record.

columns.name: itemid
columns.description: This column stores id of the medication added to the encounter for which alert is set.This column refers column itemId from items table.

columns.name: encounterId
columns.description: This column is used to store encounter ID and is foreign key references encounterId column of enc table.

columns.name: rxOrderNo
columns.description: This column stores order number for a set of medication/drug added tospecific encounter. This number is generated on the application side.

columns.name: medName
columns.description: This column stores name of the medicine/drug of the id stored in itemId column which is added as part of the treatment and on which alert is set.

columns.name: userId
columns.description: This column stores id of the user who is treating/documenting the encounter for  which alert is set. This column refers column uid from users table.

columns.name: addedDateTime

columns.name: rxComment
columns.description:
This column stores one of the below values indicating status of the medication addedfor the patient on which alert is created.
 Possible values :'Unknown' , 'Discontinued',  'Not-Taking',  'Taking',  'Stop', 'Start',
Continue', 'Increase', 'Decrease'

columns.name: isMedDelete
columns.description: This column store one of the below values indicating medication is deleted or not. When the medication is marked as delete only the last active entry is updated as deleted.Possible Values: 1 = medication deleted, 0 = medication not deleted.Default value is 0 for medication alert record.

table_description: This table is used to store details entered while adding patient into wait list. The reason for creating this table is, when patient comes, and user tries to make patients entry in wait list then that details will get saved in this table.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This column is used to store the id of the patient entry into wait list.

columns.name: patientId
columns.description: This column is used to store the id of the patient who who got added in wait list.This column is FOREIGN KEY which refers to uid column of users table that indicates which patientId of a patient is added into wait list.

columns.name: status
columns.description:
This column is storing status of patient added in waitlist. Whether that patient is still existing in the wait list screen or not. 0 - Patient is added to the wait list,
1 - Patient is removed from wait list.
The default value is set to 0 because by default when patient is added into wait list then it should be added in wait list.

columns.name: facilityId
columns.description: This column stores the facility id of facility selected while adding patient into wait list which defines under which facility patient got added into wait list. This column is FOREIGN KEY which refers to id column of edi_facilities table that indicates selected facility on add wait list screen

columns.name: followUpStatus
columns.description:
This column stores follow up status whether it is completed or not. When a patient is added to the wait list then user add follow up date time for that patient, on that day user will follow up with patient if that follow up gets successful then user will mark Yes as completed or will create next follow up. 1-Completed (Yes),  
0-Not Completed (No).
The default value is set to 0 because by default follow up status is considered as not complet

columns.name: addedOn
columns.description: The purpose of this column is to know when patients get added onto the wait list screen. This column stores date time value for patient added into waitlist.

columns.name: triageInitiatedDateTime
columns.description: The purpose of this column is to know when triage of the added patient got created.This column stores date time value for patients on the date which user has initiated triage for patient.

columns.name: notes
columns.description: The purpose of this column is to store the notes which are added at the time of adding patient into wait list or editing patient's entry into wait list.

table_description: This table stores structured items like structured questions created by end users for clinical data.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This is auto-incremented primary key in this table. This column stores unique id for each structured item created by users. The data type is int because the questions can be huge in number. The column cannot be NULL as it will always have an id.

columns.name: catId
columns.description: This column stores id of a category for which structured item is being created. This column refers to itemid column in ip_rh_items table. The data type is int. The field will always have a value and hence cannot be null.

columns.name: itemId
columns.description: This column stores id of an item for which structured item/question has been created by end user. This column refers to itemid column in ip_rh_items table. The data type is int. The field will always have a value and hence cannot be null.

columns.name: name
columns.description: This column stores name of a structured item created by end user. The data type is varchar(255) as the expected value to be stored in the name column will not exceed 255 characters. The field will always have a value and hence cannot be null.

columns.name: type
columns.description:
This column stores a number value which indicates what should be the type of the structured data on local . The data type is tinyint and the value can range from 0 to 255. The default value is NULL.Multi Select / Single Select : 0,
Numeric : 1,
Date : 2,
Boolean: 3,
Date(mm/yyyy): 4,
Date(YYYY): 5,
Free text: 6,
Date(dd/mm/yyyy): 7,
Date(mm-dd-yyyy):8,
Time(HH:mm:ss): 9,
Time(HH:mm): 10,
Date(mm/dd/yyyy HH:mm): 12,
Date(mm/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss): 13,
"Decimal	: 14"

columns.name: mandatory
columns.description: This column stores flags 0/1 to indicate whether question is mandatory to fill or not. 0 means the question is not mandatory and 1 means the question is  mandatory

columns.name: displayIndex
columns.description: This column stores a number to indicate in which order form questions should be listed on user facing screen. The data type is smallint and the value can range from -32,768 to 32,767. The data type is smallint as compared to int is because the expected items will not exceed the limitation provided by the smallInt datatype. This field will always have a value and hence cannot be null. The default value is 0.

columns.name: deleteflag
columns.description: A flag indicating if the question is deleted (1) or not (0). The tinyint data type allows for efficient storage of binary values. The default value is 0, indicating the question is not deleted.

columns.name: parentId
columns.description: This column stores id of a parent question under which new question has been created. The parent question is stored in ip_rh_structdatadetail table only. However, there cannot be a foreign key relationship because it refers to the legacy table, structdatadetail table where the parentId can be stored as 0 and accordingly it is used in the code also.

columns.name: triggerflag
columns.description: This column stores id of an option for which this question has been triggered. It stores the value from optionId column in ip_rh_structdataoptions table.However, for child questions whose parent question is Boolean, it stores triggerflag as 1 for Yes and 0 for No. As the Boolean question options come through code, when the child question for this Boolean question is triggered, the triggerflag stores the values 1 or 0 which come through code. This is applicable only for Boolean type parent questions. So this column cannot reference optionId column in ip_rh_structdataoptions table for Foreign Key. For questions which do not have parent questions, the value for this column is -1.

columns.name: itemType
columns.description: This column stores a value which indicates what is the type of the structured data whether it is a category or just an Item . 'C' - is a category and 'I' - is category item.

columns.name: nodeLevel
columns.description: This column indicates if the question is a parent question or child question. For parent question, node level is 0. For the first level child question, node level is 1 and for second level child question, node level value is 2 and so on.

columns.name: tblName
columns.description: This column stores the table name for a question to indicate where the responses of the question would be stored when the question is documented by the user.

columns.name: chartDisplay
columns.description: This column indicates whether corresponding question will be displayed on the chart.. It stores a value 0 or 1. Value 0 indicates the structured item will not show up on chart and 1 indicates the structured item will show up on chart.

columns.name: multiSelect
columns.description: This column stores a value which indicates whether the structured question is multiselect or not. Value 1 means the question is multiselect and 0 means the question is not a multiselect question.

columns.name: isSearchable
columns.description: This column is a legacy column used in the code which belonged to Acute care project in the past. So, although there is no concrete usage available for this column, we have still added it to avoid any functionality break due to removal from code. It stores the values 0 or 1.

columns.name: defaultValue
columns.description: This column stores value(s) which will be default value(s) for that question. The default value will be populated only for Boolean, Multi-Select and Single-Select type of questions.

columns.name: defaultValueId
columns.description: This column stores optionId(s) which will be default valueId(s) for that question. The default valueIds will be populated only for Boolean, Multi-Select and Single-Select type of questions. These ids will be comma separated.

columns.name: modifyNotes
columns.description: This column stores value 0 or 1 to indicate whether the notes of that question can be modified or not. Value 0 indicates that the notes of the structured element cannot be modified and Value 1 indicates that the notes of the structured element can be modified. The data type is tinyint as per business requirements.

columns.name: readonly
columns.description: This column stores a value 0 or 1 to indicate whether the question is read-only. Value 0 means the question is not readonly whereas value 1 means it is a readOnly element.

columns.name: dropdown
columns.description: This column stores a value 0 or 1 to indicate whether the question should have a dropdown or not. Value 0 indicates that the question cannot be a dropdown and Value 1 indicates that question can be a dropdown.

columns.description: This column stores value added by user. We are using datatype as varchar 255. Value will not be more than 255 characters, so we have set its length to 255. This column will always have a value hence defined as NOT NULL and default value is ''.

columns.description: This column stores user id of user. This column is used to identify which user has last updated this record (vital item) for patient encounter. This column will not always have value hence we keep NULL DEFAULT NULL.

columns.name: qualifierPosition

This column will not always have value hence we keep NULL DEFAULT NULL.

columns.name: qualifierType

This column will not always have value hence we keep NULL DEFAULT NULL.

columns.name: UpdatedTime

This column stores a high range numeric value hence integer is selected, and this column will not always have value hence we keep NULL DEFAULT NULL.

columns.name: CommunityName

columns.name: DeleteFlag

columns.name: CommunityElementid

columns.name: OrderSetItemid

table_description: This table stores information about laboratory test reports, including test results, statuses, and other related data.

columns.name: Reportid
columns.description: This column stores the auto-incremented primary key.

columns.name: Encounterid
columns.description: This column stores the ID of the encounter for which a lab is added. This column refers to the encounterid column from the enc table. If the lab added is for a future date, then this column holds the newly created encounterid (i.e., a new encounter is created for the future dated lab and the existing encounterid on which the future dated lab is added is documented in the ordencounterid column in the same table).

columns.name: Itemid
columns.description: This column stores the ID of the item/lab added for the patient. This column refers to the itemid column from the items table.

columns.name: reason
columns.description: This column stores the reason for which a lab test is ordered or received, selected from the drop-down list by the end user. This column refers to the itemName column from the items table.

columns.name: received
columns.description: This column stores an integer that indicates whether the lab result has been received (0 for not received, 1 for received).

columns.name: result
columns.description: This column stores the result of the lab test received, selected from the drop-down list by the end user. These column refers to the itemName column from the items table.

columns.name: ResultDate
columns.description: This column stores the date on which the lab results were received.

columns.name: Notes
columns.description: This column stores the free-text or selected pre-configured keywords as notes added by the end user for that particular lab of the patient.

columns.name: status
columns.description: This column stores the values 0 and 1, where 0 indicates an Open Order Status and 1 indicates a Reviewed Order Status.

columns.name: Addendum
columns.description: This column stores notes documented by the end user after lab/DI orders are marked as reviewed.

columns.name: priority
columns.description: This column stores values 0 and 1, where 1 indicates the lab order was a high-priority test and 0 indicates the lab order was not high-priority.

columns.name: assignedToid
columns.description: This column stores the identifier for the staff member assigned to the lab report (e.g., 10001, 10002, 10003).

columns.name: deleteFlag
columns.description: This column stores the value 0 or 1, which indicates whether the lab report has been deleted (0 for not deleted, 1 for deleted).

columns.name: vmid
columns.description: Column not in use

columns.name: Type
columns.description: This column stores the value 0 to indicate the test is a lab, 1 to indicate the test is diagnostic imaging, and 3 to indicate the test is a procedure.

columns.name: Billable
columns.description: This column stores the value 0 or 1, where 1 indicates the lab is in-house and 0 indicates the lab is not in-house.

columns.name: displayIndex
columns.description: This column includes the display order of the lab test in the user interface (e.g., 1, 2, 3).

columns.name: fromLabid
columns.description: This column stores an ID of the lab interface from which the lab results are received. This column refers to the id column from the lablist table. The value 0 is stored when a result is not received from any electronic interface.

columns.name: collDate
columns.description: This column stores the date when the sample was collected (e.g., 2021-08-31).

columns.name: collTime
columns.description: This column stores the time when the sample was collected (e.g., 14:30:00).

columns.name: tolabid
columns.description: This column stores an ID of the lab interface to which the lab order is transmitted. This column refers to the id column from the lablist table. The value 0 displays when the lab order is not transmitted through an electronic interface.

columns.name: billClient
columns.description: This column stores a value that indicates whether the client should be billed for the lab test (0 for no, 1 for yes).

columns.name: collSource
columns.description: This column stores the source of the test specimen collected, selected from the drop-down list by the end user. This column refers to the itemName column from the items table.

columns.name: collVolume
columns.description: This column stores the volume of the test specimen collected.

columns.name: collUnits
columns.description: This column stores the measurement unit of the volume of the test specimen collected (e.g., mL, L, Bottles).

columns.name: clinicalinfo
columns.description: This column stores clinical information about the test ordered.

columns.name: fasting
columns.description: This column stores values 0 and 1, where 1 indicates that the order required the patient to fast and 0 indicates that the patient was not required to fast.

columns.name: billType
columns.description: This column stores the flags C and N, where C indicates that an order has to be billed to the client and N indicates that the order does not have to be billed to the client.

columns.name: Pregid
columns.description: This column stores the pregnancy ID of the patient for whom the lab order is placed. This column refers to the Pregid column from the obf_pregnancy table.

columns.name: OBFLabType
columns.description: This column stores the type of lab test for obstetrics and gynecology (e.g., 0 for routine, 1 for specialized).

columns.name: publishToPortal
columns.description: This column stores a value that indicates whether the lab report should be published to the eClinicalWorks Patient Portal (0 for no, 1 for yes).

columns.name: commonNotesFlag
columns.description: This column stores a value that indicates whether common notes are used for the lab report (e.g., N for no, Y for yes).

columns.name: futureflag
columns.description: This column stores a values that indicates whether the lab test is scheduled for a future date (0 for no, 1 for yes).

columns.name: prevencounterid
columns.description: This column stores the encounterid as the previous encounterid for which the future dated order is moved to today's date. This column refers to the encounterid column from the enc table.

columns.name: ordencounterid
columns.description: If the order is future dated order, this column stores the ID of the encounter for which the order is created. This column refers to the encounterid column from the enc table.

columns.name: FutureOrderDate
columns.description: This column stores the date when the lab test is scheduled for a future order (e.g., 2021-10-01).

columns.name: ReviewedBy
columns.description: This column stores the ID of the end user who reviews the received result for the ordered test. This column refers to the UID column from the user table.

columns.name: ReviewedDate
columns.description: This column stores the date when the lab report was reviewed (e.g., 2021-09-02).

columns.name: ReviewedTime
columns.description: This column stores the time when the lab report was reviewed (e.g., 15:30:00).

columns.name: transDate
columns.description: This column stores the date when the lab report was transferred (e.g., 2021-09-03).

columns.name: transTime
columns.description: This column stores the time when the lab report was transferred (e.g., 16:30:00).

columns.name: profileid
columns.description: This column stores the vendor sent identifier string for samples in the result received.

columns.name: IntNotes
columns.description: This column stores the free-text or selected pre-configured keywords as internal notes which could be used to communicate internally, e.g., with the nurse, MA or providers.

columns.name: HMFlag
columns.description: This column stores the flag 0 or 1, where 1 indicates when the alert is suppressed when a lab has already been performed for a patient outside of this practice, and 0 indicates otherwise.

columns.name: ccresulttolist
columns.description: This column stores a list of the last and first names of licensed providers and referring providers selected while the lab is ordered.

columns.name: ccResultToListids
columns.description: This column stores a list of the provider IDs from the ccResultToList column.

columns.name: HasACopy
columns.description: This column stores the flag 0 or 1, where 1 indicates the result is copied to other providers apart from the provider who has placed the order, and 0 indicates otherwise.

columns.name: ResultStatus
columns.description: This column stores the status of the lab result received from the vendor, where P indicates preliminary result, F indicates final result, and C indicates corrected result.

columns.name: collDescription
columns.description: This column stores the description about the specimen to be collected for the placed order.

columns.name: ordPhyName
columns.description: This column stores the last and first name of the person who ordered the lab.

columns.name: ordPhyid
columns.description: This column stores the identifier for the ordering physician (e.g., 8001, 8002, 8003).

columns.name: refPhyFlag
columns.description: This column stores the flag 0 or 1, where 0 indicates when the lab is ordered by the licensed provider and 1 indicates when the lab is ordered by referring provider/physician.

columns.name: labrefid
columns.description: This column stores the reference identifier for the lab test (e.g., LR12345).

columns.name: resultime
columns.description: This column stores the time when the lab result was obtained (e.g., 17:30:00).

columns.name: PSEHold
columns.description: This column stores a flag 0 or 1, where 1 indicates when interface transmission is allowed for futue orders and the user selects to hold the order at the LIS/vendor end and  0 indicates otherwise.

columns.name: emailSent
columns.description: This column stores a flag that indicates whether an email was sent for the lab report (0 for no, 1 for yes).

columns.name: dtEmailSent
columns.description: This column stores the date when the email was sent for the lab report (e.g., 2021-09-04).

columns.name: ActualFasting
columns.description: This column stores fasting information of the patient, where 0 inidcates fasting, 1 inidcates not fasting, and 2 inidcates not recorded.

columns.name: OrderInstructions
columns.description: This column stores the instructions for the lab test order.

columns.name: performedby
columns.description: This column stores the name of the person who performed the lab test (e.g., Jane Doe).

columns.name: hl7id1
columns.description: This column stores the first HL7 identifier for the lab test (e.g., HL70123).

columns.name: hl7id2
columns.description: This column stores the second HL7 identifier for the lab test (e.g., HL70234).

columns.name: hl7id3
columns.description: This column stores the third HL7 identifier for the lab test (e.g., HL70345).

columns.name: newcol
columns.description: Column not in use

columns.name: cancelled
columns.description: This column stores a flag that indicates whether the lab test was canceled (0 for not canceled, 1 for canceled).

columns.name: resultSentStatus
columns.description: This column stores a flag that indicates whether the lab result was sent (0 for not sent, 1 for sent).

columns.name: approvalstatus
columns.description: This column stores a flag indicating the approval status of an order, where 0 indicates no approval required, 1 inidcates approval required, 2 inidcates approved, and 3 inidcates rejected.

columns.name: SendVmsg
columns.description: This column stores a flag 0 or 1, where 1 inidcates when a message is sent for a lab and 0 inidcates otherwise.

columns.name: websync
columns.description: This column stores a flag that indicates whether the lab report was synchronized with the web portal (0 for no, 1 for yes).

columns.name: patientidentifier
columns.description: This column stores patient details that are received in the HL7 message.

columns.name: portalViewTime
columns.description: This column stores the date and time when the lab report was viewed on the eClinicalWorks Patient Portal (e.g., 2021-09-05 18:30:00).

table_description: This table stores detailed information about laboratory data reports, including the properties and values associated with each report.

columns.name: Reportid
columns.description: This column stores the ID of the received lab. This column refers to the reportid column from the labdata table.

columns.name: Propid
columns.description: This column stores an ID for each attribute in the ordered test. This column refers to the itemid column from the items table.

columns.name: Value
columns.description: This column stores the value for the attribute from the Propid column in the result received.

columns.name: importFlag
columns.description: Column is not in use

columns.name: id
columns.description: This column stores the auto-incremented primary key.

columns.name: UpdatedBy
columns.description: This column stores the ID of the provider/staff who manually updated the received results. This column refers to the UID column from the user table. If the results are received through an interface, then the value in this column is 0.

columns.name: UpdatedTime
columns.description: This column stores the current time stamp when the results are received or updated once received. The format used is YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: Testid
columns.description: This column stores the ID of the test from a device.

columns.name: flag
columns.description: This column stores data in varchar (15) format, indicating any specific flags or statuses associated with the record. Example: verified.

columns.name: resultEntrySource
columns.description: This column stores a tinyint (4) representing the source of the result entry, such as manual entry (0) or automated import (1). Example: 0.

table_description: This table stores the reference range (upper and lower limit) of a patient's lab test.

columns.name: reportid
columns.description: This column stores ID of the lab for the patient. This column refers to the reportid column in the labdata table.

columns.name: itemid
columns.description: This column stores the ID of the item added to the lab/test of the patient. This column refers to the itemid column from the items table.

columns.name: range
columns.description: This column stores the reference range of the item added to the test. This data is the consolidation of the data stored in the ValueFrom, ValueTo, and ValueUnits columns in the labranges table.

columns.name: UpdatedTime
columns.description: This column stores the time stamp in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format when a lab reference range is updated.

table_description: This table stores information about laboratory data, including report details, processing status, and sending options.

columns.name: reportid
columns.description: This column stores a primary key. This column stores the ID of the lab and refers to the reportid column in the labdata table.

columns.name: HL7ResultDate
columns.description: This column stores the result date in the Inbound Lab HL7 result message received from the vendor through the interface. The format used is YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: HL7ResultTime
columns.description: This column stores the result time in the Inbound Lab HL7 result message received from the vendor through the interface. The format used is YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: urllink
columns.description: This column stores the PACS link that is received in the Inbound Lab/DI HL7 result messaage from the vendor through the interface or that is pre-defined in the labitemkey for the interface implementation along with extra parameters (like MrnNumer, Accession id, etc.) that get added when the result is processed.

columns.name: interfacestatus
columns.description: This column stores the textual status of the lab/DI order sent or result received through the interface.

columns.name: processedresult
columns.description: This column stores the XML format data for displaying the pink paper clip.

columns.name: VisitType
columns.description: This column stores the visit type that may be received in the Inbound Lab HL7 result message from the vendor through the interface or can be inserted manually from the user interface.

columns.name: DateReceived
columns.description: This column stores the date and time when the lab/DI HL7 result message is received from the vendor through the interface. The format used is YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: resultrcvddatetime
columns.description: This column stores the date when the result is received. The format used is YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: MigrateFlag
columns.description: Column not in use

columns.name: SentOutReqNo
columns.description: This column stores the Requisition Number sent in the Outbound Lab/DI Orders HL7 message to the vendor through the Orders Generic Interface.

columns.name: facilityid
columns.description: This column stores the facility ID.  This value can come in the HL7 message and may be inserted/updated through the interface or manually. This column refers to the id column from from the edi_facilities table.

columns.name: specimenReceiveTime
columns.description: This column stores the time when the specimen (e.g., blood sample or urine sample) was received. This value can come in the HL7 message and may be inserted/updated through the interface or manually.

columns.name: specimenReceiveDate
columns.description: This column stores the date when the specimen (e.g., blood sample or urine sample) was received.  This value can come in the HL7 message and may be inserted/updated through the interface or manually. The format used is YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: isPACSLinkEnabled
columns.description: This column stores a flag 0 or 1, where 0 indicates the PACS button on the DI Result window is disabled and 1 inidcates it is enabled.  This column is updated based on a lab item key setting when a Lab/DI Inbound HL7 Order Update (ORM) message is received from the vendor through the interface.

columns.name: observationDate
columns.description: This column stores the observation date received in the Inbound Lab Results HL7 message from the vendor through the interface. The format used is YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: observationTime
columns.description: This column stores the observation time received in the Inbound Lab Results HL7 message from the vendor through the interface. The format used is YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: SpecimenActionCode
columns.description: This column stores the Specimen Action Code received in the Inbound Lab Results HL7 message from the vendor through the interface.

columns.name: PlacerGroupNumberid
columns.description: This column stores the Placer Group Number ID (unique ID) received in the Inbound Lab Results HL7 message from the vendor through the interface.

columns.name: PatientAltRace
columns.description: This column stores the race of the patient received in the Inbound Lab Results HL7 message from the vendor through the interface.

columns.name: bodysitecode
columns.description: This column stores the value of the Body Site field on the result window for DI and procedure orders only. This refers to the bodysitecode column from the bodysites table.

columns.name: ABNPrompted
columns.description: This column stores values 0 or 1 to indicate whether the Advanced Beneficiary Notice (ABN) has been prompted or not while ordering Lab or Diagnostic Imaging. 0 indicates that ABN was not prompted and 1 indicates ABN was prompted.

columns.name: ABNOption
columns.description: This column stores a value 1, 2, or 3 to indicate which option has been selected by the end user when ABN was prompted. 1 indicates I agree, bill my insurance, 2 inidcates I agree, DO NOT bill my insurance, and 3 indicates I DO NOT want these tests. These mappings are stored in the abnoptions table.

columns.name: AQRejectionReason
columns.description: This column stores the reason documented while rejecting pending orders.

columns.name: exceptionReasonid
columns.description: This column is used to store the Exception Reason ID. The default value of this column is NULL. If the encounter is not blocked for the eClinicalWorks Patient Portal, this column is set to NULL. This column refers to the exceptionReasonid column in the information_blocking_reasons table. This column stores numeric data which may increase, so it is an integer data type.

columns.name: exceptionReasonComment
columns.description: This column is used to store the reason why an encounter is restricted/blocked for the eClinicalWorks Patient Portal. As per the functionality, users can document up to 255 characters for the reason. The default value of this column is empty.

columns.name: movedOrderFlag
columns.description: This column is used to store the status of a moved order. By default, this column value is 0. The value 1 indicates the order was moved from a Current Order to a Future Order, and the value 2 indicates the order was moved from a Future Order to a different future date.

columns.name: SentOutReqNoOrdNum
columns.description: This column stores the generated requisition number. By default, this column value is 0.

columns.name: printlabid
columns.description: This column stores the same requisition number if two future orders on the same date were placed through different interfaces. The default value of this column is 0.

columns.name: SendToMode
columns.description: This column stores the mode for sending the lab report (e.g., Print, Fax, eTransmit, eTransmitOnly).

columns.name: SendToName
columns.description: This column stores the name of the recipient for the lab report (e.g., John Doe).

columns.name: SendToFaxNumber
columns.description: This column stores the fax number of the recipient for the lab report (e.g., 555-123-4567).

columns.name: FaxLogid
columns.description: This column stores the unique identifier for the fax log (e.g., 1, 2, 3) with a foreign key relation to faxlogs.Logid.

columns.name: TransmitLabid
columns.description: This column stores the unique identifier for the transmitedt lab (e.g., 1, 2, 3) with a foreign key relation to lablist.id.

columns.name: SendToStatus
columns.description: This column stores the status of sending the lab report (e.g., 1 for sent, 2 for pending, 3"for failed, and 4 for not sent).

columns.name: sendToAddressDetails
columns.description: This column stores the address details of the recipient for the lab report (e.g., 123 Main St, City, State, ZIP code).

table_description: This table stores the mappings of parent and child encounters for Labs/DIs/Procedures.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This column stores the auto-incremented primary key integer that uniquely identifies each mapping record in the table. Example: 1, 2, 3, etc.

columns.name: parentEncid
columns.description: This column stores the ID of the primary encounter. It has a default value of 0 and cannot be NULL. This column may have a foreign key relation to the encounter table's primary key (e.g., encounter.id). Example: 101, 102, 103, etc.

columns.name: childEncid
columns.description: This column stores the ID of the secondary encounter. It has a default value of 0 and cannot be NULL. This column may also have a foreign key relation to the encounter table's primary key (e.g., encounter.id). Example: 201, 202, 203, etc.

columns.name: deleteFlag
columns.description: This column stores an integer that indicates whether the mapping record has been deleted or not. A value of 0 means the record is not deleted, and a value of 1 means the record is deleted. The default value is 0.

table_description: This table stores information about various labs, their addresses, contact details, and configuration settings.

columns.name: ID
columns.description: This is an auto incremented primary key of This column .

columns.name: name
columns.description: This column stores the free text name of the new lab company from User Interface.

columns.name: deleteFlag
columns.description: This column stores value 0 / 1 indicating if the Lab Company is deleted, this is soft delete. 0 - Not Deleted , 1 -Deleted.

columns.name: LabId
columns.description: This column stores information of configured interface ID which will decide on transmission of order/results. This column refers to interfaceID column in labgateway table.

columns.name: labaddress
columns.description: This column stores the free text address of the lab company.

columns.name: labaddress2
columns.description: This column stores the free text address of the lab company.

columns.name: labcity
columns.description: This column stores the free text address city of the lab company.

columns.name: labstate
columns.description: This column stores the free text address state of the lab company.

columns.name: labzip
columns.description: This column stores the free text address zip code of the lab company.

columns.name: labphone
columns.description: This column stores the telephone number of the lab company.

columns.name: labfax
columns.description: This column stores the fax number of the lab company.

columns.name: labemail
columns.description: This column stores the email ID of the lab company.

columns.name: interfaceConfigured
columns.description: This column stores value 0/1/2 indicating electronic interface configuration type. 0 - No electronic interface , 1 - Only inbound result interface, 2 - Bidirectional interface.

columns.name: sendoutboundresult
columns.description: This column stores value 0/1 indicating send outbound result. 0 - Not send outbound result, 1- Send outbound result.

columns.name: ResultLabId
columns.description: This column stores configured interface ID for result processing. This column refers to interfaceID column in labgateway table.

columns.name: labcompanyType
columns.description: This column stores value 0/1 indicating lab company type. 0 - Lab , 1 - DI.

columns.name: inHouseLab
columns.description: This column stores value 0 / 1 indicating whether the lab company is In-House or an outside lab company. 0 - Outside , 1 -In-House.

columns.name: labCode
columns.description: This column stores the code used for part of the key to encryption / decryption for data transmission to hubs.

columns.name: superhubInterfaceID
columns.description: This column stores master interface id for this vendor at eclinicalworks.

columns.name: RepoBuildStatus
columns.description: This column stores Repo Build status

columns.name: defaultTransmitMode
columns.description: This column stores default transmit mode for an order

columns.name: cirrusPractId
columns.description: Unique identifier for the Cirrus practice associated with the lab (e.g., 500, 600, 700).

columns.name: faxDialingCountryId
columns.description: Unique identifier for the country code used for fax dialing (e.g., 1, 44, 61). Foreign key relation: References `countrycodes` table's `id` column.

table_description: This table stores information about lab lot numbers, including details about the manufacturer, expiry date, number of doses, dosage, and doses remaining for each lot number.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This is an auto incremented primary key of this column.

columns.name: lotNumber
columns.description: This column stores the lot number.

columns.name: manufacturer
columns.description: This column stores manufacturer item.

columns.name: ExpiryDate
columns.description: The expiry date of the lab item. Example: 2022-12-31, 2023-01-01.

columns.name: NoOfDoses
columns.description: The total number of doses available in the lab item. Example: 100, 200.

columns.name: Dosage
columns.description: The dosage amount for each dose of the lab item. Example: 10mg, 5ml.

columns.name: DosesRemaining
columns.description: The number of doses remaining in the lab item. Example: 50, 75.

columns.name: Facilityid
columns.description: This column is used to store facilitiy id of the edi_facilities table as reference.

columns.name: deleteflag
columns.description: This column stores the delete flag. It�ll be set to 1 if entry is deleted, otherwise 0.

table_description: This table stores information about laboratory reports for various medical encounters.

columns.name: Encounterid
columns.description: This column stores the unique identifier for a specific medical encounter. It is an integer value and cannot be NULL. Example: 12345.

columns.name: Itemid
columns.description: This column stores the unique identifier for a specific laboratory test item. It is an integer value and cannot be NULL. Example: 6789.

columns.name: Propid
columns.description: This column stores the unique identifier for a specific property of the laboratory test item. It is an integer value and cannot be NULL. Example: 9876.

columns.name: Value
columns.description: This column stores the value of the specific property for the laboratory test item. It is a string with a maximum length of 255 characters and can be NULL. Example: Positive.

table_description: This table stores parsed lab results of a patient.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This column is a primary key of this column and is set to auto increment.

columns.name: encounterid
columns.description: This column stores id of the encounter of a Patient for which lab result is received. This column refers to column encounterid from enc table.

columns.name: result
columns.description: This column stores parsed result of the received lab along with the HTML tags.

columns.name: deleteFlag
columns.description: This is a small integer column that indicates whether the lab result has been deleted or not. A value of 0 means the lab result is not deleted, and a value of 1 means the lab result is deleted. Example: 0 or 1.

table_description: This table stores list of location for laceration documentations

columns.name: id
columns.description:
This is an auto increment column. This column  stores the item names which is preshipped with the itemid as 0.
Once the lacerationSqlMigration.jsp is executed, it will add all the preshipped entries in the items table and the generated itemids will be updated in the itemid column.

columns.name: name
columns.description: This column will store the name of the item which is preshipped and will created after running lacerationSqlMigration.jsp. The size is varchar(100)

columns.name: itemid
columns.description: This column is preshipped as 0 . Once the lacerationSqlMigration.jsp is executed, it will add all the preshipped entries( in the name column) in items table and the generated itemids will be updated in the itemid column.

table_description: This table stores information about the location and details of laceration wounds for each encounter and item.

columns.name: encounterid
columns.description: This column stores the encounterid which references the encounterid column in enc table. It has size of int(11).

columns.name: itemid
columns.description: This stores the itemid . It has size of int(11). It references itemid column of items table.

columns.name: woundno
columns.description: For every item (Scalp, Head etc) present in Laceration Repair category of Procedures  when itemkey 'IsLacerationEnabled' is enabled, user can create multiple wounds. This number will increase by 1 count with evry new wound added. It is of size tinyint(4).

columns.name: woundname
columns.description: This column is used to store the wound name for the wounds created for the items. It has size of varchar(100).

columns.name: deleteflag
columns.description: This column will have value as 1 if the wound is deleted.  Default value is 0.

table_description: This table stores information about laceration procedures and their associated billing codes.

columns.name: encounterid
columns.description: This column stores the unique identifier for the encounter (e.g., 12345) during which the laceration procedure took place. It is an integer and serves as a part of the primary key for the table. It may have a foreign key relation to the `encounter` table, specifically the `id` column.

columns.name: billingid
columns.description: This column stores the unique identifier for the billing record (e.g., 67890) associated with the laceration procedure. It is an integer and serves as a part of the primary key for the table. It has foreign key relation to the `billingdata` table, specifically the `id` column.

columns.name: cptcode
columns.description: This column stores the Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) code (e.g., "12001") for the laceration procedure. It is a variable character string with a maximum length of 30 characters.

columns.name: cptid
columns.description: This column stores the unique identifier for the CPT code (e.g., 98765) associated with the laceration procedure. It is an integer and may have a foreign key relation to the `edi_cptcodes` table, specifically the `itemid` column.

table_description: This table stores the complete information of the attorney.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier for each law firm (e.g., 1, 2, 3). This is the primary key for the table.

columns.name: FirmName
columns.description: The name of the law firm (e.g., "Smith & Associates", "Johnson Law Group").

columns.name: Address1
columns.description: The first line of the law firm's street address (e.g., "123 Main St").

columns.name: Address2
columns.description: The second line of the law firm's street address, if applicable (e.g., "Suite 200").

columns.name: City
columns.description: The city where the law firm is located (e.g., "New York", "Los Angeles").

columns.name: State
columns.description: The state where the law firm is located (e.g., "New York", "California").

columns.name: Zip
columns.description: The zip code of the law firm's address (e.g., "10001", "90001").

columns.name: ContactPerson
columns.description: The name of the primary contact person at the law firm (e.g., "John Smith", "Jane Doe").

columns.name: Phone1
columns.description: The primary phone number for the law firm (e.g., "(555) 123-4567").

columns.name: Phone2
columns.description: The secondary phone number for the law firm, if applicable (e.g., "(555) 987-6543").

columns.name: ContactDetails
columns.description: Additional contact information for the law firm, such as an email address (e.g., "info@smithlaw.com").

columns.name: Notes
columns.description: A blob field for storing any additional notes or comments about the law firm.

table_description: This table stores information about various attributes and their values for patients and their encounters.

columns.name: Id
columns.description: Unique identifier for each record in the table. Example: 1, 2, 3.

columns.name: patientid
columns.description: Unique identifier for the patient. Example: 101, 102, 103.

columns.name: encounterId
columns.description: Unique identifier for the patient's encounter. Example: 1001, 1002, 1003.

columns.name: ptage
columns.description: Age of the patient at the time of the encounter. Example: 25, 30, 35.

columns.name: Attributid
columns.description: Identifier for the attribute. Example: 'height', 'weight', 'smoking_status'.

columns.name: Value
columns.description: Value of the attribute as a string. Example: '5ft 6in', '150 lbs', 'non-smoker'.

columns.name: numericvalue
columns.description: Numeric value of the attribute, if applicable. Example: 5, 10, 15.

columns.name: bpsystolicvalue
columns.description: Systolic blood pressure value, if applicable. Example: 120, 130, 140.

columns.name: bpdystolicvalue
columns.description: Diastolic blood pressure value, if applicable. Example: 80, 85, 90.

columns.name: pcpid
columns.description: Unique identifier for the primary care provider. Example: 201, 202, 203.

columns.name: pcgid
columns.description: Unique identifier for the primary care group. Example: 301, 302, 303.

columns.name: gender
columns.description: Gender of the patient. Example: 'male', 'female', 'other'.

columns.name: race
columns.description: Race of the patient. Example: 'Caucasian', 'African American', 'Asian'.

columns.name: ethnicity
columns.description: Ethnicity of the patient. Example: 'Hispanic', 'Non-Hispanic', 'Unknown'.

columns.name: lang
columns.description: Language spoken by the patient. Example: 'English', 'Spanish', 'Chinese'.

columns.name: scheduledJobFlag
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the record is part of a scheduled job (1) or not (0). Example: 1, 0.

table_description: This table stores information related to lockbox transactions, including payment details, status, and associated images.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier for each record in the table (e.g., 1, 2, 3).

columns.name: Batchid
columns.description: identifier for the batch that the transaction belongs to (e.g., 101, 102, 103).

columns.name: DateCreated
columns.description: Date and time when the record was created (e.g., '2021-08-01 12:34:56').

columns.name: DateModified
columns.description: Date and time when the record was last modified (e.g., '2021-08-02 14:56:23').

columns.name: AccountNumber
columns.description: Account number associated with the transaction (e.g., '1234567890').

columns.name: AmountDue
columns.description: Amount due for the transaction (e.g., '100.00').

columns.name: PmtAmt
columns.description: Payment amount for the transaction (e.g., '100.00').

columns.name: PatientName
columns.description: Name of the patient associated with the transaction (e.g., 'John Doe').

columns.name: PmtMethod
columns.description: Payment method used for the transaction (e.g., 'Credit Card', 'Check').

columns.name: PmtType
columns.description: Payment type for the transaction (e.g., 'Full', 'Partial').

columns.name: CheckNum
columns.description: Check number, if applicable (e.g., '12345678').

columns.name: Status
columns.description: Status code for the transaction (e.g., 0 for pending, 1 for completed, 2 for failed).

columns.name: reason
columns.description: Text description of the reason for the transaction status (e.g., 'Payment successful', 'Insufficient funds').

columns.name: Transid
columns.description: Unique identifier for the transaction (e.g., 'T123456789').

columns.name: TransDate
columns.description: Date of the transaction (e.g., '2021-08-01').

columns.name: Paymentid
columns.description: Unique identifier for the payment (e.g., 1001, 1002, 1003).

columns.name: img_reason
columns.description: Text description of the reason for the image status (e.g., 'Image uploaded successfully', 'Image not found').

columns.name: img_status
columns.description: Status code for the image associated with the transaction (e.g., 0 for pending, 1 for completed, 2 for failed).

columns.name: vendorUser
columns.description: Username of the vendor user associated with the transaction (e.g., 'vendorUser1').

columns.name: processFlow
columns.description: Text description of the process flow for the transaction (e.g., 'Step 1: Payment received, Step 2: Payment processed').

table_description: This table stores information about the mapping between locations and their surface types, conditions, and stadium types, which are used for the activity calendar module.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This is the primary key for the table, and it is an auto-incrementing integer. It uniquely identifies each record in the table. Example: 1, 2, 3, etc.

columns.name: locationcode
columns.description: Unique location code is assigned to each location when they are created using the user interface. This column is getting referred to in activitydetailinfo table in the form of the 'code' column.

columns.name: surfacecode
columns.description: This column stores ID of surface information to get associated with 'activitydetailinfo' table.

columns.name: surfacetypecode
columns.description: This column stores ID of surface type information to get associated with 'activitydetailinfo' table.

columns.name: deleteflag
columns.description: This column stores values 0 or 1 to indicate whether the item has been marked as deleted or not. 0 - Item is not marked deleted, 1 - Item is marked deleted.

columns.name: conditiontypecode
columns.description: This column stores ID of condition type information to get associated with 'activitydetailinfo' table.

columns.name: stadiumtypecode
columns.description: This column stores ID of stadium type information to get associated with 'activitydetailinfo' table.

table_description: This table stores information about different log sections, including their names, comments, and related log table data.

columns.name: id
columns.description: An integer that serves as the primary key and auto-incrementing identifier for each log section. Example: 1, 2, 3, etc.

columns.name: sectionName
columns.description: A varchar(128) field that stores the unique name of the log section. Example: "UserActivity", "SystemEvents", etc.

columns.name: comments
columns.description: A varchar(255) field that stores any additional comments or descriptions about the log section. This field has a default value of an empty string. Example: "Logs user login and logout events", "Stores system error messages", etc.

columns.name: logTableid
columns.description: An integer that serves as a foreign key, referencing the `id` column in the `log_table`. This field establishes a relationship between the log section and the log table it belongs to. Example: 1, 2, 3, etc.

columns.name: isAdminLog
columns.description: A tinyint(1) field that indicates whether the log section is for admin logs or not. A value of '1' means it is an admin log, and '0' means it is not. Example: 0 (not an admin log), 1 (admin log).

columns.name: deleteFlag
columns.description: A tinyint(1) field that indicates whether the log section has been marked for deletion or not. A value of '1' means it is marked for deletion, and '0' means it is not. Example: 0 (not marked for deletion), 1 (marked for deletion).

table_description: This table stores lot numbers and other related information about immunizations.

columns.name: Id
columns.description: This is an auto incremental primary key of This column .

columns.name: lotnumber
columns.description: This column is used to store lot number

columns.name: manufacturer
columns.description: It is used to store manufacturer's name

columns.name: VISDate
columns.description: This column stores Immunization VIS date in 'yyyy-mm-dd' format

columns.name: ExpiryDate
columns.description: This column stores lot number expiry date in 'yyyy-mm-dd' format

columns.name: deleteflag
columns.description: This column stores value 0 / 1 indicating whether entry is deleted. This is soft delete. 0 - Not Deleted , 1 -Deleted

columns.name: NoOfDoses
columns.description: This column is used to store number of doses a lot has

columns.name: VaccineId
columns.description: This column stores Vaccine Id. It refers to vaccineid of lot_immunizations table

columns.name: dosage
columns.description: It is used to store dosage for a lot

columns.name: GovSupplied
columns.description: This flag is used to indicate whether a lot is government supplied. Possible values for this are n, y, u etc

columns.name: DosesRemaining
columns.description: This is used to store remaining doses of the lot

columns.name: Facility
columns.description: This column stores facility id, primary key of edi_facilities table

columns.name: inactive
columns.description: It is used to store a flag to indicate whether a lot is inactive

columns.name: odhVac
columns.description: This field is dependent on ODHFields itemkey (Ohio Dept of Health). If itemkey is set to yes, displays odhVac textbox on UI to place value for the field from user.

columns.name: misc
columns.description: This field is dependent on ODHFields itemkey (Ohio Dept of Health). If itemkey is set to yes, displays misc textbox on UI to place value for the transaction misc from user.

columns.name: dosesGiven
columns.description: Its data type is int and is used to store given doses

columns.name: NdcCode
columns.description: This column is used to store NDC code, Refers to the NDC chosen at the time of Lot Number creation

columns.name: routeofAdminId
columns.description: It is used to store route of administration

columns.name: hl7id
columns.description: This column stores External Control number of a patient that is received via interface

columns.name: isSingleUse
columns.description: This flag is used to check if immunization is for single use

columns.name: immInjType
columns.description: This column store immunization type as 1 for immunization or 2 for injection

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier for each record in the table (int).

columns.name: Practitioner
columns.description: Box number 23 which indicates if the service provider is a practitioner (char). Example values: 'X', ''.

columns.name: Dental
columns.description: Box number 24 which indicates if the service is related to dental care (char). Example values: 'X', ''.

columns.name: LabXRay
columns.description: Box number 25 which indicates if the service is related to lab or X-ray (char). Example values: 'X', ''.

columns.name: MedEquip
columns.description: Box number 26 which indicates if the service is related to medical equipment (char). Example values: 'X', ''.

columns.name: Transportation
columns.description: Box number 28 which indicates if the service is related to transportation (char). Example values: 'X', ''.

columns.name: InvId
columns.description: This column stores the claim number against which this form is generated. This column is of type integer and length 11 with default value as NULL. Value if from edi_invoice table.

columns.name: MemberName
columns.description: Box number 1 which stores  the recipient's (patient's) First, Middle and Last Name. This is VARCHAR(40) column with NULL value allowed

columns.name: RecipientIdNo
columns.description: This is a varchar column which allow max 20 chars. This column allow NULL value and default value is ''.

columns.name: PtDob
columns.description: This is a varchar column which stores Patient's DOB and stores max 10 chars. It stores DOB in MMDDYY format. Example: It will store 121172 for Dec 11, 1972

columns.name: PtSexM
columns.description: Box number 3 which indicates patient is Male if value is store as 'X'. This column is type of char(1). Example values: 'X', ''.

columns.name: PtSexF
columns.description: Box number 3 which indicates patient is Female if value is store as 'X'. This column is type of char(1). Example values: 'X', ''.

columns.name: CondRelEmpY
columns.description: Box number 4(A) which indicates if the condition is related to employment and store as 'X'. This column is type of char(1). Example values: 'X', ''.

columns.name: CondRelEmpN
columns.description: Box number 4(A) which indicates if the condition is not related to employment and store as 'X'. This column is type of char(1). Example values: 'X', ''.

columns.name: CondRelAccY
columns.description: Box number 4(B) which indicates if the condition is related to accident and store as 'X'. This column is type of char(1). Example values: 'X', ''.

columns.name: CondRelAccN
columns.description: Box number 4(B) which indicates if the condition is not related to accident and store as 'X'. This column is type of char(1). Example values: 'X', ''.

columns.name: MedicaidNo
columns.description: Box number 5 which indicates patient's bill to insurance's Subscriber Number. This column is type of varchar(25). Value is from edi_inv_insurance table's subscriberNo column against invoiceId

columns.name: MedicareHICNo
columns.description: Box number 6 which indicates Subscriber Number if insurance is primary and superbill is primary medicare. This column is type of varchar(30). Value is from edi_inv_insurance table's subscriberNo column against invoiceId

columns.name: PtRelSelf
columns.description: Box number 7(SELF) which indicates if the patient is the policyholder and store as 'X'. This column is type of char(1). Example values: 'X', ''.

columns.name: PtRelSpouse
columns.description: Box number 7(SPOUSE) which indicates if the patient is the spouse of the policyholder and store as 'X'. This column is type of char(1). Example values: 'X', ''.

columns.name: PtRelChild
columns.description: Box number 7(CHILD) which indicates if the patient is the child of the policyholder and store as 'X'. This column is type of char(1). Example values: 'X', ''.

columns.name: PtRelOther
columns.description: Box number 7(OTHER) which indicates if the patient has another relationship to the policyholder and store as 'X'. This column is type of char(1). Example values: 'X', ''.

columns.name: PtSignature
columns.description: Box number 8 which stores patient's signature. This column is type of varchar(30). If data present against invoiceId in 'edi_inv_claimdata' table then it will store 'Signature On File'. Example: 'Signature On File', ''.

columns.name: PtSigDate
columns.description: Box number 8 which stores date of patient's signature. This column is type of varchar(10). Value of 'RelInfoDate' column from table 'edi_inv_claimdata' if data present against invoiceId. Date format is Mmddyy. Example: '121123', ''.

columns.name: RefPrName
columns.description: It stores the referring provider name. This column is type of varchar(50). Value of 'refProvId' column from table 'edi_inv_claimdata' if data present against invoiceId and find provider name for this. Example: 'Willis Sam', ''.

columns.name: RefPrNPI
columns.description: It stores the referring provider NPI. This column is type of varchar(40). Value of 'refProvNPI' column from table 'edi_inv_claimdata' if data present against invoiceId. Example: '1234567890', ''.

columns.name: AnotherHBPY
columns.description: Box number 9 which indicates if the patient has another health benefit plan and store as 'X'. This column is type of char(1). Example values: 'X', ''.

columns.name: AnotherHBPN
columns.description: Box number 9 which indicates if the patient does not have another health benefit plan and store as 'X'. This column is type of char(1). Example values: 'X', ''.

columns.name: PolicyGrpNumber
columns.description: Box number 9 which stores the policy group number. This column is type of varchar(45). Value of 'groupNo' column from table 'edi_inv_insurance'. Example: '1234567890', ''.

columns.name: InsuredName
columns.description: Box number 9 which stores the insured's name. This column is type of varchar(60). Value of 'GrId' column from table 'edi_inv_insurance'. Example: 'John Doe', ''.

columns.name: InsurancePlan
columns.description: Box number 9 which stores the insurance name. This column is type of varchar(60). Value of 'InsId' column from table 'edi_inv_insurance'. Example: 'Medicare', ''.

table_description: This table stores the configuration for CDSS measures.

columns.description: This column stores an id of the CDSS measure. This is alphanumeric and it refers column Measureid from measuredefinitions table.

columns.name: Disabled
columns.description: This column indicates if the measure is disable or enabled. 0 - Enabled and 1 - Disabled.

columns.name: Dictionary
columns.description:
This column indicates an id of the dictionary to which this measure is linked. Possible values are - TCNY(1),
DOC_NYC(2),
RI(3),
PQRI(7),
CGHN(8),
MCMP(4),
LMM(5),
BAYLOR(6),
EHEARTS(9),
MEANINGFUL_USE(10),
POINT_OF_CARE(11);

columns.name: NumeratorElement
columns.description: This column indicates what codes can be used to satisfy the alert. This column refers to column Name in CDSS_codes table.

columns.name: NumeratorElementType
columns.description: This column is linked to NumeratorElement column. Possible values are Lab or DI or Immunization.

columns.description: This column stores an id of the user who modifies the alert. This column refers column UID from user table.

columns.name: eddate
columns.description: This column stores the date when the alert was modified. The format used is YYYY-MM-DD 00:00:000.

table_description: This table stores the definitions for CDSS measures.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This column is auto incremented and primary key of This column .

columns.name: Dictionary
columns.description:
This column indicates an id of the dictionary to which this measure is linked. Possible values are:
    [ 1 - TCNY (Take Care New York - the default set of CDSS Measures) ], 
    [ 2 - New York City Department of Corrections ], 
    [ 3 - Rhode Island ], 
    [ 4 - MCMP (No longer used) ], 
    [ 5 - LMM ( No longer used) ], 
    [ 6 - Baylor ], 
    [ 7 - PQRI (Physician Quality Reporting Initiative - no longer used) ], 
    [ 8 - CGHN (Central Georgia Health Network) ], 
    [ 9 - eHearts ], 
    [ 10 - Meaningful Use (No longer used) ], 
    [ 11 - Point of Care (healow Insights) ]

columns.name: Measureid

columns.name: MeasureName

columns.name: MeasureDesc
columns.description: A description of the Measure.

columns.name: MeasureNum
columns.description: A description of the Measure's numerator (i.e. the criteria by which a patient is judged to be compliant with the Measure).

columns.name: MeasureDen
columns.description: A description of the Measure's denominator (i.e. the criteria by which the Measure is deemed relevant to a patient).

columns.name: Deleteflag
columns.description: 1 if the Measure is deleted, 0 otherwise.

columns.name: CDSSEnabled
columns.description: (Column no longer in use)

columns.name: measureidlabel
columns.description: A label for the Measure.

columns.name: NumMeasurePeriodDays
columns.description: (Column no longer in use)

columns.name: DenMeasurePeriodDays
columns.description: (Column no longer in use)

columns.name: NumInclMeasurePeriodDays
columns.description: (Column no longer in use)

columns.name: groupid
columns.description: (Column no longer in use)

columns.name: measureref
columns.description: The name of the reference file attached to the Measure.

columns.name: citation
columns.description: The bibliographic citation for the reference study associated with the Measure.

columns.name: developer
columns.description: The creator of the Measure.

columns.name: fundingSource
columns.description: The source of funding for the reference study associated with the Measure.

columns.name: releaseVersion
columns.description: The version number/date of the Measure.

columns.name: exclusions
columns.description: A description of the Measure's exclusions (i.e. criteria by which the Measure is deemed irrelevant to a patient).

table_description: This table stores information about various milestones achieved by patients.

columns.name: Milestoneid
columns.description: The unique identifier for each milestone record. Examples include: 1, 2, 3, etc.

columns.name: MilestoneName
columns.description: The name of the milestone (e.g., 'First Steps', 'Speech Development', etc.).

columns.name: MilestoneDesc
columns.description: The description of the milestone. Examples include: 'Patient took their first steps', 'Patient started speaking words', etc.

columns.description: Unique identifier for the patient associated with the milestone. This is a foreign key that refers to the `pid` column in the `patient` table. Example: 101, 102, 103, etc.

columns.name: Created
columns.description: The timestamp of when the milestone record was created. Examples include: '2021-08-01 12:34:56'.

columns.name: Userid
