columns.description: This column is used to identify unique records. It is an auto incremented primary key of This column . Data type is int. This field doesn't allow NULL value.

columns.name: encounterid
columns.description: This is a foreign key column. It refers to primary key column encounterid of enc table. The data type of this column is INT and it does not allow a NULL value.

columns.name: importedNotes
columns.description: This column stores the imported notes. This column can have large data as it stores the notes added by the user, hence the data type is varchar(MAX). It can never have a NULL value hence declared as NOT NULL.

columns.name: notes
columns.description: This column stores the additional notes. This column can have large data as it stores the notes added by the user, hence the data type is varchar(MAX). It can never have a NULL value hence declared as NOT NULL.

columns.name: modifiedBy
columns.description: This is a foreign key column.It refers to primary key column UID of user table. This column stores the id of user who modified the record last. The data type of this column is INT and it does not allow a NULL value.

columns.name: createdDateTime
columns.description: Contains date time when the record was created and datatype is DATETIME. This column stores datetime hence the data type is DATETIME. This column cannot have a NULL value.

columns.name: modifiedDateTime
columns.description: Contains date time when the record was last modified and datatype is DATETIME. This column stores datetime hence the data type is DATETIME. This column cannot have a NULL value.

columns.name: deleteflag
columns.description:
This flag indicates that this record has been deleted or not, datatype is TINYINT. This column stores an integer value hence tinyint is selected.�
Values - 0: Not Deleted 1: Deleted.�
By default, record must not be in delete status hence default 0 is chosen.

table_description:
This table stores the mapping between devices, and the problems (ICD Codes) they are facing for a patient.
 When the user wants to prescribe one or more devices for a patient in RPM, he has to select one or more ICD codes from the patient problem list to map with that device.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Contains auto incremented id, datatype is INT. This column stores integer value which could grow with number of problem device mappings added and hence integer is selected. It is AUTO_INCREMENT column and has PRIMARY KEY index.

columns.name: patientid
columns.description: Contains patientid which is referenced using the Primary Key column UID of user table. It stores the unique id of a Patient and data type is INT. This field will always have a value hence defined as NOT NULL

columns.name: deviceid
columns.description: Contains patientid which is referenced using the Primary Key column UID of user table. It stores the unique id of a Patient and data type is INT. This field will always have a value hence defined as NOT NULL

columns.name: tracker_mapping_id
columns.description:
Contains tracker_mapping_id which is referenced by the Primary Key column id of rpm_device_tracker_mapping table to link the device with Tracker Type and data type is INT.  
This field will always have a value hence defined as NOT NULL.

columns.name: ICDCode
columns.description: This column stores the problem linked to prescribed device and the data type is VARCHAR(60). This column stores characters which cannot exceed 60 characters hence VARCHAR(60) is selected .This field can have a NULL value. The default value of this field is Blank String.

columns.name: itemid
columns.description: This column stores the Primary Key of items table which manages all the ICD Codes.Contains itemid value which is referenced from itemid column od items table and data type is INT. This field will always have a value hence defined as NOT NULL.

columns.name: modifiedBy
columns.description: This column stores the Provider id who has modified the record last and data type is INT. Contains modifiedBy value which is referenced from UID column of user table. This field will always have a value hence defined as NOT NULL.

columns.name: modifiedDatetime
columns.description: This column stores the Date Time when the record was last modified and data type is DATETIME. This field will always have a value hence defined as NOT NULL.

columns.name: deleteFlag
columns.description: Flag indicates the record added is deleted, datatype is tinyint - 0 - Not Deleted, 1 - Deleted. This field will always have a value hence defined as NOT NULL. By default, this column should not be in Deleted status hence default 0 is chosen.

columns.name: rpm_enrollment_id
columns.description: This column contains enrollmentid value referenced from id column of the�rpm_enrollment_details table, datatype is INT. This field will always have a value hence defined as NOT NULL.

table_description: This table maintains all the devices from different vendors which can be allocated to RPM patients. Healow supports/tracks different trackers. Different devices are availble to track steps,sleep,BMI,glucose etc. This table maintains a list of all supported devices by healow along with the vendor information. The data structure of this table is designed in reference to the healow tables.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Contains auto incremented id, datatype is INT(11). This column stores integer value which could grow with number of supported devices added over the years hence integer(Range: 0-2,147,483,647) is selected. It is AUTO_INCREMENT column and has PRIMARY KEY index.

columns.name: device_id
columns.description: This column stores a unique device id which is used downstream to identify the device and its information.The datatype chosen is int. This column stores high range numeric value hence integer is selected and this field will always have a value hence defined as NOT NULL.The device_id value is always unique and hence unique constraint UX_rpm_supported_devices_list_device_id is added to eliminate any duplicate device id's

columns.name: deviceName
columns.description:
This column stores the device name which is primarily used for display purposes. The datatype chosen is VARCHAR(255). This column stores characters which cannot exceed 255 characters and hence VARCHAR (255) is selected.

This field will always have a value hence defined as NOT NULL .

columns.name: vendor_id
columns.description: This column is FOREIGN KEY which refers to id column  of rpm_vendors_list table that indicates which device belong to particular vendor.The data type chosen is int. This column stores high range numeric value hence integer is selected and this field will always have a value hence defined as NOT NULL.

columns.name: device_description
columns.description: This column is for giving description of particular device like what is use of given device or other related information its a VARCHAR(MAX). As the column has no limit and we have free text, therefore we have defined it as VARCHAR(MAX) / TEXT.There is no default value for this column.

columns.name: deleteFlag
columns.description: Flag indicates if this device is deleted or not, datatype is TINYINT. This column stores binary flag i.e 0/1. Datatype can be changed to TinyInt. 0: not deleted 1: deleted - By default user must not be in deleted status hence default 0 is chosen.

columns.name: cellular_device
columns.description: Flag indicates if this device is cellular or not, datatype is TINYINT. This column stores binary flag i.e 0/1. 0: not cellular 1: cellular.

table_description: This table stores information about remote patient monitoring (RPM) vendors, their display names, supported modalities, and other related attributes.

columns.name: id
columns.description:
Contains auto incremented id, datatype is INT(11). This column stores integer value which could grow with number of RPM vendors added over time and hence integer(Range: 0-2,147,483,647) is selected

. It is AUTO_INCREMENT column and has PRIMARY KEY index.

columns.name: name
columns.description:
Contains the name of the vendor and the data type is VARCHAR(255). This column stores characters which cannot exceed 255 characters hence VARCHAR(255) is selected. This field will always have a value hence defined as NOT NULL.

This field must have a unique name hence UNIQUE constraint UX_rpm_vendors_list_name� is added.

columns.name: vendor_display_name
columns.description:
Contains the display name of the vendor and the datatype is VARCHAR(255). This column stores characters which cannot exceed 255 characters hence VARCHAR(255) is selected

This field will always have a value hence defined as NOT NULL.

columns.name: modality
columns.description: This column contains the modality of the vendor.Vendors send data either through API's into healow which is passed to EMR or the readings are accessed through the PDF. Some of the vendors support both API/PDF. Hence the classification. The data type chosen for this column is VARCHAR(20). This field will always have a value hence defined as NOT NULL with Default value API.Since the column value does not exceed 20 characters VARCHAR(20) is selected. The modality can have values ('PDF','API','BOTH') only and hence CHECK constraint CHK_rpm_vendors_list_name is added.

columns.name: isLinked
columns.description:
This column specifies if the vendor is linked and data type is TINYINT. This field will always have a value hence defined as NOT NULL with Default value 0. 

This column could contain two columns�
0- If the vendor is not linked on healow�
1- If the vendor is linked on healow�

columns.name: deleteFlag
columns.description: Flag indicates vendor is Deleted or not, datatype is tinyint - 0: not deleted 1: deleted. This field will always have a value hence defined as NOT NULL. By default, vendor should not be in inactive status hence default 0 is chosen.

columns.name: support_cellular_device
columns.description: This column stores a boolean value (0 or 1) indicating whether the RPM vendor supports cellular devices or not. For example: 0 for not supporting cellular devices, 1 for supporting cellular devices.

table_description: This table stores temporary information related to CCM and RPM billing eligible patients for selected billing month.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Contains auto incremented id, datatype is INT (11). This column stores integer value which could grow with number of transactions over the years hence integer(Range: 0-2,147,483,647) is selected. It is AUTO_INCREMENT column and has PRIMARY KEY index

columns.name: patientid
columns.description: This column stores unique id of a Patient which references the UID column of the user table. The data type chosen is INT. This column allows a NULL value.

columns.name: batchid
columns.description: This column stores unique id of a phm billing batch which references the id column of the ccm_batch table. The data type chosen is INT. This column allows a NULL value.

columns.name: batchDate
columns.description: This column stores date when the phm billing batch is run. The data type chosen is DATE. This column allows a NULL value.

columns.name: strData
columns.description: This column stores json object which contains details eligible patients for rpm ccm concurrent billing.

table_description: This table stores information about prescription dispense summaries, including details about the prescription order, item, status, and dispensing and cancellation events of medications ordered from Inventory.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This is the auto-incremented primary key in This column .

columns.name: RxOrderNo
columns.description: This column stores the order number of medications prescribed from inventory. It refers to rxOrderNo from oldrxmain table.

columns.name: RxItemId
columns.description: This column stores the item id for medications prescribed from Inventory. This refers to itemid of items table.

columns.name: RxNDCCode
columns.description: This column stores the National Drug Code (NDC) of the documented drug.

columns.name: RxStatus
columns.description: This column stores the status of medications i.e. Start, Stop etc. This refers to DoctorsFlag column of OldRxMain table.

columns.name: DispensedDate
columns.description: This column stores the medication dispensed date. The format used is MM/DD/YYYY.

columns.name: DispensedBy
columns.description: This column stores the details of user who dispensed the medication from Inventory.

columns.name: DeleteFlag
columns.description: This column stores the value 0/1 indicating if a medication ordered from inventory is deleted in treatment section. 0-Not Deleted. 1-Deleted.

columns.name: UserId
columns.description: This column stores the userid of the user who orders a medication from Inventory. This corresponds to userid of user table.

columns.name: inv_SaleId
columns.description: This column stores the saleId for a medication ordered from Inventory. This refers to 'Id' column of 'inventory_sale' table and is updated once the claim is created successfully.

columns.name: RxEncId
columns.description: This column stores the encounter where medication is added from inventory. It corresponds to encounterID from enc table.

columns.name: CancelledDate
columns.description: Date and time when the prescription was cancelled. Example: '2021-08-03 16:00:00', '2021-08-04 11:15:00'.

columns.name: CancelledBy
columns.description: Name of the person who cancelled the prescription. Example: 'John Doe', 'Jane Smith'.

columns.name: CancelReasonId
columns.description: Unique identifier for the reason the prescription was cancelled, referring to the primary key in the cancel reasons table (not provided). Example: 1 (Out of Stock), 2 (Prescription Error), 3 (Patient Request).

table_description: This table stores information about medication alerts for patients, including details about the medication, the user who created the alert, and the status of the alert.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier for each medication alert record. Example: 1, 2, 3.

columns.name: itemid
columns.description: This column stores id of the medication added to the patient's encounter for which alert is set. This column refers column itemId from items table.

columns.name: encounterid
columns.description: This column stores id of the appointment which has the medication for which alert is set. This column refers column encounterId from enc table.

columns.name: rxOrderNo
columns.description: This column stores order number fior a set of medication/drug added to patient's specific encounter. This number is generated on the application side. This column refers column rxOrderNo from oldRxMain table.

columns.name: NDCCode
columns.description: This column stores the National Drug Code of the added medication/drug which has '-' hyphen in it and is always unique for any drug.

columns.name: medName
columns.description: This column stores name of the medicine/drug of the id stored in itemId column which is added as part of the treatment and on which alert is set.

columns.name: userid
columns.description: This column stores id of the Provider who is treating the Patient for whom the alert is set. This column refers column uid from user table.

columns.name: encDate
columns.description: This column stores date when the encounter was created which includes the medication for which alert is set. The format used is YYYY-MM-DD.

columns.name: encTime
columns.description: This column stores time when the encounter was created which includes the medication for which alert is set. The format used is HH-MM-SS.

columns.name: addedDateTime
columns.description: This column stores the current time stamp when the medication is added as part of the patient's treatment for which alert is created. The format used is MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: isAlertActive
columns.description: This column indicates if the created alert is active or not. 1 - alert is active, 0 - alert is inactive.

columns.name: patientid
columns.description: This column stores id of the patient for whom the alert is created. This column refers column uid from user table.

columns.name: rxComment
columns.description:
This column stores one of the below values indicating status of the medication added for the patient on which alert is created.
-4 = 'Unknown' ,
-3 = 'Discontinued',
-2 = 'Not-Taking',
-1 = 'Taking',
0 = 'Stop',
1 = 'Start',
2 = 'Continue',
3 = 'Increase',
4 = 'Decrease' .

columns.name: userName
columns.description: This column stores Last and First name of the Provider who has created the medication alert. The username stored is concatenation of ulname and ufname columns from user table.

columns.name: oldrxid
columns.description: Currently this column is not in use from This column  and hence it stores the default value i.e. 0.

columns.name: TYPE
columns.description: Type of medication alert. Example: 0 (normal), 1 (urgent).

table_description: This table stores medication comments that were created.

columns.name: Id
columns.description: This is a Primary Key of This column  and is set to auto-increment.

columns.name: name
columns.description: This column stores name of the status configured for Rx Comments by the end user in the User Interface.

columns.name: deleteFlag
columns.description: This column stores values 0 / 1 . 0 - Status configured is active and not marked as Deleted. 1 - Status configured is not active and marked as Deleted.

table_description: This column stores a patient's retrieved medication history.

columns.name: RxHubRxHistoryid
columns.description: This is a Primary Key of the table and is set to auto-increment.

columns.name: Patientid
columns.description: This column stores id of the Patient whose medication history is documented. This column refers column UID from user table.

columns.name: Encounterid
columns.description: This column stores id of the encounter of the patient for which External Rx History is retrieved. This column refers to column encounterid from enc table.

columns.name: PvdFirstName
columns.description: This column stores first name of the provider who retrieves external medication history of the patient.

columns.name: PvdMiddleName
columns.description: This column stores middle name of the provider who retrieves external medication history of the patient.

columns.name: PvdLastName
columns.description: This column stores last name of the provider who retrieves external medication history of the patient.

columns.name: PvdSuffix
columns.description: This column stores assigned suffix of the provider who retrieves medication history of the patient.

columns.name: PvdPrefix
columns.description: This column stores assigned prefix of the provider who retrieves medication history of the patient.

columns.name: NDCCode
columns.description: This column stores National Drug Code(NDC) of the documented drug.

columns.name: DrugName
columns.description: This column stores the name of the Drug added as an external medication.

columns.name: Strength
columns.description: This column stores strength of the medication from external medication history of the patient.

columns.name: StrengthUnits
columns.description: This column stores unit of strength of the medication from external medication history of the patient.

columns.name: Formulation
columns.description: This column stores an information about the form of the medicine in the retrieved external medication history of the patient.

columns.name: Quantity1
columns.description: This column stores dispense data of the medication retrieved in the external medication history.

columns.name: Quantity2
columns.description: This column stores the second quantity of the medication if present otherwise it is assigned default value.

columns.name: QuantityUnit1
columns.description: This column stores the unit of the quantity from quantity1 column.

columns.name: QuantityUnit2
columns.description: This column stores the unit of the quantity from quantity2 column.

columns.name: QuantityCode1
columns.description: This column stores the code of the quantity from the quantity1 column.

columns.name: QuantityCode2
columns.description: This column stores the code of the quantity from the quantity2 column.

columns.name: Refills
columns.description: This column stores the number of refills of the medication retrieved in the external medication history.

columns.name: Direction
columns.description: This column stores an information about how the medication was taken from the retrieved external medication history.

columns.name: LongDrugName1
columns.description: This column stores name of the drug 1 from the retrieved external medication history.

columns.name: LongDrugName2
columns.description: This column stores  name of the drug 2 from the retrieved external medication history..

columns.name: LongDrugName3
columns.description: This column stores name of the drug 3 from the retrieved external medication history..

columns.name: LastFillDate
columns.description: This columns stores the date when pharmacy fills the medication last time from the retrieved external medication history.

columns.name: MoreHistoryAvailable
columns.description: This column stores a flag 0 or 1. 1- when more medication history is available of a patient, 0 - otherwise

columns.name: RxHistoryReqDate
columns.description: This column stores request date of the medication history of a patient. The format used is YYYYMMDD.

columns.name: NCPDPid
columns.description: This column stores unique, national identifier number assigned to the pharmacies. This column refers column NCPDPid from pharmacy table.

columns.name: PharmacyName
columns.description: This column stores name of the Pharmacy who dispensed the medication.

columns.name: PharmacyCity
columns.description: This column store city name of the pharmacy documented in PharmacyName column.

columns.name: DaysSupply
columns.description: This column stores duration of the medication retrieved.

columns.name: SourceName
columns.description: This column stores name of the source, it could be : Pharmacy or PBM.

columns.name: writtendate
columns.description: Date the prescription was written. (e.g., "2021-01-01", "2021-06-15")

columns.name: primaryDiagnosisCode
columns.description: Primary diagnosis code associated with the prescription. (e.g., "I10", "E11.9", "J06.9")

columns.name: primaryDiagnosisQualifier
columns.description: Qualifier for the primary diagnosis code. (e.g., "ICD-10", "ICD-9")

columns.name: primaryDiagnosisDescription
columns.description: Description of the primary diagnosis. (e.g., "Essential (primary) hypertension", "Type 2 diabetes mellitus without complications")

columns.name: secondaryDiagnosisCode
columns.description: Secondary diagnosis code associated with the prescription. (e.g., "F32.9", "G47.9")

columns.name: secondaryDiagnosisQualifier
columns.description: Qualifier for the secondary diagnosis code. (e.g., "ICD-10", "ICD-9")

columns.name: secondaryDiagnosisDescription
columns.description: Description of the secondary diagnosis. (e.g., "Major depressive disorder, single episode, unspecified", "Sleep disorder, unspecified")

columns.name: refillRemaining
columns.description: Number of refills remaining for the prescription. (e.g., 0, 1, 2)

columns.name: pvdFacility
columns.description: Name of the facility where the prescribing provider works. (e.g., "General Hospital", "City Clinic", "Medical Center")

columns.name: pharmacyaddress
columns.description: Address of the pharmacy where the prescription was filled. (e.g., "123 Main St", "456 Elm St")

columns.name: pharmacystate
columns.description: State where the pharmacy is located. (e.g., "NY", "CA", "IL")

columns.name: pharmacyzip
columns.description: ZIP code of the pharmacy location. (e.g., "10001", "90001", "60601")

table_description: This table stores logs of prescriptions.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This column is an auto incremented Primary Key.

columns.name: Doc_FName
columns.description: This column stores doctor's first name who prescribes the medication which could be a string with maximum 50 characters in it.

columns.name: Doc_LName
columns.description: This column stores doctor's last name who prescribes the medication which could be a string with maximum 50 characters in it.

columns.name: Doc_DeaNo
columns.description: This column stores a DEA number (alphanumeric) an identifier assigned to a health care provider by the United States Drug Enforcement Administration allowing them to write prescriptions for controlled substances.

columns.name: ScriptDate
columns.description: This column stores the date in format YYYYMMDD when the medication was prescribed by the Provider.

columns.name: Pt_FName
columns.description: This column stores patient's first name who prescribes the medication which could be a string with maximum 50 characters in it.

columns.name: Pt_LName
columns.description: This column stores patient's last name who prescribes the medication which could be a string with maximum 50 characters in it.

columns.name: Pt_PBMid
columns.description: This column stores PBMid which is coming from Rx Eligibility.

columns.name: PayorSourceName
columns.description: This column stores Payor's source name which is coming from Rx Eligibility.

columns.name: Formularyid
columns.description: This column stores Formulary id coming from Rx Eligibility.

columns.name: Scriptid
columns.description: This column stores unique id generated for that DEA as Script id.

columns.name: ESIMail
columns.description: not in  use.

columns.name: PDHViewed
columns.description: not in  use.

columns.name: FormularyStatus
columns.description: This column stores the status of Formulary applicable. This value comes from Formulary Check (internal formulary hub server).

columns.name: NDCCode
columns.description: This column stores NDC code of the prescribed medication. The code has hyphen '-' in it.

columns.name: DrugName
columns.description: This column stores name of the prescribed Drug.

columns.name: dosage
columns.description: This column stores an information about the dosage of the prescribed medicine.

columns.name: Formulation
columns.description: This column stores an information about the form of the prescribed medicine.

columns.name: Quantity
columns.description: This column stores dispense data of the prescribed medication.

columns.name: Generic
columns.description: This column stores a value 'G' or 'B'. G - if the prescribed medication is generic, B - when it is branded.

columns.name: OriginalScript
columns.description: This column stores a flag 'Y' or 'N'. Y -  if medication prescribed is for first time for that encounter, N - Otherwise.

columns.name: Refills
columns.description: This column stores maximum number of refills for the prescribed medication.

columns.name: DAW
columns.description: This column stores a flag 'y' or 'N' for Dispense As Written flag. 'Y' - DAW , 'N' - else substitute allowed.

columns.name: RxChannel
columns.description:
This column stores the action taken on the eprescription. It could be one of the below : Faxed, 
Printed, 
ePrescripIpad, 
Fax:Mobile, 
ePrescription, 
eRx:Mobile.

columns.name: XMLReceived
columns.description: This column stores xml format for this record.

columns.name: Patientid
columns.description: This column stores Patient's id for whom the medication is prescribed. This column refers column UID from user table.

columns.name: doctorid
columns.description: This column stores doctor's id who prescribes the medication. This column refers column UID from user table.

columns.name: MailOrderPharmacy
columns.description: This column stores a value 1 or 0. 1 - if Pharmacy is a Mail Order, 0 - otherwise

columns.name: Alternativeid
columns.description: This column stores alternative id which populates from Rx Eligibility.

columns.name: Coverageid
columns.description: This column stores coverage id and populates from Rx Eligibility.

columns.name: Copayid
columns.description: This column stores copay id which populates from Rx Eligibility.

columns.name: NPI
columns.description: This column stores the provider�s National Provider identification number.

columns.name: NCPDPid
columns.description: This column store the unique, national identification number assigned by the National Council for Prescription Drug Programs (NCPDP) to every licensed pharmacy in the United States and its territories.

columns.name: PayorSourceCode
columns.description: This column stores the code for the Payor source from PayorSourceName column, this value populates from Rx Eligibility.

columns.name: HealthPlanGroupid
columns.description: This column stores Health Plan Group id which is populated from Rx Eligibility.

columns.name: HealthPlanid
columns.description: This column stores Health Plan id which is populated from Rx Eligibility.

columns.name: Encounterid
columns.description: This column stores the encounter id to which this eprescription is tied to. This column refers to column encounterid from enc table.

columns.name: Itemid
columns.description: This column stores the item is corresponding to the prescribed medication. This column refers column itemid from items table.

columns.name: LoginUserid
columns.description: This column stores the logged in user's id, this column refers column UID from user table.

columns.name: TransactionTime
columns.description: This column is to store the time stamp of the transaction when it happens. The format used is YYYYMMDDHHMMSS.

columns.name: encType
columns.description: This column stores type of the encounter which this eprescription is tied to. It could be one of the below values: 1 - Office Visit, 2 - Tel Encounter, Virtual Visits, 3 - Out of Office, 4 - Claim, 5 - Lab, 6 - Web Encounter, 7 - ePrescription refills, 8 - PTDASH, 9 - Orderset with patientid as 8663.

columns.name: LogBatchid
columns.description: This column stores batch id, this column is used for reporting for Ohio practices.

columns.name: LogStatus
columns.description: This column stores status of the log (Logged, Reviewed) and is used for reporting for Ohio practices.

columns.name: Take
columns.description: Instructions for taking the medication (e.g., "Take 1 tablet daily").

columns.name: Freq
columns.description: Frequency of taking the medication (e.g., "Once daily").

columns.name: Route
columns.description: Route of administration for the medication (e.g., "Oral").

columns.name: Duration
columns.description: Duration of the medication treatment (e.g., "30 days").

columns.name: PharmacyName
columns.description: Name of the pharmacy where the prescription was sent.

columns.name: OTCCode
columns.description: Over-the-counter code for the medication (Y for yes, N for no).

columns.name: CSASchedule
columns.description: Controlled Substance Act schedule for the medication (e.g., "2" for Schedule II).

columns.name: IpAddress
columns.description: IP address of the user who logged the prescription.

columns.name: rxorderno
columns.description: This column stores order number for the set of medications prescribed during a specific encounter. This is application generated number which always begins with 'S' character.

columns.name: SuprPrid
columns.description: Unique identifier for the supervising provider, if applicable.

columns.name: pharmacyid
columns.description: This column stores the Pharmacy id to which the eprescription is sent.

columns.name: FaxLogid
columns.description: Unique identifier for the fax log entry associated with the prescription. Foreign key relation to `faxlogs(Logid)`.

columns.name: sendToRxLogid
columns.description: Unique identifier for the send to Rx log entry associated with the prescription. Foreign key relation to `send_to_rx_logs(id)`.

table_description: This table stores notes created by scribes during medical encounters.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This is the primary key and a unique identifier for each note in the table. It is an integer that is automatically incremented. Example: 1, 2, 3, etc.

columns.name: encounterid
columns.description: This column stores the unique identifier of the medical encounter that the note is associated with. It is a foreign key that refers to the `id` column in the `encounters` table. Example: 101, 102, 103, etc.

columns.name: scribenotes
columns.description: This column stores the actual text of the scribe's notes. It is a text data type that can store a large amount of text. Example: "Patient complained of chest pain and shortness of breath."

columns.name: websync
columns.description: This column indicates whether the note has been synchronized with a web-based system. It is a tiny integer with a default value of '0'. A value of '0' means not synchronized, and a value of '1' means synchronized. Example: 0, 1.

columns.name: createdtime
columns.description: This column stores the date and time when the note was created. It is a datetime data type. Example: '2021-09-15 14:30:00'.

table_description: The table is used to maintain seasons details in athletics modules

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier for each season record. Example: 1, 2, 3.

columns.name: NAME

table_description: Table is used to store patient encounter and template mapping.

columns.name: entryId
columns.description: This column stores auto incremented entryId, datatype is INT (11). This column stores integer value which could grow with number of transactions over the years hence integer (Range: 0-2,147,483,647) is selected. It is AUTO_INCREMENT column and has PRIMARY KEY index

columns.name: encounterId
columns.description: This column is used to identify for which patient encounter user has documented data. This column is FOREIGN KEY which refers to encounterId column of enc table. This column stores a high range numeric value hence integer is selected, and this column will always have a value hence defined as NOT NULL.

columns.name: templateId
columns.description: This column store template id of template which is added for patient encounter. This column is FOREIGN KEY which refers to id column of ip_rh_clinical_sd_template table. This column stores a high range numeric value hence integer is selected, and this column will always have a value hence defined as NOT NULL.

columns.name: isLocked

columns.description: This column stores name or question created by end user of a structured item.

columns.name: type
columns.description: This column stores a number value which indicates what should be the type of the structured data on local . Value 0 id structured text, Value 1 is free text, Value 2 is date, Value 3 is Boolean yes and no.

columns.name: mandatory
columns.description: This column stores flags 0/1 to indicate whether question is mandatory to fill or not. 0 - question is mandatory, 1 - Item is mandatory.

columns.name: displayIndex
columns.description: This column stores a number to indicate in which order form questions should be listed on User Interface.

columns.name: deleteFlag
columns.description: This column stores values 0/1 to indicate whether the item has been marked deleted or not. 0 - Item is not marked deleted, 1 - Item is marked deleted.

columns.description: This column stores id of a parent question under which new question has been created. This column refers to id column in structdatadetail table.

columns.name: triggerflag
columns.description: This column stores id of a question options for which this question has been triggered. This column refers to Optionid column in structdataoptions table.

columns.name: itemType
columns.description: This column stores a value which indicates what is  the type of the structured data whether it is a category or just an Item .  'C' - is a category and 'I' - is an item.

columns.name: nodeLevel
columns.description: This column stores level of question like parent question or child question level. For parent question node level value as 0, child question node level value as 1 and for second level child question node level values as 2 etc.

columns.name: tblName
columns.description: This column stores the table name for a question to indicate category/module and item belongs to. i.e structSocialHistory , structHpi , structExam, structPreventive, structPhysicalExam etc

columns.name: chartDisplay
columns.description: This column stores a value 0 or 1 to indicate whether the data should come up on chart or not. Value 0 indicates the structured item will not come up on chart and Value 1 indicates the structured item will come up on chart.

columns.name: multiSelect
columns.description: This column stores a value which indicated whether the structured question us multiselect or not. Value 1 is states user can multiselect the options 0/NULL states user cannot multiselect the options

columns.name: IsSearchable
columns.description: This column stores a value which indicated whether the structured question is searchable or not. Value 1 is states the question is searchable , the value 0 states  the question is not searchable.

columns.name: defaultValue
columns.description: This column stores a value which will be a default value  for that  question . The column value will be NULL if the question doesn't have a default value.

columns.name: defaultValueid
columns.description:
This column stores an id which will be a default value  for that  question . 
This column  refers to  column  optionid from structdataoptions table or stores blank '' if the question doesn't have a default value id.

columns.name: modifynotes
columns.description: This column stores a value 0 or 1 to indicate whether the notes of that question can be modified or not. Value 0 indicates that the notes of the structured element cannot be modified and Value 1 indicates that the notes of the structured element can be modified

columns.name: readonly
columns.description: This column stores a value 0 or 1 to indicate whether the question is read-only. Value 0 means the question is not readonly whereas value 1 means it is a readOnly element.

columns.name: dropdown
columns.description: This column stores a value 0 or 1 to indicate whether the question  should have a dropdown or not. Value 0 indicates that the question cannot be a dropdown and Value 1 indicates that question can be a dropdown.

columns.name: PmtPlanid
columns.description: This column stores id of a payment plan id . This column refers to planid column in paymentplandetail table.

columns.name: imagename
columns.description: This column stores the value of a  file name of the image associated to that structured questions.

columns.name: minVal
columns.description: This column stores a value which will be a minimum value for that question . The column value will be blank if the question doesn't have a minimum value.

columns.name: maxVal
columns.description: This column stores a value which will be a maximum value for that question . The column value will be blank if the question doesn't have a maximum value.

columns.name: multitrigger
columns.description: This column stores a value which triggers multiple structured questions.

columns.name: displayOnPn
columns.description: This column stores a value 0 or 1 to indicate whether the question should display on progress notes  or not. Value 1 indicates the question should display on progress notes  and Value 0 states  the question should not display on progress notes.

columns.name: inactive
columns.description: It Indicates whether the data item is inactive (1) or not (0). It default value is 0 means active.

table_description: This table stores the reasons for structured addendums, along with information about the user who created the reason and timestamps for when the reason was created.

columns.name: reasonId
columns.description: Unique identifier for each reason, with an integer value. For example: 1, 2, 3.

columns.name: reason
columns.description: The text description of the reason for the structured addendum. For example: "Typographical error", "Missing information".

columns.name: userId
columns.description: The unique identifier (integer) of the user who created the reason. This is a foreign key that refers to the `users` table and the `uid` column. For example: 101, 102, 103.

columns.name: createdDate
columns.description: The date when the reason was created, in the format YYYY-MM-DD. For example: 2021-08-01, 2021-08-02.

columns.name: createdTime
columns.description: The time when the reason was created, in the format HH:MM:SS. For example: 14:30:00, 15:45:30.

columns.name: deleteflag
columns.description: A tiny integer (0 or 1) indicating whether the reason has been deleted (1) or not (0). For example: 0, 1.

columns.name: nonStructuredReason
columns.description: A tiny integer (0 or 1) indicating whether the reason is non-structured (1) or structured (0). For example: 0, 1.

table_description: This table stores the reasons for noncompliance in a structured format, along with information about non-structured reason and if the record is deleted.

columns.name: reasonId
columns.description: This is the primary key and an auto-incrementing integer that uniquely identifies each reason for noncompliance. Example: 1, 2, 3, etc.

columns.name: reason
columns.description: This is a varchar(255) column that stores the description of the noncompliance reason. Example: "Late submission", "Incomplete documentation", etc.

columns.name: deleteflag
columns.description: This is a tinyint(4) column that indicates whether the record is deleted or not. A value of '0' means the record is not deleted, and a value of '1' means the record is deleted. Example: 0, 1.

columns.name: nonStructuredReason
columns.description: This is a tinyint(4) column that indicates whether the reason is non-structured or not. A value of '0' means the reason is structured, and a value of '1' means the reason is non-structured. Example: 0, 1.

table_description: This table stores demographic information about students, including their program, college, major, dormitory, address, phone number, registration status, and other related details.

columns.name: WithdrawalDesc

columns.name: EthnicCode

columns.name: EthnicCodeDesc

columns.name: AthleteInd

columns.name: LocalAddressLine1

columns.description: This column stores id of a provider/staff who suppressed the interaction prompt. This column refers to UID column in user table.

columns.name: InteractionType
columns.description: This column stores abbreviation indicating type of interaction prompted in a drug interaction warning. DA - Drug to Allergy Interaction , DI - Drug to Drug Interaction.

columns.name: Drugid1
columns.description: This column stores id of a drug which has interaction with other prescribed drug. ids stored in this column comes from  Medispan API or Multum drug database.

columns.name: Drugid2
columns.description: This column stores id of a drug which has interaction with other prescribed drug.  ids stored in this column comes from  Medispan API or Multum drug database.

columns.name: AdjustedSeverity

table_description: This table stores information about different types of transactions and their creation time.

table_description: This table stores the history of transactions and collection statuses for patients in a medical practice.

columns.description: Unique identifier for each record in the table (e.g., 1, 2, 3).

columns.description: The identifier for the patient associated with the transaction. This could be a foreign key referring to the id column in the Patient table  (e.g., 101, 102, 103).

columns.description: The patient's balance before the transaction (e.g., 100.00, 200.00, 300.00).

columns.name: Balance
columns.description: The patient's current balance after the transaction (e.g.,150.00, 250.00, 350.00).

columns.name: CollectionStatus
columns.description: The status of the collection process for the patient's balance (e.g., Pending, Paid, Overdue).

columns.name: date
columns.description: The date when the transaction occurred (e.g., 2021-10-01, 2021-10-02, 2021-10-03).

columns.name: time

columns.name: modifieddatetime

columns.description: The identifier for the file associated with the transaction. This could be a foreign key referring to the id column in the `transworldfilelog` tables. (e.g., 1001, 1002, 1003).

columns.name: practiceid
columns.description: This is the identifier for the medical practice associated with the transaction. This could be a foreign key referring to the id column on the Practice table (e.g., 1, 2, 3).

table_description: This table stores information about file logs related to Transworld Systems, including details about the file, the number of patients and claims, and the creation date and time.

table_description: This table stores information about the triage responses for patients in a medical facility.

table_description: This table stores information about different types of trigger code systems.

table_description: This table stores information about revenue and CPT codes associated with invoices.

columns.name: RateCode

columns.name: Itemid
columns.description: An integer representing the unique identifier of the item or service. Example: 56789 (Foreign key relation: `items.itemid`)

columns.name: TermCode

columns.description: This column stores the immunizationid for which the reaction is being documented on Immunization Reaction Add/Edit window. This column will always have a valid immunizationid value and never be NULL as the data in this column is updated from the Immunization Reaction window.

columns.name: vaccineReactionid
columns.description: This column storea the reactionid selected at the time of reaction documentation on the Immunization Reaction Add/Edit window. This refers to the vaccineReactionListid column of the database, so the data type must match that column. This column will always have a valid vaccine reaction ID value and never be NULL as data in this column is updated from the Immunization Reaction window.

columns.name: deleteFlag
columns.description: This column stores the deleteFlag value for a particular immunization reaction. The default value for this column is 0 at the time of documenting a new reaction. This column is set to 1 when a user deletes a reaction from Immunization Reaction History window.

columns.name: lastUpdatedBy
columns.description: This column stores the userid of the logged-in user who has performed an add, update or delete action on an immunization reaction on the Immunization Reaction History window. This refers to the users.UID column of the database, so the data type must match that column. This column will always have a valid logged-in user ID value and never be NULL as data in this column is updated from the Immunization Reaction window.

columns.name: vaccineReactionDate
columns.description: This column stores the Reaction Date associated to an immunization reaction on the Immunization Reaction Add/Edit window. This column is populated from the EMR and is never NULL. If the optional Reaction Date field is not selected on the Reaction Add/Edit window, then the default date is applied. Date format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2022-12-14.

columns.name: updatedDateTime
columns.description: This column stores the date/time when a user adds, updates, or deletes a reaction associated to an immunization on the Immunization Reaction History window. This column will always be populated with the current_time stamp when an entry is made from the EMR and is never NULL. The Date/Time format is YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss. Example: 2022-03-07 18:19:11.

columns.name: rxnStatus
columns.description: This column stores the latest action performed on a particular immunization reaction (e.g., A - When a reaction is newly documented, U - When an existing reaction is updated, D - When a reaction is deleted). This status is sent to the Immunization Hub and state registries. This column is updated from the Immunization Reaction window; the setting defaults as A.

table_description: This table stores information about the dispense queue for vision products, such as glasses or contact lenses, including the status of the dispense process, assignment details, and related encounter and order information.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This column is an auto incremented primary key.

columns.description: This column stores an encounter id for which dispense record is added. This column refers to column encouner id from the enc table. Also, enctype = 16 indicates dispense encounter.

columns.description: This column stores different statuses when the dispense record is created using dispense module. This column refers to the column id from the vision_master table.

columns.description: This column stores an identifier for the user to whom the dispense queue record is assigned. (e.g., 1001, 1002, 1003)

columns.name: context
columns.description: This column stores one of the below context for this dispense record. A "1" is created based on a previous sight exam, a "2" is for a remake, a "3" is for outside Rx, a "4" is for contact lens from previous previous sight tests, and a "5" is outside Rx for contact lens, and "6" is for over the counter.

columns.name: isdeleted
columns.description: This column contains a flag to indicate whether the record is deleted, where 0 is the default value (e.g., 0, 1).

columns.name: createdby
columns.description: This column stores the id of the staff or provider who creates this dispense record. This column refers to the column UID from the user table.

columns.name: createdon
columns.description: This column stores the time stamp when this dispense record was created. The format used is YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: updatedby
columns.description: This column stores the id of the staff or provider who updates this dispense record. This column refers to the column UID from the user table.

columns.name: updatedon
columns.description: This column stores the time stamp when this dispense record was created. The format used is YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: pnencounterid

columns.name: pairid
columns.description: This column stores the id of the pair whenever it is added to this dispense record. This column refers to the column id from the vision_order_pair table.

columns.name: orderid
columns.description: This column stores order id whenever a order is placed. This column refers to column id from the vision_orders table.

columns.name: indispense_status_log
columns.description: This column stores the time stamp when last time the status was updated. The format used is YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: notes
columns.description: This column stores additional notes (free text) for this dispense record.

columns.name: visionrxid
columns.description: This column stores an identifier for the vision prescription associated with the dispense queue record (e.g., 10001, 10002, 10003).

table_description: This table stores information related to near vision testing performed for patients during their encounters.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This is the primary key for the table, which uniquely identifies each record. It is an integer value that is automatically incremented by the database. Example: 1, 2, 3, etc.

columns.name: encounterid
columns.description: This is a foreign key that refers to the `enc` table's `encounterid` column. It represents the unique identifier for a patient's encounter during which the near vision testing was performed. Example: 101, 102, 103, etc.

columns.name: pu_acc_amp
columns.description: This column stores the accommodative amplitude value for the patient's near vision testing. It is a varchar(6) field. Example: '2.50D', '3.00D', '1.75D', etc.

columns.name: pbu_near_add
columns.description: This column stores the near addition value for the patient's near vision testing. It is a varchar(5) field. Example: '+1.0', '+1.5', '+2.0', etc.

columns.name: nra
columns.description: This column stores the negative relative accommodation value for the patient's near vision testing. It is a varchar(5) field. Example: '-2.0', '-1.5', '-1.0', etc.

columns.name: pra
columns.description: This column stores the positive relative accommodation value for the patient's near vision testing. It is a varchar(5) field. Example: '+1.0', '+1.5', '+2.0', etc.

columns.name: bin_xcyl
columns.description: This column stores the binocular cross-cylinder value for the patient's near vision testing. It is a varchar(5) field. Example: '0.50', '0.75', '1.00', etc.

table_description: This table stores information about non-player characters (NPCs) in a vision system, including encounter ID, type of vision prescription, and various vision-related attributes.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This is the primary key and an auto-incrementing integer that uniquely identifies each record in the vision_npc table. Example: 1, 2, 3, etc.

columns.name: encounterid
columns.description: This is a foreign key that refers to the `encounterid` column in the `enc` table. It represents the unique identifier for an encounter with an NPC. Example: 101, 102, 103, etc.

columns.name: rx_type
columns.description: This is a tiny integer column that represents the type of vision prescription for the NPC. It can be NULL or an unsigned integer value. Example: 0, 1, 2, etc.

columns.name: npc_blur
columns.description: This is a small integer column that represents the blur value for the NPC's vision. It can be null or an integer value. Example: 10, 20, 30, etc.

columns.name: npc_break
columns.description: This is a small integer column that represents the break value for the NPC's vision. It can be null or an integer value. Example: 5, 10, 15, etc.

columns.name: npc_recovery
columns.description: This is a small integer column that represents the recovery value for the NPC's vision. It can be null or an integer value. Example: 3, 6, 9, etc.

columns.name: comments
columns.description: This is a varchar column with a maximum length of 255 characters that stores any additional comments or notes about the NPC's vision. It has a default value of an empty string. Example: "NPC has astigmatism.", "NPC wears glasses.", etc.

table_description: This table stores information about nystagmus, a vision condition characterized by involuntary eye movements, for each patient encounter.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This is the primary key for the table and is an auto-incrementing integer value. It uniquely identifies each record in the table. Example: 1, 2, 3, etc.

columns.name: encounterid
columns.description: Unique identifier for each patient encounter. This column has a foreign key relation with the `enc` table and the `encounterid` column. Example: 101, 102, 103.

columns.name: direction
columns.description: The direction of the nystagmus eye movement. Example: 'horizontal', 'vertical', 'rotary'.

columns.name: frequency
columns.description: The frequency of the nystagmus eye movement. Example: 'low', 'medium', 'high'.

columns.name: amplitude
columns.description: The amplitude of the nystagmus eye movement. Example: 'small', 'medium', 'large'.

columns.name: NULL_point
columns.description: The position of the eyes where the nystagmus movement is minimized or absent. Example: '10 degrees left', '5 degrees up'.

columns.name: head_posture
columns.description: The head posture adopted by the patient to minimize the nystagmus movement. Example: 'tilted left', 'chin down'.

columns.name: comments
columns.description: Additional comments or observations related to the nystagmus condition. Example: 'worsens with fatigue', 'improves with glasses'.

table_description: This table stores patients' contact lens order information.

columns.name: barcode
columns.description: Barcode of the product, a string of up to 255 characters (e.g., "123456789012").

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of the order, represented as an integer (e.g., 0 for pending, 1 for processed).

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Quantity of the product ordered, represented as an integer (e.g., 2).

columns.name: side
columns.description: Side of the contact lens, represented as a tiny integer (e.g., 1 for left, 2 for right).

columns.name: visionrxid
columns.description: identifier for the vision prescription, referring to the primary key in the vision prescriptions table.

columns.name: pair
columns.description: Pair of contact lenses, represented as a two character string (e.g., "L1").

columns.name: drno
columns.description: This column indicates the reference for contact lens order which is a combination of encounterid and pair.

columns.name: price
columns.description: Price of the product that is represented as a decimal with 12 digits and four decimal places (e.g., 99.9900).

columns.name: isdeleted
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the record is deleted, represented as a tiny integer (e.g., 0 for not deleted, 1 for deleted).

columns.name: bc
columns.description: Base curve of the contact lens, a string of up to 11 characters (e.g., "8.6").

columns.name: dia
columns.description: Diameter of the contact lens, a string of up to 11 characters (e.g., "14.0").

columns.name: color
columns.description: Color of the contact lens, a string of up to 30 characters (e.g., "Blue").

columns.name: isOtherLens
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the lens is not a standard lens, represented as a bit (e.g., 0 for standard, 1 for non-standard).

columns.name: productName
columns.description: Name of the product, a string of up to 255 characters (e.g., "Acuvue Oasys").

columns.name: category
columns.description: Category of the product, a string of up to 30 characters (e.g., "Daily Disposable").

columns.name: material
columns.description: Material of the contact lens, a string of up to 30 characters (e.g., "Silicone Hydrogel").

columns.name: oad
columns.description: Overall diameter of the contact lens, a string of up to 11 characters (e.g., "14.5").

columns.name: ozd
columns.description: Optical zone diameter of the contact lens, a string of up to 11 characters (e.g., "9.0").

columns.name: pc1
columns.description: First parameter code of the contact lens, a string of up to 15 characters (e.g., "PC123").

columns.name: pc2
columns.description: Second parameter code of the contact lens, a string of up to 15 characters (e.g., "PC456").

columns.name: pc3
columns.description: Third parameter code of the contact lens, a string of up to 15 characters (e.g., "PC789").

columns.name: pc4
columns.description: Fourth parameter code of the contact lens, a string of up to 15 characters (e.g., "PC012").

columns.name: ct
columns.description: Center thickness of the contact lens, a string of up to 11 characters (e.g., "0.08").

columns.name: sc
columns.description: Sagittal depth of the contact lens, a string of up to 11 characters (e.g., "2.5").

columns.name: tc
columns.description: Total diameter of the contact lens, a string of up to 11 characters (e.g., "14.2").

columns.name: SPH
columns.description: Spherical power of the contact lens, a string of up to 11 characters (e.g., "-2.00").

columns.name: CYL
columns.description: Cylindrical power of the contact lens, a string of up to 11 characters (e.g., "-1.25").

columns.name: AXIS
columns.description: Axis of the contact lens, a string of up to 11 characters (e.g., "180").

columns.name: NADD
columns.description: Near addition power of the contact lens, a string of up to 11 characters (e.g., "+1.50").

columns.name: DVA
columns.description: Distance visual acuity, a string of up to 20 characters (e.g., "20/20").

columns.name: NVA
columns.description: Near visual acuity, a string of up to 20 characters (e.g., "20/30").

columns.name: rxtype
columns.description: Prescription type, represented as a tiny integer (e.g., 0 for single vision, 1 for multifocal).

table_description: This table stores information about vision order repairs, including details about the product, pricing, tax, discount, and status updates throughout the repair process.

columns.name: oadOS

columns.name: pc1OS

table_description: This table stores vision prescription information for patients, including prescription details for the right and left eyes, prescription date, and expiration date.

columns.name: OrigPrescriptionid

columns.name: PrescriptionDate
columns.description: Date and time when the prescription was created. Example: '2021-09-15 10:30:00'.

columns.name: Type
columns.description: Type of vision prescription, such as glasses or contact lenses. Example: 'glasses', 'contacts'.

columns.name: ExpDate

columns.name: encid

columns.name: PrescriptionLeft

table_description: This table stores information about patients' pupils documented during their encounters, including details about their pupil size, brightness, and any abnormalities.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This column is an auto incremental primary key.

columns.name: encounterid
columns.description: This column stores the encounter ID and has foreign key constraint on "encounterid" column of "enc" table.

columns.name: isperrla
columns.description: This column will indicate whether pupils are equal, round, and reactive to light and accommodation. This column is a bit with a default value of 0. Value is 1 when check box is checked in UI.

columns.name: isra
columns.description: This column will indicate whether pupils are reactive to accommodation. This column is a bit with a default value 0. Value is 1 when checkbox is checked in UI.

columns.name: islgao
columns.description: This column will indicate whether pupils have Limbal Glow Angles Open. This column is a bit with a default value of 0. Value is 1 when checkbox is checked in UI.

columns.name: apd
columns.description: This column will indicate what type of Afferent Pupillary Defect the pupils have. It can only hold one of the following values - Right, Left, Negative and Both. Default value is NULL indicating non of the radio buttons are selected. It is of type Enum in mysql. In MSSQL it is varchar with a check constraint on it.

columns.name: r_dim
columns.description: This column will store values for Dim for the right eye pupil. Values that can be stored are from 1 - 10. Default value is NULL. This column is optional and hence when user does not enter any value, NULL will be stored in them.

columns.name: l_dim
columns.description: This column will store values for Dim for left eye pupil. Values that can be stored are from 1 - 10. Default value is NULL. This column is optional and hence when user does not enter any value, NULL will be stored in them.

columns.name: r_bright
columns.description: This column will store values for Bright for right eye pupil. Values that can be stored are from 1 - 10. Default value is NULL. This column is optional and hence when user does not enter any value, NULL will be stored in them.

columns.name: l_bright
columns.description: This column will store values for Bright for left eye pupil. Values that can be stored are from 1 - 10. Default value is NULL. This column is optional and hence when user does not enter any value, NULL will be stored in them.

table_description: This table stores information about refund checks, including the associated file, user details, and the time the record was created.

table_description: This table stores information related to contact lens prescriptions, including wear schedules, replenishment details, care regimens, and other relevant notes.

columns.description: This is the primary key for the table and is an auto-incrementing integer value. It uniquely identifies each record in the table. Example: 1, 2, 3, etc.

columns.name: VisionRxid
columns.description: This column contains a foreign key that refers to the `id` column in the `visionrx` table. It represents the unique identifier for the associated vision prescription. Example: 101, 102, 103, etc.

columns.name: Encounterid
columns.description: Foreign key that refers to the `encounterid` column in the `enc` table. It represents the unique identifier for the associated patient encounter. Example: 201, 202, 203, etc.

columns.name: WearSchedule
columns.description: This column contains a text description of the contact lens wear schedule. Example: "Daily wear", "Extended wear", "Continuous wear", etc.

columns.name: Replenishment
columns.description: This column is a text description of the contact lens replenishment schedule. Example: "Monthly", "Bi-weekly", "Quarterly", etc.

columns.name: DOT
columns.description: This column is a text description of the dispensing optician or technician's notes. Example: "Patient prefers daily disposable lenses", "Patient has dry eyes", etc.

columns.name: CareRegiment
columns.description: This column contains a text description of the recommended care regimen for the contact lenses. Example: "Use multipurpose solution", "Use hydrogen peroxide solution", "Use daily cleaner and conditioning solution", etc.

columns.name: Notes
columns.description: Additional text notes related to the contact lens prescription. Example: "Patient has astigmatism", "Patient is new to contact lenses", etc.

columns.name: lenticular
columns.description: A varchar (25) column that stores information about the lenticular design of the contact lens. Example: "Standard", "Custom", "Aspheric", etc.

columns.name: edgelift
columns.description: A varchar(25) column that stores information about the edge lift of the contact lens. Example: "Low", "Medium", "High", etc.

table_description: This table stores information about fitting comments related to vision prescriptions, including centration movement, toric orientation, and Nafi pattern.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This is the primary key for the table and is an auto-incrementing integer value. It uniquely identifies each record in the table. Example: 1, 2, 3, etc.

columns.name: VisionRxid
columns.description: Foreign key that refers to the `id` column in the `visionrx` table. It represents the unique identifier for the associated vision prescription. Example: 101, 102, 103, etc.

columns.name: Encounterid
columns.description: identifier for the encounter related to the vision prescription. It refers to enc table `encounterid` column. Example: 1001, 1002, 1003.

columns.name: Centration_Movement
columns.description: This column contains a text description of the centration movement for the vision prescription. Example: "Minimal", "Moderate", "Significant".

columns.name: Toric_Orientation
columns.description: This column contains a text description of the toric orientation for the vision prescription. Example: "Horizontal", "Vertical", "Oblique".

columns.name: Nafi_Pattern
columns.description: This column is a text description of the Nafi pattern for the vision prescription. Example: "Regular", "Irregular", "Mixed".

columns.name: Fitting_Comments
columns.description: This column contains additional text comments related to the fitting of the vision prescription. Example: "Patient needs further adjustments", "Fitting is perfect", "Consider different lens type".

table_description: This table stores information related to vision prescriptions, including measurements and attributes for the prescribed lenses.

columns.name: id
columns.description: This is the primary key for the table and is an auto-incrementing integer value. It uniquely identifies each record in the table. Example: 1, 2, 3, etc.

columns.name: VisionRxid
columns.description: Foreign key that refers to the `id` column in the `visionrx` table. It represents the unique identifier for the associated vision prescription. Example: 101, 102, 103, etc.

columns.name: Encounterid
columns.description: identifier for the patient encounter during which the prescription was given. It refers to enc table `encounterid` column. Example: 1001, 1002, 1003.

columns.name: ExamType
columns.description: This column contains an identifier for the type of eye exam conducted. Example: 1, 2, 3.

columns.name: Eye_OD_OS
columns.description: This column indicates whether the prescription is for the right eye (OD) or left eye (OS). Example: 0 (OD), 1 (OS).

columns.name: OZD_0
columns.description: This column contains an optical zone diameter measurement for the first lens. Example: "7.5", "7.8", "8.0".

columns.name: R2_0
columns.description: Second radial measurement for the first lens. Example: "2.5", "3.0", "3.5".

columns.name: W2_0
columns.description: This column contains a second width measurement for the first lens. Example: "0.8", "1.0", "1.2".

columns.name: R3_0
columns.description: This column contains a third radial measurement for the first lens. Example: "4.0", "4.5", "5.0".

columns.name: W3_0
columns.description: This column contains a third width measurement for the first lens. Example: "1.5", "1.8", "2.0".

columns.name: RPC_0
columns.description: This column contains a radial periphery curve measurement for the first lens. Example: "8.0", "8.5", "9.0".

columns.name: WPC_0
columns.description: Width periphery curve measurement for the first lens. Example: "2.5", "3.0", "3.5".

columns.name: BC_1
columns.description: Base curve measurement for the second lens. Example: "8.0", "8.5", "9.0".

columns.name: DIA_1
columns.description: This column contains a diameter measurement for the second lens. Example: "14.0", "14.5", "15.0".

columns.name: SPH_1
columns.description: This column contains pherical power measurement for the second lens. Example: "-2.00", "-1.50", "0.00".

columns.name: CYL_1
columns.description: This column contains cylindrical power measurement for the second lens. Example: "-0.75", "-0.50", "0.00".

columns.name: AXIS_1
columns.description: This column contains an axis measurement for the second lens. Example: "90", "100", "110".

columns.name: OZD_1
columns.description: Optical zone diameter measurement for the second lens. Example: "7.5", "7.8", "8.0".

columns.name: R2_1
columns.description: Second radial measurement for the second lens. Example: "2.5", "3.0", "3.5".

columns.name: W2_1
columns.description: Second width measurement for the second lens. Example: "0.8", "1.0", "1.2".

columns.name: R3_1
columns.description: Third radial measurement for the second lens. Example: "4.0", "4.5", "5.0".

columns.name: W3_1
columns.description: Third width measurement for the second lens. Example: "1.5", "1.8", "2.0".

columns.name: RPC_1
columns.description: Radial periphery curve measurement for the second lens. Example: "8.0", "8.5", "9.0".

columns.name: WPC_1
columns.description: Width periphery curve measurement for the second lens. Example: "2.5", "3.0", "3.5".

columns.name: Color
columns.description: Color of the lens. Example: "Clear", "Blue", "Green".

columns.name: DOT
columns.description: Dot matrix pattern on the lens. Example: "Small", "Medium", "Large".

columns.name: CT
columns.description: Center thickness of the lens. Example: "0.08", "0.10", "0.12".

columns.name: BLEND
columns.description: Blend type of the lens. Example: "Soft", "Medium", "Hard".

columns.name: AOZO
columns.description: Aspheric or zonal optimization of the lens. Example: "Aspheric", "Zonal".

columns.name: LENT
columns.description: Lens treatment applied. Example: "UV", "Anti-Reflective", "Scratch-Resistant".

columns.name: EDGE
columns.description: Edge design of the lens. Example: "Round", "Beveled", "Polished".

columns.name: EDGET
columns.description: Edge treatment applied to the lens. Example: "Polished", "Tinted", "None".

columns.name: PRISM
columns.description: Prism correction value for the lens. Example: "0.5", "1.0", "1.5".

columns.name: MATERIAL
columns.description: Material used for the lens. Example: "Polycarbonate", "Plastic", "Glass".

table_description: This table stores information about spectacle notes and lens add-ons related to a specific vision prescription and encounter.

columns.name: VisionRxid

columns.name: Encounterid

columns.name: LensAddons

columns.name: Notes
